name: All On The Line Texas
subject: Our movement is fighting to protect the voting power of Black and Latino voters in Texas
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE NATIONAL REDISTRICTING ACTION FUND
body:
With your help, we can keep up the fight
|
---

Peter,
Right now, our affiliate — the National Redistricting Foundation (NRF) — is putting up one hell of a fight to block the implementation of Texas’s new racially gerrymandered congressional map. **And we here at AOTL need to be poised to respond, no matter what the court says.**
**A quick recap:**
At the direction of Donald Trump, Texas lawmakers enacted a new congressional gerrymander, and this one goes even further to diminish the voting power of communities of color.
**The NRF immediately filed a supplemental complaint challenging the map. The NRF-supported plaintiffs are now asking the court to use the prior congressional map for the 2026 elections as this case continues in court.**
As Marina Jenkins, executive director of the NRF, put it: “Texas’s existing map was facing legal challenges for cracking and packing minority voters to limit their ability to elect the candidates of their choice. **This new map exacerbates those fundamental flaws; it is an unconstitutional racial gerrymander that intentionally discriminates against Black and Latino voters, and it must not be allowed to go into effect.” **
**AOTL is closely monitoring the court process so that we can be ready to respond no matter what the court does. **
**And whether or not the new map remains in effect, though, our movement cannot falter.** The fair maps movement is fighting gerrymandered maps everywhere we can. All On The Line is focused on organizing volunteers to push back against map manipulation and working to educate voters about what’s at stake for our democracy in the months ahead. Once the courts rule on gerrymanders like Texas, this grassroots movement will need to be ready to mobilize.
[**We need all hands on deck to ensure we’re doing everything we can to defend our democracy as extremists try to silence voters with mid-decade redraws. name: David Hogg
subject: Randy grew up on Medicaid — now he’s fighting to save it
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
Randy Villegas is taking on corporate greed and the political establishment in a crucial swing House seat — but he needs our help.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20251020-1&t=1&akid=2758%2E587540%2E6T_1hl)
Hi Peter, I'd like to introduce you to another one of our LWD candidates, someone I couldn’t be more excited to support: **Randy Villegas.**
Randy is an educator, small business owner, organizer, and proud son of Mexican immigrants running for Congress in California’s 22nd District, **one of the most competitive swing seats in the country** that will help decide control of the House.
**He’s the _only_ candidate in this race refusing corporate PAC money — because he knows you can’t fight for affordable healthcare, housing, and groceries while cashing checks from the corporations driving prices up.**
**[That’s why I’m asking you to split a $5 donation right now between Randy Villegas and Leaders We Deserve.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20251020_1_villegas.czWAza&refcode=em20251020-2758&amount=5&t=3&akid=2758%2E587540%2E6T_1hl)**
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20251020_1_villegas.czWAza&refcode=em20251020-2758&amount=5&t=4&akid=2758%2E587540%2E6T_1hl)
Randy grew up on Medicaid, food assistance, and school lunches — the very programs Republican Congressman David Valadao voted to slash.
**This race is _very_ winnable for Randy. **Valadao barely scraped by in the last two elections — and he already lost re-election here in 2018 for voting to repeal the Affordable Care Act. Some people just never learn...
**But to flip this seat, Randy has to beat the incumbent Republican and a corporate-backed Democrat — taking on the political establishment twice in one race.**
Right now, he’s facing one of the most conservative Democrats in California, someone who voted _against_ holding oil corporations accountable for price gouging and takes money from Big Pharma and Big Oil.
Randy’s campaign is powered by nurses, teachers, farmers, and working people — not corporations. He’s already raised more than half a million grassroots dollars — because people know he’s the kind of leader who will actually fight for them.
But both parties are pouring money into this race — Republicans know this is one of their most vulnerable seats, and corporate Democrats want to keep the status quo. **We need to show up and have Randy’s back, right now.**
**[Peter, this is one of the most competitive races we’ve ever taken on. If you’re able to, please pitch in $5 to Randy Villegas and Leaders We Deserve right now.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20251020_1_villegas.czWAza&refcode=em20251020-2758&amount=5&t=5&akid=2758%2E587540%2E6T_1hl)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20251020_1_villegas.czWAza&amount=5&refcode=em20251020-2758&t=24&akid=2758%2E587540%2E6T_1hl)**
Randy's mom always used to tell him, _"Tell me who you're with, and I'll tell you who you are."_
I’m proud to say I’m with Randy Villegas — I hope you will be too.
Thank you,

David Hogg

name: Jim Jordan
subject: CNN: Democrats doing “Better than ever”
body:
Believe me, I wish this was Fake News...
Believe me, I wish this was Fake News...
| | **_A SECURE MEMO TRANSMITTED FROM THE DESK OF REP. JIM JORDAN_**
---
Friend,
---
The Democrats haven’t had much to celebrate recently.
---
**But _CNN_ is taking a victory lap after Democrats added _TWO_ more House seats to their column by winning special elections in Virginia and Arizona!**
_**CNN:
Democrats are doing better than ever in Trump-era special elections**_
“Democrats are over-performing in special elections more than they ever have in the Trump era — dating back to his first term.”
Believe me, I wish this was nothing more than Fake News...
But so far this year, the Democrats have overperformed in all of the House special elections by **_DOUBLE_ _DIGIT_** margins!
The last time Democrats overperformed in special elections with margins anywhere close to these was during President Trump’s first two years in office.
**They went on to FLIP over _40_ House seats in the midterms!**
_And right now, the Democrats are actually doing _BETTER_ than they were back then! _
But there’s one important caveat to all of this: The Democrats aren’t winning special elections by these huge margins because they’re winning more votes.
_Instead, they’re winning because thousands of Republican voters simply aren’t showing up to cast their ballots like they did last November._
**I’ll be perfectly frank with you, Friend: The biggest threat to President Trump’s House majority isn’t from anything the Democrats can do.__It’s from our own voters getting complacent and not turning out to vote.__**
And since we’re ONLY 1 SEAT over the _bare_ _minimum_ _threshold_ to declare a Majority in the House, we truly have no room for error. Losing even a single seat could prove disastrous!
_Given this troubling trend in special elections, I’ve been tasked with determining _exactly_ who President Trump and I can count on to show up and vote in the midterms. _
_I just need one thing from you before I can officially mark you as “verified,” Friend._

I’ve told you time and time again just how important this race is for New Jersey. **But what you need to understand is, what we do here will have major implications for the country.**
This is the first major election since Donald Trump returned to office. Since then, we’ve seen nothing but chaos and corruption come from the White House — and New Jersey families have taken hit after hit because of it.
On November 4, New Jerseyans have an important choice to make: we can choose the career politician who’s going to copy and paste Trump’s disastrous policies into New Jersey, or we can choose a new way forward: a leader who will _always_ put our state first, and _never_ bend to the will of deep-pocketed Washington politicians.
And if we win, not only do we send a powerful message to the nation by choosing the path of affordability, opportunity, and freedom — we empower Democrats _across the country_ to stand up and fight back against the Trump administration, setting us up for major wins in 2026, 2028, and beyond.
Whatever happens, America is going to follow New Jersey’s lead, Peter. That’s why National Republicans are pouring millions of dollars into this race, it’s why Donald Trump and his administration have attacked me repeatedly, _and it’s why we have to win this election._
**[The movement we’re building here in New Jersey is so much bigger than me or you — it’s about all of us coming together to build a new path forward for our state, and for our country. And if that’s the type of movement you believe in, I would really appreciate it if you split whatever you can between my team and State Democrats Committee to help power me to victory this Election Day.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/96775?refcode=em20251020-9604&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=9604%2E614464%2EZ5cuqv)**

body:
[](http://trk.2025battleground.com/?xtl=1apjtn1vd0n8m9xk97r0pflt1p376ggmilwj0gmwgj8hnu68vpih5nswxa80bn2guj36q4ga29d1ihxg9ol4238zf09weifjsojtdazgm3l30vvxqvld71i&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4gjfp&__onlt=h) [Mark as Spam](http://trk.2025battleground.com/?xul=t2p76x2ul3l184ws2kiv1kps6sviqd5yj3n8o1m1wdpuki61ttrohbnmk3xpeyikun1ndf2m7fgfrj1cb1jtekh02312fp6y1g9svh59bi&__stmp=t4gjfp&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh) | [Unsubscribe](http://trk.2025battleground.com/?xul=t2p76x2ul3l184ws2kiv1kps6sviqd5yj3n8o1m1wdpuki61ttrohbnmk3xpeyikun1ndf2m7fgfrj1cb1jtekh02312fp6y1g9svh59bi&__stmp=t4gjfp&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh)
---
Please read the message below from Turning Point USA.
* * *

| | | | [](http://trk.2025battleground.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4gjfp&__onlt=h)
---
Friend, Even now... it still doesn't feel real that we lost Charlie. His voice, his courage, his conviction — it shaped all of us. And his vision — **to build the most faithful and the most patriotic generation in American history** — is why Turning Point USA exists today. Friend, that's why we have an inspiring update for you... In just the first seven days since Charlie was taken from all of us, Turning Point USA has received more than 54,000 requests from students who want to start or join a chapter:
---
[](http://trk.2025battleground.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4gjfp&__onlt=h)
---
**God is so good.** ✝️🙏🕊️ To give you perspective, Friend... Coming into this school year, Turning Point USA had roughly 900+ college chapters and 1,200+ high school chapters. It took us years to build those chapters... over a decade in fact... _But now?_ These students who signed up? They weren't asked to... They weren't recruited... **They felt it was their time to stand up for this country and honor Charlie.** Because of the life he lived. The faith he had. The love he showed God, his family, and others. The courage he had to speak truth. And his vision of a better America for us all.
---
[](http://trk.2025battleground.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4gjfp&__onlt=h)
---
He always believed this day would come. He used to talk about it all the time — how the momentum would shift, how young people would rise up with courage, and how a Turning Point USA chapter would be in every college and high school in America. And now... _It's happening._ Faster than he could have imagined. Bigger than we thought possible. And more beautiful than we can even describe. **Again, Friend, God is so good.** Since we lost Charlie, we've also felt SO MUCH love... Prayers. Emails. Messages. Stories about how Charlie's voice changed lives... or your children's or grandchildren's lives. And so many supporters have asked, _"What can I do?"_ As you read this, our team is working around the clock to follow up with every chapter request. And we're going to need help equipping them with our activism kits. **Every new chapter receives these kits from Turning Point USA with everything they need to get started — including:** ✅ Leadership materials
✅ Pocket Constitutions
✅ Chapter training tools
✅ American flags & patriotic gear Friend, I'm sure you'd believe it when we say it... _this won't be a small task._ But we're going to do it. Whatever it takes. **_For Charlie._** _And here's how YOU can help with this..._ **Every $25 you give today helps stock another activism kit — ready to deploy into a new Turning Point USA student chapter...** How many of these activism kits can you help provide to the wave of new student chapters that are just getting started?
---
[ **1 KIT = $25**](http://trk.2025battleground.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4gjfp&__onlt=h)
---
[ **2 KITS = $50**](http://trk.2025battleground.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4gjfp&__onlt=h)
---
[ **10 KITS = $250**](http://trk.2025battleground.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4gjfp&__onlt=h)
---
[ **100 KITS = $2,500**](http://trk.2025battleground.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4gjfp&__onlt=h)
---
[ **1,000 KITS = $25,000**](http://trk.2025battleground.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4gjfp&__onlt=h)
---
[ **Sponsor Activism Kits**](http://trk.2025battleground.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4gjfp&__onlt=h)
---
Friend, if there was ever a more immediate way you could help make Charlie's vision a reality... **This is it****.**
---
[](http://trk.2025battleground.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4gjfp&__onlt=h)
---
Also... **Here's one more powerful thing you can do:** 📩 If you have a son, daughter, grandchild, niece, nephew — or any young person in your life — who wants to get involved... who wants to join or start a chapter... **Please send them this link:** **[TPUSAStudents.com/StartaChapter](http://trk.2025battleground.com/?xtl=u3vjmpooycjx3s46abkyf21juvh6knzkp0ewcm1r0lde7iikymu76sq875jlrq38fru0pw79mhp0dxcq0am08ievtwzbsq5myfh2s45yj1rzmgckj54nrlxnwc9hx9rchz0fz9voadju&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4gjfp&__onlt=h)** Friend, if you've already given... If you've already donated... If you've already been a voice of encouragement and strength in this painful week... If you've prayed, been praying, and continue to pray... **Thank you.** We can never say it enough. If you've read this far, we want you to know this... **You're the reason Charlie's mission and vision will grow for generations to come.** God is so good.
---
**For Charlie,** -The Turning Point USA Family **P.S.** Please know, Friend, if you can't afford to help right now, all we ask for are your prayers. Charlie would have wanted you to pray first — and if that's all you can give today, _we're grateful._ But if you're able to help... if you're overjoyed to hear that students are flocking to Charlie's message and mission... Your gift today helps sustain this wave of student inspiration and gets new student chapters off the ground floor... And ensures Charlie's vision is realized faster than we all thought possible. **Every $25 you give today helps us stock another activism kit ready to deploy to a new student chapter.**
---
[ **Sponsor an Activism Kit**
**Make Your Gift Here**](http://trk.2025battleground.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4gjfp&__onlt=h)
---
Thank you for your help and for your prayers, Friend. **God is so good.** 🙏
---

Phoenix, Arizona 85044

Every new chapter receives these kits from Turning Point USA with everything they need to get started — including: ✅ Leadership materials ✅ Pocket Constitutions ✅ Chapter training tools ✅ American flags & patriotic gear Friend, I'm sure you'd believe it when we say it... this won't be a small task. But we're going to do it. Whatever it takes. For Charlie. And here's how YOU can help with this... Every $25 you give today helps stock another activism kit — ready to deploy into a new Turning Point USA student chapter... How many of these activism kits can you help provide to the wave of new student chapters that are just getting started? Friend, if there was ever a more immediate way you could help make Charlie's vision a reality... This is it**. Also... Here's one more powerful thing you can do: 📩 If you have a son, daughter, grandchild, niece, nephew — or any young person in your life — who wants to get involved... who wants to join or start a chapter... Please send them this link: Friend, if you've already given... If you've already donated... If you've already been a voice of encouragement and strength in this painful week... If you've prayed, been praying, and continue to pray... Thank you. We can never say it enough. If you've read this far, we want you to know this... You're the reason Charlie's mission and vision will grow for generations to come. God is so good. For Charlie, -The Turning Point USA Family P.S. Please know, Friend, if you can't afford to help right now, all we ask for are your prayers. Charlie would have wanted you to pray first — and if that's all you can give today, we're grateful. But if you're able to help... if you're overjoyed to hear that students are flocking to Charlie's message and mission... Your gift today helps sustain this wave of student inspiration and gets new student chapters off the ground floor... And ensures Charlie's vision is realized faster than we all thought possible. Every $25 you give today helps us stock another activism kit ready to deploy to a new student chapter. Thank you for your help and for your prayers, Friend. ## Amazon Cloud Outage Disrupts Online Services
A massive [Amazon Web Services outage Monday](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFyhCAURb9GOxx4wLIWFGm227Qpnac8lQ3KjuAS8_UZM5MvSH_unXvPx727ow9-nd5xIZvH2K1UUqCcaetwwe-4DiHubtgwzZT6sNMDjw44aCY4A9E59OHoVO3sSAQka7LCXARXQmhZz1agIsCeX6gXV1DQUm-o11cjWyOlHmpvzzbBQQjOtYZGml4BgWlHh1y4oVKcnM9xax7Rr3mmMRzxRVszxKUOds75mSr5VsGtglsppTkvFKLPE6jghiWxuGeciOXo8GBzLCzEdWLFh8B8ZgFTZgPuiVgc_1j6egb0KzkmeMvNVet6s-55Zny6mErxaUEfflfkf6l7WfgJAAD___oog-0) disrupted banks, airlines, gaming networks, and smart-home devices worldwide, affecting thousands of companies. The failure knocked major platforms offline, including Snapchat, Fortnite, Venmo, Reddit, and Ring, along with Amazon’s own Alexa and shopping sites. The problem was traced to a failure in AWS’s network-monitoring system and DNS functions at its Virginia data hub, part of a global cloud network used by thousands of companies. Most services have since come back online, though some users are still seeing slow connections and login errors. The outage lasted several hours and caused widespread interruptions across the U.S. and beyond. | We're excited to invite you to the 2025 Campaign and Candidate Virtual Bootcamp Series, hosted in partnership with the Republican National Committee (RNC).
This series of training sessions are designed to equip you with the tools, strategies, and confidence to run a successful campaign and win. These trainings are designed for candidates running for office, campaign staff and volunteers who are involved or want to be involved in campaigns at any level, or those just wanting to learn the basics of running a political campaign. November 13, 2025 at 6pm - Training 4: Political - The Ground Game and Putting it All Together

After a UT Austin professor was [removed](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L_OozAQBPCnMZ0jezF_Uri4hi7XXokMXmAlw0b2Xkje_hN5ha8e6Tea-fcYH4ESHevfsKOX98LjgWdJKIJ5PEPOeOzzC0MOdEx8zplLOcMIBhptjQY7xkDpM7oq-snEu63Q2661xjnX9tXmO5hgcmhrY-YIC0Id--iwt6FZoIl1Rf7CrAFrrbGmvbllck3dNbHvZ2gjKmcwknC-yYaC71CW9OEX5tvMe5X8JvIsqv6jYFAwyIYbpXRlCoaNd7wGKRgw_p-DEB8KhqZpa1PfdZgmFtFfVM-cEq6on5kXLIVz0QkXoSKaInLilfCCquzj86SUqLSdcmbdA337Kvndgy8PPwEAAP__PqOHYw) from an administrative post over "ideological differences," Gov. Greg Abbott said that "_Texas is targeting professors who are more focused on pushing leftist ideologies rather than preparing students to lead our nation_." Abbott's Sunday [social media post](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0Duu4yAUgOHV4C4Rj8OroEjjqTLVSDMdAnOcIGETARMnu7_K3cJt_-Ir_r9Xfw255P32O2zoxmutfsejFxwDmz9Ca7hvyxNDC3mP9Vha7f0InlMuT4yeOPMp5PL2MCUXabJsQse0YhQAlJnuLkKMCowRYZVCgDAolF1SgJgsAyun7D4Yo5wxRhlVZ1gjSKFlMmbhKiEBiimP2s7jjgNfoa_lXZ_YzkvdpuLuYzw6ERfCZ8Ln16cSPv9qeLvEWMfwf_4RPvcRxv9O-MystlYKCmC1ltYoDVNz6XHkUnJXmgC9bSGXb3387MnT8a8AAAD__8q-cxE) shared an Axios article about Art Markman, a professor of psychology and marketing who was removed as senior vice provost for academic affairs in September. # Liberty-minded Healthcare Providers Across Texas
---
| |
---
| At Texans for Vaccine Choice, we know how important it is to have a healthcare provider who believes in patient-centered care: someone who listens, respects your choices, and supports true informed consent. That’s why TFVC has built a **secure database of medical professionals across Texas** who support vaccine choice and put patients first. In just the past two years, we’ve fielded **over 500 requests** for provider recommendations from pediatricians to family practitioners, specialists, and midwives. While we have a growing list in major metro areas, **we need your help expanding our reach** into rural, suburban, and smaller Texas towns. If you know a healthcare professional who should be added to our medical liberty database, please send us their **name, city, and specialty** to info@TexansForVaccineChoice.com or use the [Contact Us](https://xdzgmz.clicks.mlsend.com/tb/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyMDEyNjAsXCJsXCI6MTY4ODcyMDIwNTQ5ODI5NzY0LFwiclwiOjE2ODg3MjA4NDc3MDkxNTMzM30iLCJzIjoiYjNjNTliZThlNGQyMzE3MyJ9) button on our website. Your referrals help us grow this essential resource and connect more families with providers who truly respect their rights. _Together, we can strengthen our community and ensure every Texan has access to healthcare professionals who truly get it, with TFVC here to support you, **not just in policy, but in the everyday choices that protect your family’s health and freedom.**_

About PowerBank Corporation
PowerBank Corporation is an independent renewable and clean energy project developer and owner focusing on distributed and community solar projects in Canada and the USA. The Company develops solar and Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects that sell electricity to utilities, commercial, industrial, municipal and residential off-takers. The Company maximizes returns via a diverse portfolio of projects across multiple leading North America markets including projects with utilities, host off-takers, community solar, and virtual net metering projects. The Company has a potential development pipeline of over one gigawatt and has developed renewable and clean energy projects with a combined capacity of over 100 megawatts built. To learn more about PowerBank, please visit [powerbankcorp.com](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4hevm&__onlt=h).

Peter, I wanted you to be the first to know: **I’m running to continue serving as Minnesota’s Attorney General. **
As the People’s Lawyer, I’m fighting to help Minnesotans afford their lives and live with dignity, safety, and respect. And together, we’ve made real progress.
For the past seven years, I’ve fought for Minnesotans — holding corporations accountable, winning new protections for Minnesota workers and consumers, and cracking down on fraud, scams, and price gouging. When Donald Trump threatened our rights and cut vital programs, I took him to court and helped restore critical freedoms and funding to millions of Minnesotans.
But there’s more work to be done. Too many families are still struggling to make ends meet. Oligarchs, billionaires, and corporations are lining their own pockets at our expense. And Trump and his MAGA allies will continue attacking our shared values and the most vulnerable members of our communities.
**That’s why I’m running for reelection. But I can’t do it alone, Peter. **

**Ian Rowe** is one of the most courageous and insightful voices redefining how we think about success, opportunity, and responsibility in America. A senior fellow at the **American Enterprise Institute** , Ian focuses on education, upward mobility, family formation, and adoption -- issues at the very heart of our national renewal.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1f045fd7-2367-4e50-a950-b97b79e587fb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
He is the co-founder of **Vertex Partnership Academies** , a virtues-based International Baccalaureate high school in the Bronx, and the founder of the **National Summer School Initiative** , both created to expand real pathways of achievement for young people. His groundbreaking book, _Agency: The Four Point Plan (F.R.E.E.) for All Children to Overcome the Victimhood Narrative and Discover Their Pathway to Power_ , has inspired educators and parents across the country to move beyond blame and rediscover self-determination.
At **Seed & Roots 2025**, Ian will unpack how **family, religion, education, and entrepreneurship** form the moral fabric of a free society -- and why restoring these pillars is essential to building the next generation of capable, confident, and free Americans.

| | [ ]()
---
Peter, I’m a mom of four in a state where Leftist Lunatics repeatedly try to violate parental rights – and then brag about it (remember the school librarian I told you about a couple weeks ago who sued two bold moms for standing up against sexually explicit material and LOST?!). So to say I’m concerned about parental rights is an understatement. I’m fired up about it. And being part of the Common Sense Majority, I’m pretty sure most of you are too, whether you are currently parenting a minor child, you’re a grandparent, aunt or uncle, or you’re just a concerned citizen. Parental rights should matter to all of us because children are our future. It may be a cliche, but it’s true. Children were meant to be raised by parents and families, not indoctrinated and “guided” by bureaucrats and activists (groomers, really, if you ask me). _So, TOMORROW, get your voice ready._ **CALL IN to 101.5 FM between 6-10 AM EDT on Wednesday, 10/22 and**** _voice YOUR concerns about parental rights violations in New Jersey._** 101.5 will be talking about parental rights TOMORROW and wants to hear from you. It might be a story you’ve heard that the public needs to know. It might be a story you’ve _experienced personally_ that needs to be told. It might be that you just need to get off your chest why parental rights are important and tell the lunatics to back the heck off our kids!
---
****CALL 1-800-283-1015 between 6-10 AM EDT TOMORROW****
---
Let's get loud, Common Sense Majority! Our kids are worth it. For New Jersey, Elizabeth Nader

clean_body: Will you split a contribution between my campaign and State Democrats Committee to help me defeat Donald Trump's hand-picked candidate in the biggest election of 2025? Peter, I'm going to lay this out as clearly as I can: Donald Trump endorsed my opponent Winsome Earle-Sears late Sunday night. I'm the only Democrat running for Governor this year in a state controlled by Republicans, and I need each person reading this to join our donor list by midnight. It's urgent so that we can continue standing up to President Trump, turning out voters, and demonstrating the strength of this campaign. If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: This whole year, my opponent has spent more time groveling for Trump's endorsement than standing up for Virginia. In fact, Winsome admits that she met privately with Trump to plead for his support. This came at a time when the President was firing thousands of federal workers, driving up prices, and planning to cut funding for healthcare and public schools — actions which have devastated Virginia's economy and threatened the livelihoods of so many. It's clear that Winsome places her loyalty to Trump above everything else. Now, I'm using every tool at my disposal to make sure voters know the truth about Winsome. But we're in the heart of early voting now, and sharing our message on TV, at the doors, and over the internet is so incredibly expensive. So, can I count on your support today, Peter? Thank you for standing with me. Let's win this together. Abigail Spanberger Paid for by State Democrats Committee (StateDemocrats.com). _**The 2024 illegal power grab by the Democrat Controlled Board of Education is a warning sign of what a Democrat Controlled Greenwich would look like and why a conservative-run Greenwich is critical.**_
[ Pledge your support](https://substack..19KikuDBZFBwG4lMCoQzVw2aWReYr4n-ceTAiwnFzSQ?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=176737755)
On October 21, 2024 the Democrat controlled Board of Education (BOE) held what has been determined to be an **illegal meeting** where they appointed someone that they knew would support them to fill a vacancy on the Board of Education. _**First Selectman Fred Camillo called this "the mother of all power grabs."**_
The Selectman **legally appointed** someone else to fill the vacant position on the BOE. Yet, the BOE refused to seat the legally appointed BOE member and instead seated the BOE with their illegal replacement. _**The BOE then continued to conduct its business, including the extension of Superintendent Toni Jones ' contract prematurely, long before her existing contract was set to expire, probably due to this additional support that would not have existed at contract renewal time with the First Selectman's legally appointed replacement.**_
Legal cases were filed by the Board of Selectman, despite the objection of the Democrat Selectwoman Janet Stone-McGuigan. This turned what should have only been a legal battle against the BOE into a partisan battle of Democrat Selectwoman and Democrat controlled BOE against the Republican First Selectman.
The Board of Selectman with Ms. Stone-McGuigan objected and filed a complaint against the BOE with the Freedom of Information Commission ("FOIC"). They also filed for a restraining order against the BOE.
Members of the Greenwich RTM attempted to defund the First Selectman's legal fight to overturn the illegal action of the BOE.
[The following are the facts as outlined in the Connecticut Centinal](https://substack.com/redirect/8f5561bb-99a8-4e53-bb27-feeb098547be?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**" Here Are The Hearing Officer's Key Findings:**
* Sometime between October 17th and October 21st, the Greenwich Board of Selectmen (BOS) published notice of a remote special meeting for October 22nd at 9am for one thing: "Discussion and vote on Board of Education vacancy"; the meeting was ultimately scheduled for 3pm on October 22nd.
* On October 21st at 10:48am, the Democrats filed with the Greenwich Town Clerk public notice of a "remote emergency meeting" to be held **just 42 minutes later** that same day at 11:30am for the purpose of "filling of a Board vacancy (Policy [Bylaw] 9221)."
* The Town Clerk stamped the notice as "received" at 11:21 am, just 9 minutes before the emergency meeting was scheduled to convene.
* The Democrats did not provide notice of the meeting pursuant to CGS § 1-225(d), which Bylaw 9221 references.
* The Democrat-called October 21st emergency meeting had a quorum with five of seven BOE members present: the four Dems, along with republican Michael-Joseph Mercanti-Anthony.
* During the meeting it was found that Acting Chair Hirsh mentioned the "BOS noticed a special meeting for the following day to fill" the BOE vacancy and insisted that it was the Democrat-led board's "statutory responsibility to fill such vacancy" pursuant to CGS § 10-219.
* At the FOI hearings and in their brief, the Democrats alleged that the BOS was using Camillo's meeting to try to "interfere with" and "usurp" the Democrat-controlled board's "authority to fill a board vacancy in less than 24 hours."
* Camillo argued that the Democrats' reason for convening their October 21st meeting as an "emergency" didn't meet the meaning of CGS § 1-225(d) and that the meeting was illegal under the FOI Act; he further asserted that the BOS had full authority to fill the open BOE seat pursuant to CGS § 7-107.
* Under Connecticut Supreme Court Case Ridgefield v. FOIC, it was determined that an "emergency" must be "unexpected or unforeseen" and "must necessitate immediate action"; however, it was found that the Democrats' "predicament was not unexpected or unforeseen."
* Since Bylaw 9221 references CGS §§ 7-107 and 10-219, the Democrats "should have been aware of the significance of those statutes in relation to their duty to fill Ms. Kowalksi's vacancy."
* Plus, the need to dispense with standard notice of a special meeting was also avoidable had the Democrat-led board chosen to act during the 94 days between Ms. Kowalksi's departure and the special emergency meeting.
* As such, it was found that the meeting wasn't an "emergency" within CGS § 1-225(d).

Now, the FOIC can provide relief that it "believes appropriate to rectify the denial of any right conferred by the [act]" and that includes declaring any action "null and void" that was "taken at any meeting which a person was denied the right to attend."
It was also found that the Democrats "deprived the public of access to the appointment of an official who ... would otherwise have been elected to serve by the public."
It was further found that the Democrats did not act in good faith to comply with the notice requirements of the FOI Act with respect to the October 21st "emergency" meeting.
The Commission recognizes that nullification "may call into question the legality of any actions by the respondent board in which Ms. Behette's vote constituted a deciding vote."
Nonetheless the FOIC believes the "proper remedy" would be to "declare null and void the action taken" at the October 21st meeting, aka the "sham emergency meeting" where the Democrats attempted the coup."
Here is the Finding in their words:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/aa965834-56ad-4d61-bb9e-53021be92144?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The FOIC will issue the final ruling on October 22, 2025.
What is most significant and most frightening is the joint collaboration by the Democrat Selectwoman and the Democrat controlled BOE to block the legal challenge to what proved to be an illegal act of the BOE in violation of the meeting and notice requirement of Section 1-225(d) of the Connecticut General Statutes.
_**Is this what a Democrat controlled Greenwich would look like where a board, specifically the BOE, which controls over $200 million or over 40% of the total town budget, to engage in an illegal act and then do whatever they can to block a challenge to their illegal behavior.**_
**Greenwich voters must say no to such rogue action on the part of Greenwich Democrats by electing Republicans as**
**First Selectman (Fred Camillo)**
**Selectwoman (Lauren Rabin)**
**Town Clerk (Jackie Budkins)**
**Tax Collector (Heather Smeriglio)**
Remember it was First Selectman Fred Camillo and Selectwoman Lauren Rabin who stood up, fought and won the battle against illegal behavior by the Democrat controlled BOE. It was Selectwoman and Democrat Stone McGuigan who did not support the nullification of an illegal act by the BOE.
**It cannot be Rules for Thee and Not For Me - which is becoming the Democrat Mantra and its awful that this is completely on partisan lines.**
**Over $200 million dollars of the annual Greenwich budget is controlled by the BOE. Illegal actors should not be trusted to control the education of our children and how the budget is allocated.**
The remainder of the budget is controlled by the BET (Board of Estimate and Taxation). Here too we have a Republican tradition of responsible fiscal spending and keeping taxes low to make Greenwich as affordable as possible while spending more per pupil on education than any of our neighboring towns.
**Success should rewarded at the ballot box by voting for the Republican BET slate and Row B this November.**

" Here Are The Hearing Officer's Key Findings: Sometime between October 17th and October 21st, the Greenwich Board of Selectmen (BOS) published notice of a remote special meeting for October 22nd at 9am for one thing: "Discussion and vote on Board of Education vacancy"; the meeting was ultimately scheduled for 3pm on October 22nd. On October 21st at 10:48am, the Democrats filed with the Greenwich Town Clerk public notice of a "remote emergency meeting" to be held just 42 minutes later that same day at 11:30am for the purpose of "filling of a Board vacancy (Policy [Bylaw] 9221)." The Town Clerk stamped the notice as "received" at 11:21 am, just 9 minutes before the emergency meeting was scheduled to convene. The Democrats did not provide notice of the meeting pursuant to CGS § 1-225(d), which Bylaw 9221 references. The Democrat-called October 21st emergency meeting had a quorum with five of seven BOE members present: the four Dems, along with republican Michael-Joseph Mercanti-Anthony. During the meeting it was found that Acting Chair Hirsh mentioned the "BOS noticed a special meeting for the following day to fill" the BOE vacancy and insisted that it was the Democrat-led board's "statutory responsibility to fill such vacancy" pursuant to CGS § 10-219. At the FOI hearings and in their brief, the Democrats alleged that the BOS was using Camillo's meeting to try to "interfere with" and "usurp" the Democrat-controlled board's "authority to fill a board vacancy in less than 24 hours." Camillo argued that the Democrats' reason for convening their October 21st meeting as an "emergency" didn't meet the meaning of CGS § 1-225(d) and that the meeting was illegal under the FOI Act; he further asserted that the BOS had full authority to fill the open BOE seat pursuant to CGS § 7-107. Under Connecticut Supreme Court Case Ridgefield v. FOIC, it was determined that an "emergency" must be "unexpected or unforeseen" and "must necessitate immediate action"; however, it was found that the Democrats' "predicament was not unexpected or unforeseen." Since Bylaw 9221 references CGS §§ 7-107 and 10-219, the Democrats "should have been aware of the significance of those statutes in relation to their duty to fill Ms. Kowalksi's vacancy." Plus, the need to dispense with standard notice of a special meeting was also avoidable had the Democrat-led board chosen to act during the 94 days between Ms. Kowalksi's departure and the special emergency meeting. As such, it was found that the meeting wasn't an "emergency" within CGS § 1-225(d). Now, the FOIC can provide relief that it "believes appropriate to rectify the denial of any right conferred by the [act]" and that includes declaring any action "null and void" that was "taken at any meeting which a person was denied the right to attend." It was also found that the Democrats "deprived the public of access to the appointment of an official who ... would otherwise have been elected to serve by the public." It was further found that the Democrats did not act in good faith to comply with the notice requirements of the FOI Act with respect to the October 21st "emergency" meeting. The Commission recognizes that nullification "may call into question the legality of any actions by the respondent board in which Ms. Behette's vote constituted a deciding vote." Nonetheless the FOIC believes the "proper remedy" would be to "declare null and void the action taken" at the October 21st meeting, aka the "sham emergency meeting" where the Democrats attempted the coup." Here is the Finding in their words: | | ---|---|--- The FOIC will issue the final ruling on October 22, 2025. What is most significant and most frightening is the joint collaboration by the Democrat Selectwoman and the Democrat controlled BOE to block the legal challenge to what proved to be an illegal act of the BOE in violation of the meeting and notice requirement of Section 1-225(d) of the Connecticut General Statutes. Is this what a Democrat controlled Greenwich would look like where a board, specifically the BOE, which controls over $200 million or over 40% of the total town budget, to engage in an illegal act and then do whatever they can to block a challenge to their illegal behavior. Greenwich voters must say no to such rogue action on the part of Greenwich Democrats by electing Republicans as First Selectman (Fred Camillo) Selectwoman (Lauren Rabin) Town Clerk (Jackie Budkins) Tax Collector (Heather Smeriglio) Remember it was First Selectman Fred Camillo and Selectwoman Lauren Rabin who stood up, fought and won the battle against illegal behavior by the Democrat controlled BOE. It was Selectwoman and Democrat Stone McGuigan who did not support the nullification of an illegal act by the BOE. It cannot be Rules for Thee and Not For Me - which is becoming the Democrat Mantra and its awful that this is completely on partisan lines. Over $200 million dollars of the annual Greenwich budget is controlled by the BOE. Illegal actors should not be trusted to control the education of our children and how the budget is allocated. The remainder of the budget is controlled by the BET (Board of Estimate and Taxation). Here too we have a Republican tradition of responsible fiscal spending and keeping taxes low to make Greenwich as affordable as possible while spending more per pupil on education than any of our neighboring towns. Success should rewarded at the ballot box by voting for the Republican BET slate and Row B this November.** EARLY VOTING IS GOING ON NOW! The Goldstein Substack is free today. Peter,
My opponent Lauren Boebert would have you believe that this weekend's No Kings protests were terrorist rallies, that we rioted, and that the goal was to sow fear and promote violence.
On Saturday I attended rallies across Colorado's 4th Congressional district, in Parker, Windsor, Loveland, and Highlands Ranch. Here's what I actually saw:
Families with strollers. Veterans carrying American flags. Teachers, nurses, students -- people who love this country -- standing together to say that no one, not even a President, is above the law.
---
| [](https://t7pkg9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001CNpgABG368O3tgzS2dMZSEn00yGHkuJY2oDpoHK4cS2VBbZUYwrqr3T9JIAsC5_uBjMFWx3Z0vQFd2ejwN5S_eacYLMN03J_Z_OmjUdYy6V-4-1LX7Z0h9ZkKMLNOPFyYWxxakJh9NpjGCSSGGG75KGC4DOkm7CI-1P61gMrlneAjAuM-3qi4SPJkm2wiWcq_B94YkksrDPD2CCALFtFDY_6VF29upgQ&c=R4kydJfKrVciLfURNZmbCkiZewiYk-eEddfeti4sj1LYeyVVTsyeZA==&ch=5OcYgwnwTUx1A8Z-1n36asVA9aQXDKsTQo2ENnnkcjhUJLN4ZvNN6A==)
---
We weren't there to spread chaos. We were there to exercise Constitutional rights.
But Lauren Boebert can't stand that. She wants you to believe that if you exercise your right to speech, assembly and stand up for equality, for truth, for accountability -- you're the enemy.
It's why she and the administration are pushing Saudi Arabia-style restrictions like NSPM-7 that could get you surveilled or even thrown in jail on counter-terrorism charges for something as simple as attending a No Kings rally.
Coloradans deserve a representative who sees her constituents as neighbors, not enemy combatants. Unfortunately that's how Boebert views us. We need to take away her platform before we see how far she'll take this.
In 2024 I had the best performance a Democrat has ever had in this district whereas Boebert massively underperformed Trump in every county. Now I'm back to finish the job. If you're with me, I need your help to take this message to every corner of this massive district.
[Will you please make a monthly contribution of whatever you can afford to help us continue to rapidly scale our campaign to defeat Boebert, flip Colorado's 4th, and take back the House for Democrats?](https://t7pkg9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001CNpgABG368O3tgzS2dMZSEn00yGHkuJY2oDpoHK4cS2VBbZUYwrqr3T9JIAsC5_uBjMFWx3Z0vQFd2ejwN5S_eacYLMN03J_Z_OmjUdYy6V-4-1LX7Z0h9ZkKMLNOPFyYWxxakJh9NpjGCSSGGG75KGC4DOkm7CI-1P61gMrlneAjAuM-3qi4SPJkm2wiWcq_B94YkksrDNUAKhZ-U49zxMqiY_fmaa7&c=R4kydJfKrVciLfURNZmbCkiZewiYk-eEddfeti4sj1LYeyVVTsyeZA==&ch=5OcYgwnwTUx1A8Z-1n36asVA9aQXDKsTQo2ENnnkcjhUJLN4ZvNN6A==)

Hey Peter,
We’re 21 days into the government shutdown, and Americans are paying the price. Meanwhile, Republicans are focused on one thing: cutting the guardrails that keep our democracy intact.
Donald Trump and his cronies are using this crisis to let go of dedicated public servants who’ve spent their careers protecting our air, water, and essential programs. In what feels like a perfect metaphor, the people who help land our planes safely are getting sidelined and going without their full pay...making travel unsafe for everyone.
All the while, the Secretary of Homeland Security Kristi Noem is spreading her airport propaganda, a video at security checkpoints where she blames Democrats for a shutdown while Republicans control the government at every level: the House, Senate, Supreme Court, and presidency. Their goal is clear: dismantle the programs that protect and feed our families.
Movement for Freedom is here to lift up our stories, fuel our collective fire, and make sure no one feels alone in this struggle. But we can only do it together.
We exist to build grassroots power strong enough to fight back. But to meet this moment, we need resources to organize, train, and mobilize.

The mad passions of a hunted animal stirred within him, and he loathed the man who was seated at the table, more than in his whole life he had ever loathed anything. He glanced wildly around. Something glimmered on the top of the painted chest that faced him. His eye fell on it. He knew what it was. It was a knife that he had brought up, some days before, to cut a piece of cord, and had forgotten to take away with him. He moved slowly towards it, passing Hallward as he did so. As soon as he got behind him, he seized it and turned round. Hallward stirred in his chair as if he was going to rise. He rushed at him and dug the knife into the great vein that is behind the ear, crushing the man’s head down on the table and stabbing again and again. There was a stifled groan and the horrible sound of some one choking with blood. Three times the outstretched arms shot up convulsively, waving grotesque, stiff-fingered hands in the air. He stabbed him twice more, but the man did not move. Something began to trickle on the floor. He waited for a moment, still pressing the head down. Then he threw the knife on the table, and listened. He could hear nothing, but the drip, drip on the threadbare carpet. He opened the door and went out on the landing. The house was absolutely quiet. No one was about. For a few seconds he stood bending over the balustrade and peering down into the black seething well of darkness. Then he took out the key and returned to the room, locking himself in as he did so. The thing was still seated in the chair, straining over the table with bowed head, and humped back, and long fantastic arms. Had it not been for the red jagged tear in the neck and the clotted black pool that was slowly widening on the table, one would have said that the man was simply asleep. How quickly it had all been done! He felt strangely calm, and walking over to the window, opened it and stepped out on the balcony. The wind had blown the fog away, and the sky was like a monstrous peacock’s tail, starred with myriads of golden eyes. He looked down and saw the policeman going his rounds and flashing the long beam of his lantern on the doors of the silent houses. The crimson spot of a prowling hansom gleamed at the corner and then vanished. A woman in a fluttering shawl was creeping slowly by the railings, staggering as she went. Now and then she stopped and peered back. Once, she began to sing in a hoarse voice. The policeman strolled over and said something to her. She stumbled away, laughing. A bitter blast swept across the square. The gas-lamps flickered and became blue, and the leafless trees shook their black iron branches to and fro. He shivered and went back, closing the window behind him.

Ivan Dmytrovych Sirko was born in the early seventeenth century, approximately between 1605 and 1610. This is evidenced primarily by the results of research on Sirko's remains, according to which the Cossack ataman was 70-75 years old at the time of his death in 1680. The first researcher of Sirko's biography, the famous Ukrainian historian Dmytro Yavornytskyi, suggested that the future ataman was born in Sloboda Ukraine in the settlement of Merefa (now the city of Merefa, Kharkiv region). However, this is not true. Merefa was founded only in 1658, i.e. when Sirko was in his late teens. However, Sirko and his family lived in Merefa for a long time in his house, and after his death, his wife and some family members lived there. The fact that Merefa in Slobozhanshchyna is associated with the name of the Cossack Ataman is evidenced by another name for the town recorded in some Ukrainian chronicles, Sirkivka. Where, then, should we look for Sirko's homeland? In our opinion, the sources give grounds to localize it in Eastern Podillia, namely in the Vinnytsia region. It is worth recalling that Sirko was a colonel in Vinnytsia (Kalnytsia) in 1658-1660. As you know, at that time in Ukraine, people who came from the local area were usually elected to such positions. Let us also recall a letter from Hetman of the Left Bank Ukraine Ivan Samoilovych to the tsarist voivode Prince G. Romodanovsky of April 20, 1675*, which recounts (in Russian) Sirko's own words: "And since I was born among the Poles, I want to die there." Thus, it is clear that Sirko was born on the Ukrainian lands that were under the rule of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, not Muscovy (the latter included Slobozhanshchyna). The historian Volodymyr Borysenko's assumption that Sirko's birthplace was the hundred-man town of the Bratslav regiment Murafa, a few kilometers from Kalnyk, is correct. Now it is the village of Zhdanov, Vinnytsia region. By the way, Murafa in the Slobozhanshchyna probably originated from this Murafa, because immigrants from the Right Bank of Ukraine to the Left Bank often gave the newly founded settlements the names of their native villages or towns. It is also worth noting Sirko's great interest in Keleberda, which he founded in 1675 on the left bank of the Dnipro. For a long time, he sought from the Moscow tsar the right to own this town or sloboda, as well as the strategically important crossing of the Dnipro near Perevolochna (Sirko wanted this crossing not for himself, but for the entire Zaporozhian Lowland Army). Contrary to popular belief, we believe that Sirko did not come from a Cossack family, but from a small Ukrainian Orthodox gentry. For example, we know the name of a Podillia nobleman, Voytekh Sirko, who was married to a certain Olena Kozynska. Sources mention them in 1592. It is possible that they were relatives of the Cossack leader. Perhaps it is no coincidence that the kings of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, writing to Sirko, called him "urodzon." The word "nobleman" evokes negative associations for many people due to stereotypes instilled in school textbooks of the Stalinist era. However, this approach is not always correct. The term "nobleman" is identical to the words "knight," "chevalier," "nobleman," etc. and was commonly used not only in Poland but also in Ukraine, Belarus, and the Czech Republic. If scholars in Russia, Poland, and the Czech Republic, having contracted vulgar sociologism, no longer accuse Pushkin or Bunin, Suvorov or Kutuzov, Žižka or Kostiushko of being of noble or gentry origin, why have attacks on the Ukrainian and Belarusian gentry continued until recently? Is it not because in this way the imperial "divide and conquer" was transferred to our long-suffering history? Was it not because it was necessary to impose a nihilistic attitude toward the history of Ukraine, to "prove" that Ukrainians or Belarusians were just dark labor without national consciousness, ethnographic material doomed to build other people's empires? Meanwhile, the Ukrainian gentry produced many outstanding sons of Ukraine, fighters for its freedom. Suffice it to mention the names of Kryshtof Kosinski, Petro Konashevych-Sahaidachny, Ivan Sulyma, Ivan Mazepa, Bohdan Khmelnytsky, and his associates: Ivan and Danylo Vyhovsky, Ivan Bohun, Danylo and Ivan Nechai, Mykhailo Krychevsky, Jan Sokolovsky, Siluyan Muzhylovsky, and others. Sirko's appearance and personality do not always coincide with the conventional ideas about him that have developed in some works of art. The Cossack leader was slightly taller than average (174-176 cm), had regular facial features, and a straight nose. By the way, the great Relin intuitively caught this when he depicted him in the center of his painting "Cossacks Writing a Letter to the Turkish Sultan." It is interesting that the prototype for Sirko's image in the painting was the famous military leader General Dragomirov. Only one significant detail was not known to Repin and his consultant D. Yavornytskyi - a red birthmark on Sirko's lower lip on the right side. His contemporaries considered it a "sign of God" given to distinguish him from ordinary people. The Grand Hetman of the Crown, the future King of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, Jan Sobieski, who knew Sirko well and met him in Bratslav in 1671.

By the way, Murafa in the Slobozhanshchyna probably originated from this Murafa, because immigrants from the Right Bank of Ukraine to the Left Bank often gave the newly founded settlements the names of their native villages or towns. It is also worth noting Sirko's great interest in Keleberda, which he founded in 1675 on the left bank of the Dnipro. For a long time, he sought from the Moscow tsar the right to own this town or sloboda, as well as the strategically important crossing of the Dnipro near Perevolochna (Sirko wanted this crossing not for himself, but for the entire Zaporozhian Lowland Army). Contrary to popular belief, we believe that Sirko did not come from a Cossack family, but from a small Ukrainian Orthodox gentry. For example, we know the name of a Podillia nobleman, Voytekh Sirko, who was married to a certain Olena Kozynska. Sources mention them in 1592. It is possible that they were relatives of the Cossack leader. Perhaps it is no coincidence that the kings of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, writing to Sirko, called him "urodzon." The word "nobleman" evokes negative associations for many people due to stereotypes instilled in school textbooks of the Stalinist era. However, this approach is not always correct. The term "nobleman" is identical to the words "knight," "chevalier," "nobleman," etc. and was commonly used not only in Poland but also in Ukraine, Belarus, and the Czech Republic. If scholars in Russia, Poland, and the Czech Republic, having contracted vulgar sociologism, no longer accuse Pushkin or Bunin, Suvorov or Kutuzov, Žižka or Kostiushko of being of noble or gentry origin, why have attacks on the Ukrainian and Belarusian gentry continued until recently? Is it not because in this way the imperial "divide and conquer" was transferred to our long-suffering history? Was it not because it was necessary to impose a nihilistic attitude toward the history of Ukraine, to "prove" that Ukrainians or Belarusians were just dark labor without national consciousness, ethnographic material doomed to build other people's empires? Meanwhile, the Ukrainian gentry produced many outstanding sons of Ukraine, fighters for its freedom. Suffice it to mention the names of Kryshtof Kosinski, Petro Konashevych-Sahaidachny, Ivan Sulyma, Ivan Mazepa, Bohdan Khmelnytsky, and his associates: Ivan and Danylo Vyhovsky, Ivan Bohun, Danylo and Ivan Nechai, Mykhailo Krychevsky, Jan Sokolovsky, Siluyan Muzhylovsky, and others. Sirko's appearance and personality do not always coincide with the conventional ideas about him that have developed in some works of art. The Cossack leader was slightly taller than average (174-176 cm), had regular facial features, and a straight nose. By the way, the great Relin intuitively caught this when he depicted him in the center of his painting "Cossacks Writing a Letter to the Turkish Sultan." It is interesting that the prototype for Sirko's image in the painting was the famous military leader General Dragomirov. Only one significant detail was not known to Repin and his consultant D. Yavornytskyi - a red birthmark on Sirko's lower lip on the right side. His contemporaries considered it a "sign of God" given to distinguish him from ordinary people. name: Justin Riemer - RITE President
subject: RITE Demands Proof of Citizenship for Voter Registration
body:
States are relying on a broken ‘trust but don’t verify’ system for registering voters |
---
| |
---
| | **RITE Demands Proof of Citizenship for Voter Registration**
_Calls on EAC to End Honor System and Empower States to Enforce Citizen-Only Voting_
**WASHINGTON, DC** – Restoring Integrity and Trust in Elections (“RITE”), a non-profit organization dedicated to protecting election integrity, is [urging](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=50dec215c1&e=ea91f782ea) the United States Election Assistance Commission (EAC) to amend the National Mail Voter Registration Form to require documentary proof of citizenship (“DPOC”) from individuals registering to vote.

RITE is supporting a rulemaking petition filed by America First Legal Foundation that requests the EAC modify its regulations and the federal registration form—used by nearly every state—to include a DPOC requirement. RITE’s comment explains that the EAC possesses the authority to make this change because providing documentary proof is necessary for state election officials to properly assess a registrant’s eligibility. The federal form currently requires only a simple attestation of citizenship.

RITE’s comment emphasizes that the need for reform is far greater today than when Congress enacted the National Voter Registration Act (NVRA) in 1993, which created the federal form. Since then, the noncitizen population has grown exponentially, while the current honor system has enabled the registration of thousands of noncitizens in recent years, including many who have voted.

“States are relying on a broken ‘trust but don’t verify’ system for registering voters,” said RITE President Justin Riemer. “The EAC’s registration form ties the hands of states trying to ensure that only citizens register and vote. That must change. RITE urges the EAC to give states the tools they need to ensure citizen-only voting.”

RITE has been a national leader in advancing citizen-only voting. The organization has filed briefs supporting President Trump’s Executive Order directing the EAC to require proof of citizenship on the national registration form, sued cities that extended voting rights to noncitizens in local elections, and taken legal action in North Carolina and Arizona to stop overseas noncitizen voting. RITE has also litigated to uphold laws requiring states to verify voter eligibility at the point of registration. ###

body:
I learned a simple lesson in the Navy: You put the mission first, you put others before yourself. I hold that same belief today, and it guides my work in Congress.
Peter,
Growing up right here in Western PA, I learned the values we all know: hard work, service, love of country. Those values shaped who I am.
Stepping up after this country was attacked on 9/11 was an easy choice for me because of those values.
I went off to the Naval Academy at 17 years old to serve my country. I was commissioned as an active-duty naval officer, and led Americans at sea and in Iraq.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/96729?refcode=em20251021-9589&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=9589%2E614464%2EXdgsqB)
Two deployments at sea and a tour on the ground in Iraq shaped who I am and my worldview, and strengthened my love of country and my love of Western Pennsylvania.
I learned a simple lesson in the Navy: "Ship, Shipmate, Self." You put the mission first, you put others before yourself. I hold that same belief today, and it guides my work in Congress.
But in Washington, I see politicians acting, instead, like a bunch of corrupt, corporate bootlickers.
You’ve got the VA Secretary saying the planned firing of 80,000 VA workers won’t hurt veteran care. You’ve got Elon Musk accessing *your* private data and calling Social Security benefits a “Ponzi scheme.” You’ve got the Trump administration push to slash Medicaid and hand more tax giveaways to the ultra-wealthy.
They’re gutting the programs hardworking families rely on, turning their backs on veterans, and raiding government resources—all to line the pockets of billionaires and corporate elites.
Peter, I don’t know about you, but those aren’t the values I was raised with in Western PA.
I learned to fight for what matters, to stand by the people who have my back, and to never walk away from a fight that needs fighting. And I’m sure as hell not backing down now.

clean_body: I learned a simple lesson in the Navy: You put the mission first, you put others before yourself. I hold that same belief today, and it guides my work in Congress. Peter, Growing up right here in Western PA, I learned the values we all know: hard work, service, love of country. Those values shaped who I am. Stepping up after this country was attacked on 9/11 was an easy choice for me because of those values. I went off to the Naval Academy at 17 years old to serve my country. I was commissioned as an active-duty naval officer, and led Americans at sea and in Iraq. Two deployments at sea and a tour on the ground in Iraq shaped who I am and my worldview, and strengthened my love of country and my love of Western Pennsylvania. I learned a simple lesson in the Navy: "Ship, Shipmate, Self." You put the mission first, you put others before yourself. I hold that same belief today, and it guides my work in Congress. But in Washington, I see politicians acting, instead, like a bunch of corrupt, corporate bootlickers. You’ve got the VA Secretary saying the planned firing of 80,000 VA workers won’t hurt veteran care. You’ve got Elon Musk accessing your private data and calling Social Security benefits a “Ponzi scheme.” You’ve got the Trump administration push to slash Medicaid and hand more tax giveaways to the ultra-wealthy. They’re gutting the programs hardworking families rely on, turning their backs on veterans, and raiding government resources—all to line the pockets of billionaires and corporate elites. Peter, I don’t know about you, but those aren’t the values I was raised with in Western PA. I learned to fight for what matters, to stand by the people who have my back, and to never walk away from a fight that needs fighting. And I’m sure as hell not backing down now. * * *
I was thinking yesterday about how everything in the MAGA movement is projection. Full-on, textbook projection.
They've spent the last couple of days ranting about how the No Kings protests were dangerous, anti-American rallies meant to incite violence. You and I both know that's bullshit. I was at the No Kings rally in Chicago--it was joyful, patriotic, and packed with people who love this country enough to stand up to fascists.
And I kept thinking: the real "hate America" rally already happened. It was on January 6th, 2021, when Donald Trump incited his followers to violently assault police officers while trying to overturn a fair election. (And let's not forget: one of Trump's first acts after re-taking the presidency was to pardon those same cop-beaters--one of whom was just arrested again for threatening to kill Hakeem Jeffries.)
It's a pattern. Republicans accuse Democrats of things Republicans have already done or desperately want to do themselves.
For four years, they've screamed about "lawfare," about being politically persecuted. In reality, they were just being held accountable for their crimes. Donald Trump is a convicted felon because he defrauded the state of New York. Roger Stone. Steve Bannon. The list goes on. These guys are criminals, full stop. They were being prosecuted by the justice system--because no one is supposed to be above the law.
Is the system perfect? No. But at least it was generally working.
So what do Republicans do when they get power back? After all their whining about lawfare? Trump guts the FBI. Guts the DOJ. Then turns around and orders them to go after his political enemies.
Adam Schiff. James Comey. Tish James. John Bolton. Anyone who's ever crossed Trump or poses a threat to him--they're all targets now.
If an FBI agent refuses to perp-walk Comey? Fired. If a DOJ prosecutor says, "We don't have the evidence to charge Tish James"? Gone. Replaced with loyalists--cronies with no experience who'll follow orders.
And the truth is, most of these cases will get tossed by judges. They'll end in not-guilty verdicts--because they're not real. They're fake. They're show trials meant to punish and distract.
* * *

* * *
And Trump doesn't care. He just wants to flex his power, settle scores, and bleed his opponents dry--of time, money, and energy. That's the whole game.
And it doesn't stop there. Republicans scream that Democrats are canceling free speech, stifling dissent. Meanwhile, Trump threatens ABC with FCC action to get Jimmy Kimmel off the air. He goes after Harvard because it's not "pro-Trump" enough. He attacks any institution that isn't bending the knee.
They say Democrats want to destroy American traditions and institutions. But through Project 2025 and every blueprint MAGA has laid out, it's _them_ who are tearing it all down--piece by piece.
They accuse Democrats of protecting predators. And yet--they're the ones shielding the Epstein files because Trump's name is all over them. They literally shut down the government to block Adelita Grijalva from being sworn in--because when she is, she will cast the deciding vote to release those files.
And don't get me started on the TMZ report yesterday that Trump is preparing to commute Diddy's sentence as soon as this week.
Who's protecting pedophiles? Them.
It's all projection.
And it makes you wonder--what else is projection? What other shit are they flinging at us that's actually a confession?
We know they want to rig the midterms. They've basically said it out loud.
Trump is replacing election integrity officials with loyalists. All over the country, he and J.D. Vance are pushing for aggressive gerrymandering--in the middle of the decade. They're not even pretending anymore.
Look at what happened in Texas. They're terrified. Terrified that Americans will hold them accountable for what they've done--for gutting this economy and screwing over tens of millions of working-class people.
They know they can't win fairly. They've admitted it. So they're rigging it.
Again: projection, projection, projection, projection.
The good news is, they're not subtle. We can see what's coming. We can prepare.
We just have to take them seriously. Take their words seriously. Take their actions seriously. And use all of it--all of it--to educate the public, rally our people, and work with local election officials to defend democracy at the ground level.
We've got to be smart right now. About how we fight for our communities. About how we show up for each other. Because if we do that--if we stay focused--we can win the midterms. We can start steering this thing back. We can block the fascists from reaching their endgame--whatever the hell that is.
I've said it before and I'll keep saying it: it's more important to watch what Trump _does_ than what he _says_. That's always been true.
He says a lot of dumb shit. Most of it's noise. Distraction. Like that AI meme over the weekend where he was literally dumping feces all over America and, weirdly, Harry Sisson? Like--what?
So yeah, ignore the stupid stuff. But never forget: the loudest, most furious accusations? Nine times out of ten, they're projections.
And don't ever let them make you afraid to be part of something as righteous and joyful as the No Kings protest. That was one of the most patriotic things I've seen in the ten months since Trump clawed his way back into office.
And that protest was just the beginning.
There will be more No Kings protests. More resistance. More chances to fight back. And every time we show up together, we get a little closer to turning this around.
Stay in the fight. Do what you can. Figure out how to be useful.
And for the love of God, take care of yourself.

Peter,
I’m Dr. Nila Devanath - a hospital doctor running for Congress in Virginia’s 2nd District.
Every day, I see what happens when Washington fails to act. Families forced to cut their medication in half to make it last. Veterans waiting months for care because the VA is overstretched. People skipping checkups because they’re terrified of the bills that will come next.
I refuse to stay silent while politicians like Donald Trump and Jen Kiggans make the situation worse.
Taking back Virginia’s 2nd District is crucial to taking the House back for Democrats and making progress on the issues affecting our communities. Will you join me in this fight for a better future by splitting a donation between Real Texas PAC and my campaign right now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-nila?refcode=102125_1]

| | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117700561/577347995/623074613?refcode=jtk1424-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM3OTQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOGM2OWMyOWItOGVhZS1mMDExLThlNjEtNjA0NWJkZWQ4YmE0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=h-IJPgwkpCVz9Mks_12K_t6J3LVIhs_-2IwnFMvXz4c=&emci=bae62993-02ae-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=8c69c29b-8eae-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=9329426)
---
Hello friend,

This weekend, thousands in Hartford, New London, Willimantic, Granby, Westport, Windsor, and across our great state and nation stood together under one message: We are Americans. **We want no thrones, no crowns, no kings.**
From veterans, to young families, to first-generation Americans, I spoke to many in the crowds who shared the same conviction: Our democracy does not now and will _never_ belong to one person. It belongs to _all of us._
These protests were not simply a vocal moment – they were a statement of presence. And a statement of resistance. We will not be silent in the face of the creeping consolidation of power, the cessation of our typical checks and balances, or the policies that threaten what should be non-negotiable: healthcare, civil rights, and an honest and trustworthy government.
In Hartford alone, over 12,000 people turned out in a peaceful and lawful demonstration that is firmly rooted in our First Amendment right to gather. As your senator, I saw you. I heard you. And I’m doubling down on the work we must do: continuing to defend the programs that the current administration deems unnecessary, in spite of the millions of Americans who rely on them; standing up for the rule of law as this Department of Justice politicizes and weaponizes that great agency; ensuring that the phrase our nation’s founding document begins with still means something – _“We the People.”_
The challenge ahead of us is great, but the strength of community can be greater. While I fight on the floors of Washington, I need your help to fight in your daily lives to protect the very foundation of our democracy. Together, we can prove once again that America is strongest when its people stand united and unafraid, even in its darkest moments.
In service,

Dick

Many teens and young adults struggle with anxiety and depression. What their parents don't know is that those mental health
challenges can have spiritual root causes.

Dr. Natalie Atwell has an intense desire to find biblical answers to mental health concerns. She currently leads a private
counseling practice in Charlotte, North Carolina, and is an adjunct faculty member at Liberty University. She is an author and the
creator of Mental Warrior Courses focused on “Weird Influences of Mental Health." Listen for her insight on helping the teens in
your life. Like, subscribe and share.

Over the past decade, teens across the U.S. have faced a sharp rise in mental health challenges. While some point to smartphones

clear: moms must stay attuned to their children's emotional and mental well-being. That means noticing persistent changes in
behavior, or expressions of hopelessness, and being present when it matters most. This week, we'll explore warning signs and

Team: The reaction to last weekend's mass protests show just how eager the MAGA movement is to silence anyone who disagrees with them. Their constant refrain when asked about Americans using freedom of speech to articulate dissent was to say the protestors "hate America." That couldn't be farther from the truth.
Make your voice heard right now and tell Congress to act before Trump's punitive memo can be used to silence protests and clamp down on dissent >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/a-new-federal-memo-could-silence-dissent-tell-congress-to-act?source=direct_link&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]

Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Folks,
On September 25, 2025, the President released National Security Presidential Memorandum-7 (NSPM-7), titled “ Countering Domestic Terrorism and Organized Political Violence .” This memo contains broad and vague language that could allow government agencies to monitor or penalize individuals and groups based on their beliefs rather than their actions.
Terms like “anti-American,” “anti-capitalist,” and “anti-Christian” are so loosely defined that peaceful advocacy organizations, religious communities, or critics of government policy could be subject to investigation—even if they have no connection to violence of any kind. In our current political environment, it means partisan finger-pointing and extremism can be elevated from a difference of opinion to political retribution and punishment with no due process.
This raises serious constitutional questions about freedom of speech, religion, and association. It is essential that elected officials provide oversight before this policy is implemented further.
Call on Congress today to let them know that our right to free speech must be protected no matter who is in control of our government >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/a-new-federal-memo-could-silence-dissent-tell-congress-to-act?source=direct_link&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]

subject: The Texas Constitution says “shall” not “maybe”
disclaimer_text: paid for by Joe Jaworski Campaign
body:
You know it in your head, heart, and bones — that “suitable funding” is not happening. Our public schools have been defunded for decades. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/jaworskifortexas.com/fed-up-14189983?e=5d8d80652b)
---
| | [ ](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=d6432e357b&e=5d8d80652b)
---
| | , Texas Constitution, Article 7 says: “A general diffusion of knowledge being essential to the preservation of the liberties and rights of the people, it shall be the duty of the Legislature of the State to establish and make suitable provision for the support and maintenance of an efficient system of public free schools." **Keywords: Shall. Duty. Legislature. Suitable provision. Support. Maintenance. Efficient. Public. Free.** You know in your head, heart and bones that suitable funding isn’t happening. In fact, we’re been defunding and malnourishing our public schools for decades. And now, state leaders want to drain even more money out of the system for private school vouchers. **That’s not just bad policy. It’s unconstitutional.** The Texas Constitution is a promise to our people. When politicians break that promise, someone has to hold them accountable. **Sounds like a lawsuit to me.** I’m Joe Jaworski, and I’m running for Texas Attorney General to fight for Texas families, Texas teachers, and Texas students. Our Constitution demands it. [**If you believe in defending public education and the rule of law, stand with me today.**](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=7af8ff0661&e=5d8d80652b) Onward,

| | Stop scrolling, wake up, and don't miss this moment! We're living in strange times, dark times, but times appointed for each and every one of us. Today's podcast comes from my sermon to The Cure Church in St. Louis, titled _Stop Scrolling, Don't Miss The Moment._ The world prioritizes popularity, follower count, and fitting in the world. God has a plan and purpose for each and every one of us. But the distractions of life are causing far too many believers to miss it. Today's podcast comes from my sermon to The Cure Church in St. Louis, titled Stop Scrolling, Don't Miss The Moment. The world prioritizes popularity, follower count, and fitting in the world. | Peter,
There are now only two weeks left until the most critical election of 2025 for Democrats--the November 4th PA Supreme Court retention election.
The stakes of this race are existential for Democrats.
If MAGA and Trump succeed in toppling the Democratic majority on the PA Supreme Court, they will gain control over the court responsible for how elections are run in the most important swing state in America. This will allow Trump to rig the upcoming '26 & '28 elections--denying Democrats a midterm victory and control of the White House for at least a decade.
Since earlier this summer, Defend Our Courts has been one of the leading Democratic organizations spearheading the defense of this critical court, and we have since rallied tens of thousands of Democrats to come to PA's aid.
Now with only two weeks to go, we are preparing our final surge--one last hail mary to try and prevent MAGA from seizing the court and Democracy from falling:

**Christine Flowers** is a lifelong Philadelphian, who has a deep attachment to the region. She has been practicing immigration law for over twenty-five years with a specialization in asylum and refugee law, after having taught high school French and Spanish at area schools. In addition to her legal practice, Christine is a syndicated columnist whose opinion pieces appear in newspapers across the country, as well as a regular participant in local radio and television programs that focus on current affairs.

A graduate of Merion Mercy Academy, Bryn Mawr College and Villanova Law School, her local roots run deep. This can best be expressed by the fact that her mood is directly related to how well the Eagles, Flyers, Sixers and Phillies are playing at any given moment. Christine is an aunt to one human, two Black Labs and a bearded dragon.
