There are now only two weeks left until the most critical election of 2025 for Democrats--the November 4th PA Supreme Court retention election.
The stakes of this race are existential for Democrats.
If MAGA and Trump succeed in toppling the Democratic majority on the PA Supreme Court, they will gain control over the court responsible for how elections are run in the most important swing state in America. This will allow Trump to rig the upcoming '26 & '28 elections--denying Democrats a midterm victory and control of the White House for at least a decade.
Since earlier this summer, Defend Our Courts has been one of the leading Democratic organizations spearheading the defense of this critical court, and we have since rallied tens of thousands of Democrats to come to PA's aid.
Now with only two weeks to go, we are preparing our final surge--one last hail mary to try and prevent MAGA from seizing the court and Democracy from falling:

Friend,

I was proud to join the millions of people across America and the thousands across Illinois protesting President Trump’s abuses of power at the No Kings rally in Decatur.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117709539/577377161/-2063340125?refcode=em-10.21.25-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjQwNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMjg3YTUxOC05OWFlLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Fngs1FpYZD_9IGexiD9etGz0XjvA4Nc_Gs7-EfO9Ndo=)

It felt especially meaningful given the chaos in our politics right now – both in Washington and at home:
* The government shutdown has entered its third week, and Republicans are still unwilling to work with us to secure affordable healthcare for working families who already struggle with rising costs. Federal employees and active military are going without paychecks, and everyday people are unable to access services they rely on.

* Illinois is in the national spotlight as President Trump sends the National Guard into Chicago. This isn’t about safety, it’s a no holds barred display of power. It’s especially hypocritical after the White House canceled critical law enforcement grants – only to turn around and wield the National Guard against any community that dares to speak out.

I’m continuing to fight for IL-13 in Congress, no matter what the Trump administration and national Republicans throw at us. I’m energized by the folks I met at the rally this weekend, and I’m taking that courage back with me to keep pushing for progress.

Thank you, and let’s keep showing up together.

Nikki

Jason Plummer / State Senate website
By Illinois Review

Republican Illinois State Senator Jason Plummer, who recently endorsed Ted Dabrowski for governor and now serves as his campaign chairman, is facing growing scrutiny over his financial ties to one of the most liberal organizations in professional sports – the Los Angeles Dodgers.

Plummer’s father, Robert Plummer, is a minority owner of the Dodgers, and records show that Jason himself is also an investor.
For a man now leading a “pro-family, pro-freedom” gubernatorial campaign in Illinois, that connection raises serious questions about authenticity and conviction.

The Dodgers have become one of Major League Baseball’s most aggressively left-wing franchises – openly promoting causes that run counter to traditional values. The team made national headlines after honoring the Sisters of Perpetual Indulgence, a radical drag group that mocks Catholic nuns and the Christian faith, during a “Pride Night” event.
https://x.com/NEWSMAX/status/1670095204253339652?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw%7Ctwcamp%5Etweetembed%7Ctwterm%5E1670095204253339652%7Ctwgr%5Eba9b3a4a193ea90e0dc621dfa72b44dbd407ddc1%7Ctwcon%5Es1_&ref_url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.illinoisreview.com%2Fillinoisreview%2F2025%2F10%2Fdabrowskis-campaign-chair-tied-to-dodgers-team-that-celebrates-transgenderism-mocks-faith.html&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=4f4e5799f9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2025/10/dabrowskis-campaign-chair-tied-to-dodgers-team-that-celebrates-transgenderism-mocks-faith.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=4f4e5799f9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823
The Los Angeles Dodgers had planned to give an award to a group of gay and transgender drag performers who mock the Catholic faith. (Los Angeles Dodgers June 4, 2022/60 Second Docs Dec. 27, 2021/Youtube)
Despite an uproar from religious leaders and even members of Congress, the Dodgers doubled down – awarding the group a “Community Hero Award” live on the field.

More recently, the Dodgers celebrated a male swimmer competing in women’s sports, calling him a “trailblazer for inclusion.” The decision drew fierce backlash from women’s rights advocates, parents, and athletes who said the team was undermining fairness and disrespecting biological women.
The Dodgers have also donated to pro-abortion groups and far-left social causes, aligning themselves with California’s progressive elite. To many conservatives, the franchise has become a symbol of moral collapse in modern American culture – one that mocks faith, celebrates gender ideology, and undermines women’s sports.
But Plummer’s connection is just one part of a larger problem surrounding Dabrowski’s campaign. As Illinois Review previously reported, several of Dabrowski’s top donors have deep Democratic ties – including contributors who have funded liberal PACs, abortion advocacy groups, and candidates who oppose school choice and parental rights.

For a candidate claiming to represent conservative reform, Dabrowski’s donor list reads more like the finance team for a Pritzker re-election bid than a grassroots Republican movement. The funding network – combined with Plummer’s Dodgers connection – raises doubts about whether Dabrowski’s campaign is truly guided by conservative principles or simply managed by opportunists seeking influence.

His campaign has already been rocked by a growing internal scandal involving senior adviser Jeanne Ives, after she was linked to the leak of a confidential internal document from a rival campaign. That leak – reportedly published through outlets tied to longtime Ives allies Dan Proft and Brian Timpone – has ignited fury among Republican leaders, with some warning of potential lawsuits and donors threatening to withdraw financial support.

Now, with Plummer’s Dodgers ties and Democrat-linked financiers funding Dabrowski’s campaign, what began as a promising outsider candidacy is looking increasingly compromised.

Dabrowski’s message of “honesty and integrity” is being drowned out by headlines about leaks, liberal money, and woke affiliations. Voters who once hoped he might offer a clean conservative alternative to JB Pritzker are beginning to wonder whether he represents real change – or just another version of Illinois politics in disguise.

A campaign that claims to fight for family values and religious liberty is now being led by a man who profits from a franchise that mocks faith and celebrates gender ideology – and bankrolled by donors who finance the very Democrats destroying Illinois.

Ted Dabrowski still has time to prove that his campaign reflects the principles he promotes. But that will require stronger judgment, better allies, and a willingness to show that conservative values aren’t just talking points – they’re convictions worth standing by.

## Make American agriculture great again...
You've heard me talk about MAHA.
Today I want to talk about an aspect of MAHA that doesn't get a lot of coverage: the farmers and ranchers that actually raise the products we consume.
America first means agriculture too.
But striking the balance between consumer prices and American profitability can be tough.
It's easy to jump on the bandwagon complaining about high prices, but it's worth it to take a step back and ask what benefits _all_ of America.
Farmers and ranchers have dealt with price controls and unfair markets for decades, it's high time for a change.
After all, the rural base is a huge part of what got Trump and this Republican Congress elected.
These folks are the backbone of America; they literally feed us--and a good chunk of the rest of the world.
But with a storm brewing in the beef market, people are starting to ask questions about what the right move is, both for America's ranchers and the country as a whole.
Let's break it down...

subject: FWD: Trump wants to let polluters off the hook. Fight back 🗣️
body:
Speak out against this dangerous proposal, friend
| | |
---
| Hi—

Did you see this email from Trevor? We need you to join us and speak out against the latest outrageous proposal from Trump’s Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), which would eliminate a vital reporting tool that holds big polluters accountable.

**_But our records show that your name is still missing._**

The public has a right to know how much dangerous, planet-warming pollution is being emitted by large industries—**and there’s still time for the EPA to make things right.**[**Add your name to our public comment before the November 3 deadline.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/4115778/87SdQ4wZ)

Thanks for your continued advocacy,

Eva Piatek
Digital Lead - Email
Evergreen Collaborative

\---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Trevor Dolan, Evergreen Collaborative
Date: Wed, Oct 8, 2025
Subject: Trump wants to let polluters off the hook |
| [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/4115779/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
| Trump’s EPA wants to eliminate the Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program—a vital tool that helps tackle climate pollution by collecting data on how much companies are currently emitting.

[**Sign onto our comment now to tell Trump that dangerous pollution doesn’t go away when you stop counting it.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/4115780/87SdQ4wZ) [TAKE ACTION](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/4115781/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| Hi Friend,

As the government shutdown continues to drag on, more and more of us are going to feel the impact: from higher bills and dirtier air to cuts to food assistance and other essential services that families depend on.

And make no mistake, this is all part of Trump’s larger scheme to destroy every part of the federal government that doesn’t directly enrich him and his cronies.

**The latest proposal from Trump’s Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) is just another way to hurt working Americans while shielding polluters from any responsibility.**

That’s because Trump’s EPA is proposing to end the **Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program (GHGRP)** —a vital system that tracks climate pollution from the United States’ biggest emitters.

Without it, we’ll lose a critical tool for tracking progress on climate, holding major polluters accountable, and making data-informed decisions to protect public health.

[**EPA is accepting public comments on this proposal until November 3, and we’ve put one together calling on them NOT to repeal the GHGRP. Will you sign on in support?**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/4115782/87SdQ4wZ) |
---
[ADD YOUR NAME](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/4115783/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| Closing down the GHGRP would severely limit access to unbiased information on pollution in communities across the country—a move that advances the Trump administration’s imperative, backed by the oil and gas industry, to undermine any attempts to combat the climate crisis.

**It’s erasing data _and_ accountability.**

As we continue to see more record-breaking heat waves, unpredictable storms, and destructive wildfires, the public has a right to know how much dangerous, planet-warming pollution is being emitted by large industries. [**Add your name to our public comment now!**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/4115784/87SdQ4wZ) |
---
[SIGN ON](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/4115785/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| Thanks for all that you do, |
---
| | |
---

Evergreen Collaborative

About PowerBank Corporation
PowerBank Corporation is an independent renewable and clean energy project developer and owner focusing on distributed and community solar projects in Canada and the USA. The Company develops solar and Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects that sell electricity to utilities, commercial, industrial, municipal and residential off-takers. The Company maximizes returns via a diverse portfolio of projects across multiple leading North America markets including projects with utilities, host off-takers, community solar, and virtual net metering projects. The Company has a potential development pipeline of over one gigawatt and has developed renewable and clean energy projects with a combined capacity of over 100 megawatts built. # Ackerman credits tax cuts, infrastructure boosts and tariff tweaks for fueling Trump's economic wins
Billionaire investor **[Bill Ackman hailed President Donald Trump](https://substack.com/redirect/2464c385-9c8e-49b5-9826-c86adc45daac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as the most pro-business leader in U.S. history during a Tuesday CNBC interview, crediting tax cuts, infrastructure boosts and tariff tweaks for fueling economic wins amid declining geopolitical risks.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c7611dee-4279-46fa-af17-281457546cb6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Ackman 's Tariff Triumph: **Ackman voiced initial worries over Trump's April tariff rollout but praised the president for pausing it after his input, averting deeper market shocks and showcasing responsive policy-making.

[](https://substack.com/redirect/b6f49121-b097-4c11-8cd8-f07f8f0381fa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Fed Fuels Growth:** Trump's influence has kept the Federal Reserve accommodative with interest rate cuts, Ackman noted, creating a low-rate environment that supercharges corporate investments and expansions.
* **Geopolitics Eases Up:** Market risks from global tensions have notably dropped under Trump, though Ackman lamented strained U.S.-China ties, signaling cautious optimism for stable trade horizons.
* **NYC Socialism Slam:** Urging CEOs to rally early votes against Democratic mayoral nominee Zohran Mamdani, Ackman decried his "wrong" socialist fixes for city woes, fearing harm to Wall Street's dominance.

[](https://substack.com/redirect/5b3c3b30-a7c7-44ec-8213-f08c25fe1663?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

# **Rare Earth Roundup: Excitement builds as prospecting, trade deals and buying frenzy surge**
In a bold strike amid escalating US-China trade tensions, Ohio-based steelmaker **[Cleveland-Cliffs unveiled plans Monday](https://substack.com/redirect/6aff3e13-c986-4820-941d-ec9cdab21956?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to explore rare earth mining at two sites, sparking a 20% stock surge and echoing the speculative thrill of crypto-era corporate pivots as investors bet on America's push for mineral independence.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6aff3e13-c986-4820-941d-ec9cdab21956?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Geopolitical Spark Ignites** : Beijing's fresh restrictions on rare earth exports, coupled with White House tariff threats, exposed U.S. supply chain vulnerabilities, fueling urgent domestic mining pursuits.
* **CEO 's Strategic Vision**: Lourenco Goncalves vows to mirror steel triumphs by securing critical minerals, positioning Cliffs as a key player in the national sovereignty counter play against foreign reliance on rare earth minerals .
* **Hype Echoes Blockchain Era** : Mere pivot announcements (like Cleveland Cliffs) are driving wild market reactions, as rare earths promise tangible geopolitical leverage and future profits for US based miners
* **Wider Industry Ripple** : Tech titans like Nvidia and Whirlpool have aligned their operations with trade war tactics, potentially unleashing a wave of U.S. miner investments and sector volatility.

In a bold move to counter China's stranglehold on vital minerals, President Donald Trump and Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese signed **[a sweeping critical minerals agreement,](https://substack.com/redirect/1ec67f6e-1ab0-4f58-a6b6-a94d1cf9104f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** unlocking an $8.5 billion pipeline of joint projects to secure U.S. supply chains amid escalating trade tensions to stem China's advances.
* **Billion-Dollar Swift Funding Boost** : Australia and the U.S. commit $1 billion over six months to launch _**immediately**_ viable rare earths processing initiatives, accelerating diversification from Beijing's dominance.
* **Strategic Ally Processing Power** : Leveraging Australia's rare earths expertise--one of the few non-Chinese processors in existence--the deal channels U.S. investments into Down Under facilities for enhanced global supply resilience.
* **Trilateral Venture with Japan** : The deal expands cooperation via a U.S.-Australia-Japan joint venture, involving firms like Alcoa, to build interconnected processing networks and mitigate single-source risks **[created over the last 25 years.](https://substack.com/redirect/8d49ea90-d345-4e12-8637-fdf6302ed1f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
* **Tariff Threats Escalate Tensions** : Trump vows 100% duties on Chinese goods if needed, blending confrontation with diplomacy ahead of Xi Jinping summit, projecting a mineral abundance within a year.

**India 's Giant Refinery's Historic Dry-Out Ignites Global Frenzy**
In a stunning first, India's largest precious metals refinery, MMTC-Pamp, **[exhausted its silver stocks last week](https://substack.com/redirect/92c07ffb-3903-4a1a-be91-df51f719fc20?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** amid frenzied Diwali buying, sparking a worldwide shortage that shattered London's trading hub and sent premiums soaring to unprecedented levels.
* **Diwali Frenzy Fuels Shortage** : Unprecedented demand for silver jewelry during the Hindu festival, amplified by social media hype promoting it over gold, overwhelmed refineries nationwide.
* **London Vaults Drained Dry** : A global crisis hit the pricing epicenter for Silver in London, with free-floating (available) silver plunging below 150 million ounces against 250 million in daily trades (demand), triggering a 200% increase annualized borrowing rates.
* **Persistent Supply Deficits Exposed** : A cumulative 678 million ounce shortfall since 2021, driven by solar power production demand and ETF inflows, has eroded inventories from 1.1 billion ounces in 2021 to critical lows.
* **Market Rally Shows Resilience** : Despite a 6% price drop on October 17, ongoing U.S. fiscal worries and inflation sustain bullish outlook for silver, with experts warning of prolonged volatility.

**Bitcoin 's Epic Crash Boosts Gold **
Bitcoin's plunge of more than 14% in a single day on October 10th to $104,000 amid President Trump's tariff threats on China, triggering $19 billion in crypto liquidations, **[as investors pivot to surging gold](https://substack.com/redirect/e26da48d-aac5-4b65-a713-022778db3904?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** above $4,300 an ounce for safer haven bets.
* **Whale Bets Fuel Downward Spiral** : A savvy trader's $192 million short position profited big before the crash, followed by another bearish Sunday wager, intensifying selling pressure on volatile Bitcoin, derailing crypto's "Uptober" rally hopes.
* **Derivatives Amplify Liquidity Crunch** : Over $19 billion in **[leveraged futures](https://substack.com/redirect/609cc74e-31a3-45d8-af1e-ed73333f400a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** liquidations dried up crypto markets, with platforms auto-closing trades to curb losses, at prices **[that have sparked lawsuit threats.](https://substack.com/redirect/609cc74e-31a3-45d8-af1e-ed73333f400a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
* **Optimistic Crypto Rebound Forecast** : Despite setbacks, JPMorgan eyes $165,000 Bitcoin by year-end, while experts predict eventual capital rotation from gold's central bank-backed surge back to digital assets.

# The scale of Amazon's Cloud Crash yesterday was truly cataclysmic
Amazon Web Services **[suffered a massive outage Monday](https://substack.com/redirect/afabfbb7-3389-43a1-9304-4cff8c09efc0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in its US-East-1 region, knocking out over 70 services and crippling major sites like Disney+, Reddit, Robinhood and United Airlines for hours, stranding millions of users and delaying operations worldwide.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/afabfbb7-3389-43a1-9304-4cff8c09efc0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **DynamoDB DNS failure sparks chaos** : Core database and name resolution services in northern Virginia triggered widespread disruptions, not a cyberattack but a technical overload affecting AWS's "record-keeper" for the internet.
* **Airlines and finance grind to halt** : Travelers couldn't check in at Delta and United; crypto traders were locked out of Coinbase, while Venmo payments and Robinhood trades froze amid peak business hours.
* **Amazon 's internal empire stalls too**: Warehouse workers idled in break rooms, Flex drivers lost access to gigs, and third-party sellers battled offline tools, amplifying supply chain snarls.
* **Recovery exposes cloud fragility risks** : Full restoration by evening left message backlogs; experts warn of over-reliance on AWS, Microsoft, and Google, echoing past global blackouts from single-provider failures.

* * *
* * *
# GM roars back in Q3 with billion dollar earnings report
General Motors **[crushed third-quarter expectations](https://substack.com/redirect/f0782be8-6e62-4b6a-83d8-ea9cb8e1bb68?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Tuesday with $48.59 billion in revenue and $2.80 adjusted earnings per share, prompting executives to hike full-year profit forecasts amid easing tariff pressures and robust vehicle demand.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f0782be8-6e62-4b6a-83d8-ea9cb8e1bb68?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Beats Analyst Projections** : GM surpassed Wall Street estimates across the board, delivering adjusted EBIT of $3.38 billion versus the forecasted $2.72 billion, fueled by strong sales momentum.
* **Absorbs EV Setbacks** : GM incurred $1.6 billion in special charges from scaling back their all-electric vehicle plans, slashing net income 57% to $1.3 billion despite margin compression to 2.7%.
* **Eases Tariff Burdens** : A projected 2025 tariff hit was slashed to $3.5 billion-$4.5 billion from prior $4 billion-$5 billion, vowing to offset 35% through strategic adjustments.
* **Boosts Cash Flow Targets** : Elevated full-year automotive free cash flow guidance to $10 billion-$11 billion, signaling sustained financial health and investor confidence into 2026.

Team, If you’re on a few political email lists, you’ve probably seen your fair share of alarm bells and urgent countdowns. I get it — politics can feel like one long emergency. But I want to do things a little differently because I don’t think of you as an endless ATM. **_You are a partner in this work._**__ You’re a part of the team that’s helping us build a renewable future, protect our democracy, and deliver real results for New Mexico families. We’re facing powerful special interests that are determined to drag us backward on clean energy, public lands, and reproductive freedom. But we’ve shown that grassroots support can outwork and outlast big money every single time. That’s why these fundraising emails are so important. Every contribution helps us organize in every corner of New Mexico, stand up to the corporate lobbyists in Washington, and fight for politics that put people — _not profits_ — first. support Medicare for All.

are in power — we’d still be waiting for Social Security and Medicare.

party, Peter.

fight for them.

We’re not going to dig ourselves out of this mess by electing more
politicians who talk in circles. That’s how we lose to Trumpism.

Let’s stop pretending the middle ground is where change happens.

People are hungry for a Democratic Party that inspires hope again — a
party that backs concrete values: Medicare for All. Taxing billionaires.
Refusing money from corporate PACs and AIPAC from day one, not just when
it’s politically convenient to do so.

That’s what our campaign represents. But to win, I need you with me.

Every dollar we raise right now powers a movement to build a government

Ivan Dmytrovych Sirko was born in the early seventeenth century, approximately between 1605 and 1610. This is evidenced primarily by the results of research on Sirko's remains, according to which the Cossack ataman was 70-75 years old at the time of his death in 1680. The first researcher of Sirko's biography, the famous Ukrainian historian Dmytro Yavornytskyi, suggested that the future ataman was born in Sloboda Ukraine in the settlement of Merefa (now the city of Merefa, Kharkiv region). However, this is not true. Merefa was founded only in 1658, i.e. when Sirko was in his late teens. However, Sirko and his family lived in Merefa for a long time in his house, and after his death, his wife and some family members lived there. The fact that Merefa in Slobozhanshchyna is associated with the name of the Cossack Ataman is evidenced by another name for the town recorded in some Ukrainian chronicles, Sirkivka. Where, then, should we look for Sirko's homeland? In our opinion, the sources give grounds to localize it in Eastern Podillia, namely in the Vinnytsia region. It is worth recalling that Sirko was a colonel in Vinnytsia (Kalnytsia) in 1658-1660. As you know, at that time in Ukraine, people who came from the local area were usually elected to such positions. Let us also recall a letter from Hetman of the Left Bank Ukraine Ivan Samoilovych to the tsarist voivode Prince G. Romodanovsky of April 20, 1675*, which recounts (in Russian) Sirko's own words: "And since I was born among the Poles, I want to die there." Thus, it is clear that Sirko was born on the Ukrainian lands that were under the rule of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, not Muscovy (the latter included Slobozhanshchyna). The historian Volodymyr Borysenko's assumption that Sirko's birthplace was the hundred-man town of the Bratslav regiment Murafa, a few kilometers from Kalnyk, is correct. Now it is the village of Zhdanov, Vinnytsia region. By the way, Murafa in the Slobozhanshchyna probably originated from this Murafa, because immigrants from the Right Bank of Ukraine to the Left Bank often gave the newly founded settlements the names of their native villages or towns. It is also worth noting Sirko's great interest in Keleberda, which he founded in 1675 on the left bank of the Dnipro. For a long time, he sought from the Moscow tsar the right to own this town or sloboda, as well as the strategically important crossing of the Dnipro near Perevolochna (Sirko wanted this crossing not for himself, but for the entire Zaporozhian Lowland Army). Contrary to popular belief, we believe that Sirko did not come from a Cossack family, but from a small Ukrainian Orthodox gentry. For example, we know the name of a Podillia nobleman, Voytekh Sirko, who was married to a certain Olena Kozynska. Sources mention them in 1592. It is possible that they were relatives of the Cossack leader. Perhaps it is no coincidence that the kings of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, writing to Sirko, called him "urodzon." The word "nobleman" evokes negative associations for many people due to stereotypes instilled in school textbooks of the Stalinist era. However, this approach is not always correct. The term "nobleman" is identical to the words "knight," "chevalier," "nobleman," etc. and was commonly used not only in Poland but also in Ukraine, Belarus, and the Czech Republic. If scholars in Russia, Poland, and the Czech Republic, having contracted vulgar sociologism, no longer accuse Pushkin or Bunin, Suvorov or Kutuzov, Žižka or Kostiushko of being of noble or gentry origin, why have attacks on the Ukrainian and Belarusian gentry continued until recently? Is it not because in this way the imperial "divide and conquer" was transferred to our long-suffering history? Was it not because it was necessary to impose a nihilistic attitude toward the history of Ukraine, to "prove" that Ukrainians or Belarusians were just dark labor without national consciousness, ethnographic material doomed to build other people's empires? Meanwhile, the Ukrainian gentry produced many outstanding sons of Ukraine, fighters for its freedom. Suffice it to mention the names of Kryshtof Kosinski, Petro Konashevych-Sahaidachny, Ivan Sulyma, Ivan Mazepa, Bohdan Khmelnytsky, and his associates: Ivan and Danylo Vyhovsky, Ivan Bohun, Danylo and Ivan Nechai, Mykhailo Krychevsky, Jan Sokolovsky, Siluyan Muzhylovsky, and others. Sirko's appearance and personality do not always coincide with the conventional ideas about him that have developed in some works of art. The Cossack leader was slightly taller than average (174-176 cm), had regular facial features, and a straight nose. By the way, the great Relin intuitively caught this when he depicted him in the center of his painting "Cossacks Writing a Letter to the Turkish Sultan." It is interesting that the prototype for Sirko's image in the painting was the famous military leader General Dragomirov. Only one significant detail was not known to Repin and his consultant D. Yavornytskyi - a red birthmark on Sirko's lower lip on the right side. His contemporaries considered it a "sign of God" given to distinguish him from ordinary people. The Grand Hetman of the Crown, the future King of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, Jan Sobieski, who knew Sirko well and met him in Bratslav in 1671.

Is it not because in this way the imperial "divide and conquer" was transferred to our long-suffering history? Was it not because it was necessary to impose a nihilistic attitude toward the history of Ukraine, to "prove" that Ukrainians or Belarusians were just dark labor without national consciousness, ethnographic material doomed to build other people's empires? Meanwhile, the Ukrainian gentry produced many outstanding sons of Ukraine, fighters for its freedom. Suffice it to mention the names of Kryshtof Kosinski, Petro Konashevych-Sahaidachny, Ivan Sulyma, Ivan Mazepa, Bohdan Khmelnytsky, and his associates: Ivan and Danylo Vyhovsky, Ivan Bohun, Danylo and Ivan Nechai, Mykhailo Krychevsky, Jan Sokolovsky, Siluyan Muzhylovsky, and others. Sirko's appearance and personality do not always coincide with the conventional ideas about him that have developed in some works of art. The Cossack leader was slightly taller than average (174-176 cm), had regular facial features, and a straight nose. By the way, the great Relin intuitively caught this when he depicted him in the center of his painting "Cossacks Writing a Letter to the Turkish Sultan." It is interesting that the prototype for Sirko's image in the painting was the famous military leader General Dragomirov. Only one significant detail was not known to Repin and his consultant D. Yavornytskyi - a red birthmark on Sirko's lower lip on the right side. His contemporaries considered it a "sign of God" given to distinguish him from ordinary people. PowerBank Corporation is an independent renewable and clean energy project developer and owner focusing on distributed and community solar projects in Canada and the USA. The Company develops solar and Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects that sell electricity to utilities, commercial, industrial, municipal and residential off-takers. About PowerBank Corporation
PowerBank Corporation is an independent renewable and clean energy project developer and owner focusing on distributed and community solar projects in Canada and the USA. The Company develops solar and Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects that sell electricity to utilities, commercial, industrial, municipal and residential off-takers. The Company maximizes returns via a diverse portfolio of projects across multiple leading North America markets including projects with utilities, host off-takers, community solar, and virtual net metering projects. The Company has a potential development pipeline of over one gigawatt and has developed renewable and clean energy projects with a combined capacity of over 100 megawatts built. | | Dear Friends,

It’s been a busy and productive few weeks in District 2 and across Arizona. I’m excited to share some important updates, community highlights, and upcoming opportunities for engagement.

**🛡️**** Sex Offender Management Board Launch**
On **October 7th** , the **Sex Offender Management Board** (SOMB) held its inaugural meeting. I proudly sponsored this legislation during the **2024 legislative session** , and we secured funding this past session.
🔗 Learn more about the SOMB’s mission and upcoming meetings: [azdps.gov/sex-offender-management-board](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=5c7c768a97&e=a7ab36849c)

💰 **Conforming to Federal Tax Provisions**
Arizona faces major fiscal challenges from the recent federal tax changes (H.R. 1). State budget analysts from the Joint Legislative Budget Committee have warned us in order to fully conform to these most recent federal tax changes we could face a reduction in the state general fund revenues by an estimated $438 million in Fiscal Year 2026. This is due to new federal deductions, lower tax on certain income (like tips and overtime), and increased standard deductions that Arizona does not automatically adopt. The legislature and governor will have to decide whether to amend state statute to adopt these provisions.

To learn more about the state's financial outlook, you can view a recent Finance Advisory Committee _[Revenue and Budget Update](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=27062b209b&e=a7ab36849c)_ from October 9th.
**📞 Constituent Conversations**
Over the past few weeks, I’ve met with many constituents to discuss:
* Criminal justice system concerns
* Navigating DES programs and concerns with DCS
* Barriers to entry for small business owners

Your stories and insights continue to shape my legislative priorities.

**🏫**** Education Engagement**
I’ve had the privilege of meeting with:
* District school superintendents and governing board members and charter school operators,
* Current high school, college, and law school students,
* International students from **[Project Arizona](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=5273ef77ff&e=a7ab36849c) , **and
* High school leaders from **[USSY](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=f2d113f702&e=a7ab36849c)**[**P**](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=8c36f59d9d&e=a7ab36849c)** \-- **two students** ** will be selected to represent Arizona in DC next March.

These conversations are helping identify meaningful tweaks to current laws—**stay tuned for updates!**

**👮**** Supporting Law Enforcement Families through LEAP**
I attended the **inaugural heroes’ gala **hosted by **[LEAP](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=ca1e3886be&e=a7ab36849c) (Law Enforcement Advocacy Project)** last week.
🎉 Their next event is scheduled for **December 13, 2025 so mark your calendars**.
💙 Support their mission: [Donate to LEAP](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=d53f4d0d3c&e=a7ab36849c)

**🏆 Celebrating Local Excellence**
* I was honored to receive the **Fair Chance Champion Award** from **[Arouet ](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=6b043ceb51&e=a7ab36849c)**at their annual **Fair Chance Symposium** on **October 16th**. If you are a company and would like to partner with Arouet, please learn more about how you can create second chances that create positive changes lasting a lifetime on their [website](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=3f25a5d5fa&e=a7ab36849c).
* Congratulations to **Karen’s Hallmark – The Giftive Shop** , named "2025 Retailer of the Year" by the **Arizona Retailers Association**! I was happy to nominate Karen's Hallmark and their fantastic staff over the summer.
📍 Visit them at: **509 E Bell Rd, Suite 1, Phoenix**

📰 **Bolick in the News**

San Tan Valley News [Sex Offender Management Board](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=bc32553f80&e=a7ab36849c)
Arizona Capitol Times [SOS to mirror federal campaign finances rules for security](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=12d848e48d&e=a7ab36849c)
Roll Call [CD 1 Now a Toss Up](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=342bea3d1d&e=a7ab36849c)

Thank you for staying engaged and informed. I’m grateful for the opportunity to serve and advocate for our community at the state level. Let’s keep working together to make Arizona stronger.

Warm regards,
**Shawnna**

| **Campaign Update**
**🗓️ Upcoming Campaign Kick-off Fundraiser** Join me on **October 22nd from 4pm to 6pm** in **downtown Phoenix** for a joint campaign fundraiser alongside Rep. Walt Blackman. I hope you will continue to support my efforts.
📩 [Please RSVP](mailto:info@bolickforarizona.com?subject=RSVP%20for%2010%2F22) TODAY to receive the address for TOMORROW's event.
🗳️** Please help me get my name on the 2026 Republican primary ballot**
As many of you may know, I was involved in a car accident at the end of June. I’ve spent the past few months focusing on healing, and I’m grateful for the continued support as I move forward. _Now, I’m turning my attention back to serving our community—and I need your help._ If you reside in the following zip codes, there is a good chance I represent you at the state capitol: 85022, 85023, 85024, 85027, 85029, 85032, 85050, 85053, 85085, 85308, 85310, or 85331.

Please take a moment to sign my secure online nomination petition to ensure my name appears on the August 4, 2026, Republican primary ballot. **👉[ Click here](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=340983d78c&e=a7ab36849c) **to sign the petition Your support means the world to me, and I’m excited to continue working on behalf of Legislative District 2 for two more years.

subject: Missed paychecks, missed groceries

Many of them are having trouble making rent, putting gas in their car, and buying groceries for their families. **Government workers are the ones who make our democracy happen.** They deserve support from We the People as a wannabe dictator wreaks havoc on their pocketbooks. I want to take a moment to explain why Virginia’s elections in 14 days are so important.
Put simply: the Commonwealth’s elections are a referendum on the Trump administration’s record.
As Virginians go to the polls, we’ll elect our next Governor and decide if Democrats maintain control of the General Assembly. If Democrats can win big, we send a clear message that voters are rejecting the chaos, corruption, and extremism that have defined Trump and the GOP.

As farmers on Colorado's eastern plains struggle to make ends meet with Trump's disastrous tariffs, billionaire Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent finally announced he's coming to the rescue with a massive $40 billion bailout...
For Argentina.
Bessent just handed his Wall Street buddy a $40 billion lifeline after betting big on Argentina and losing. Now American taxpayers are footing the bill while Colorado farmers get left behind.

This isn't "America First," it's billionaires first.
Billionaires are looting the middle class in broad daylight, transferring wealth upward while the people who feed our nation get scraps. Colorado's farmers and ranchers don't need pity or bailouts -- they need fair markets, a strong farm bill, and leaders who respect and work for them. Food isn't optional, but apparently accountability is.
I'm running because the folks keeping this country fed deserve champions in Congress -- not errand boys for the billionaire class. And that's all that my opponent Lauren Boebert has been in Congress, a billionaire's puppet, voting time and time again to line the pockets of the billionaires who bankroll her political career at the cost of her middle and working class constituents in CO-4.

| | **Upcoming Webinar with Robert Miller!**
---
|
---
| Join us on **Saturday, October 25, 2025 at 11:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM ET** for a live Zoom webinar with **Robert (Bob) Miller, BCTN, ANWPB** on the _Epigenetic and Genetic Factors Leading to Increased NLRP3, Histamine, and Glutamate in ASD_. Bob will unpack how specific genetic variants, when combined with environmental/epigenetic triggers, can upregulate the **NLRP3 inflammasome** , dysregulate **histamine** pathways, and elevate **glutamate** excitotoxicity in autism spectrum disorder. Expect a clear, mechanism-focused walkthrough and practical insights on how these pathways intersect and what that means for individualized support strategies. Bob is a **Board-Certified Traditional Naturopath** who specializes in genetic-specific nutrition and founded the **NutriGenetic Research Institute** to study links between genetic variants and clinical presentations. He has presented multi-year research programs on complex chronic illness and mast-cell/HEME/NADPH-related mechanisms, and has educated thousands of practitioners internationally on applying functional genomics in care.

## **Introducing Our Headline Speaker, Aaron Siri!**
---

| We are thrilled to announce that **Aaron Siri, Esq.** will be joining us as a **headline speaker** at the 2026 **Autism Health Summit**! Known for his groundbreaking legal work in medical freedom and health rights, Aaron Siri has become one of the most influential voices advocating for transparency, informed consent, and ethical medical policy. His powerful message and commitment to truth have inspired millions, and his presence at the Autism Health Summit promises to be one of our most impactful sessions yet. [Click HERE](https://autismhealth.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7c0b21e245e40197b3670bea2&id=8cefd57140&e=3a42edfdc4) to view our upcoming speaker lineup. This **transformative 3-day event** brings together world-class experts, parents, practitioners, and advocates from around the globe to share cutting-edge research, innovative therapies, and inspiring stories of hope and healing. **CME credits available for professionals!**

### **Join Autism Health at The Big Blue Bash!**
---
|
---
| Autism Health is honored to support our friends at the **National Police Defense Foundation (NPDF)** and the **Federal Law Enforcement Officers Association (FLEOA)** at the upcoming **Big Blue Bash** — a prestigious evening celebrating our nation’s heroes in law enforcement. The event will take place at the world-renowned **Mar-a-Lago Club in Palm Beach, Florida** , bringing together leaders, advocates, and supporters from across the country for a night of unity, recognition, and purpose. This year’s Big Blue Bash will feature special guests, distinguished speakers, live entertainment, and opportunities to support critical programs that protect those who protect us. We’re proud to stand alongside NPDF and FLEOA in honoring the men and women who serve our communities with courage and integrity. To learn more and secure your spot at this unforgettable evening, visit [NPDF.org](https://autismhealth.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7c0b21e245e40197b3670bea2&id=ea50d27271&e=3a42edfdc4). About PowerBank Corporation
PowerBank Corporation is an independent renewable and clean energy project developer and owner focusing on distributed and community solar projects in Canada and the USA. The Company develops solar and Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects that sell electricity to utilities, commercial, industrial, municipal and residential off-takers. The Company maximizes returns via a diverse portfolio of projects across multiple leading North America markets including projects with utilities, host off-takers, community solar, and virtual net metering projects. The Company has a potential development pipeline of over one gigawatt and has developed renewable and clean energy projects with a combined capacity of over 100 megawatts built. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117718883/577407624/1239926708?refcode=em_wei_fr_nokings_102125&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkOWI1YmMwZS1hZWFlLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2hv1Poc_YU4lVuPZzW32bPlLbjdvDrUVIOziBboP4mM=&emci=3a13bb56-aaae-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=d9b5bc0e-aeae-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=51844520) Hi, Phil here. I was deeply moved as I stood with tens of thousands of Coloradans — and nearly seven million people nationwide — who showed up to peacefully protest at a No Kings rally this weekend. Standing shoulder to shoulder with friends and neighbors, we saw historic turnout from Cortez to Grand Junction to Fort Collins to Lamar. Two of my fellow Coloradans, Linda and Loretta, showed up on Saturday because they understand what we’re up against. They had a powerful message to share: **_This is a time to show courage._** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117718885/577407629/-468657501?refcode=em_wei_fr_nokings_102125&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkOWI1YmMwZS1hZWFlLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2hv1Poc_YU4lVuPZzW32bPlLbjdvDrUVIOziBboP4mM=) _"I didn’t march in the Civil Rights movement, so this is my time to stand up. This is my opportunity."_ _"You have to stand up, and now is the time."_ We’ve seen for ourselves that our freedom of speech isn’t guaranteed — we need to defend it. That’s why I called on Coloradans to show up in record numbers for No Kings Protests on Saturday — and they did so. We protested to stop a federalized National Guard from being deployed in Colorado, pitting Americans against Americans. We protested against any and all attacks on our gold-standard voting laws, including our right to vote by mail. And we protested against the threats and intimidation this administration keeps throwing at us. As your Attorney General, I know what it takes to stand up to a bully. My office has taken Trump to court 39 times and counting, and we keep winning in the courts. Because when you’re up against a lawless bully, appeasing won’t get you anywhere. **The only option is to stand up for what we believe in _and fight like hell for it._ I’m the only person running for governor who has stood up to Donald Trump at every turn — and whether we’re in the streets or in the courtroom, you can count on me to never back down from this fight.** Together, we’ll fight with courage. We’ll defend this republic. We’ll protect the rule of law. And we’ll make sure that here in Colorado, and all across America, there are no kings. **[If you’re with us, I’d be honored if you’d make a donation to our people-powered campaign today.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117718886/577407630/-468657501?refcode=em_wei_fr_nokings_102125&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkOWI1YmMwZS1hZWFlLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2hv1Poc_YU4lVuPZzW32bPlLbjdvDrUVIOziBboP4mM=)** Thanks so much, Phil

About PowerBank Corporation
PowerBank Corporation is an independent renewable and clean energy project developer and owner focusing on distributed and community solar projects in Canada and the USA. The Company develops solar and Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects that sell electricity to utilities, commercial, industrial, municipal and residential off-takers. The Company maximizes returns via a diverse portfolio of projects across multiple leading North America markets including projects with utilities, host off-takers, community solar, and virtual net metering projects. The Company has a potential development pipeline of over one gigawatt and has developed renewable and clean energy projects with a combined capacity of over 100 megawatts built. To learn more about PowerBank, please visit [powerbankcorp.com](https://trk.conservativereboot.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4hwa6&__onlt=h).

Peter,
**I’m in Virginia today to support my friend Abigail Spanberger, and I want to tell you why.**
Abigail’s race isn’t just about who will serve as Virginia’s next Governor. It’s also one of the first major tests of what kind of country we’re going to be a year into Donald Trump’s second term.
Abigail represents the kind of leadership we need right now. She served our country in the CIA, then in Congress, where she consistently prioritized results over rhetoric. Now she’s running for Governor to bring that same sense of integrity and service to Virginia.
I’ve seen firsthand what kind of leader Abigail is. When we worked together on transportation projects to benefit the Virginians she represented, she stayed focused on results – grounded, practical, and determined to make life better for the people she serves. She doesn’t lead with slogans or soundbites; she leads by doing.
We need more leaders like Abigail, but this is going to be a hard-fought race. The last Virginia Governor’s race was decided by only two points. The stakes are enormous. Every yard matters. Every door knocked matters. Every donation matters.

clean_body: = Peter, I’m in Virginia today to support my friend Abigail Spanberger, and I want to tell you why. Abigail’s race isn’t just about who will serve as Virginia’s next Governor. It’s also one of the first major tests of what kind of country we’re going to be a year into Donald Trump’s second term. Abigail represents the kind of leadership we need right now. She served our country in the CIA, then in Congress, where she consistently prioritized results over rhetoric. Now she’s running for Governor to bring that same sense of integrity and service to Virginia. I’ve seen firsthand what kind of leader Abigail is. When we worked together on transportation projects to benefit the Virginians she represented, she stayed focused on results – grounded, practical, and determined to make life better for the people she serves. She doesn’t lead with slogans or soundbites; she leads by doing. We need more leaders like Abigail, but this is going to be a hard-fought race. Team, I wanted you to be the first to know: **I’m running to continue serving as Minnesota’s Attorney General.**
As the People’s Lawyer, I’m fighting to help folks afford their lives and live with dignity, safety, and respect. And together, we’ve made real progress.
For the past seven years, I’ve fought to hold corporations accountable, won new protections for Minnesota workers and consumers, and cracked down on fraud, scams, and price gouging. When Donald Trump threatened our rights and cut vital programs, I took him to court and helped restore critical freedoms and funding to millions of Minnesotans.
But there’s more work to be done. Too many families are still struggling to make ends meet. Oligarchs, billionaires, and corporations are lining their own pockets at our expense. And Trump and his MAGA allies will continue attacking our shared values and the most vulnerable members of our communities.
**That’s why I’m running for reelection. But I can’t do it alone, team.**
This movement is powered by people like you — not corporate PACs and special interests. We need your support to prove our grassroots team is fired up and ready to win this race.

subject: re: Trump's endorsement
body:
Will you split a contribution between my campaign and Deb Haaland to help me defeat Donald Trump's hand-picked candidate in the biggest election of 2025?
I'm going to lay this out as clearly as I can:
**Donald Trump just endorsed my opponent Winsome Earle-Sears.**
I'm the only Democrat running for Governor this year in a state controlled by Republicans, and I need each person reading this to join our donor list by midnight. It's urgent so that we can continue standing up to President Trump, turning out voters, and demonstrating the strength of this campaign.
[**Will you split a $5 contribution between my campaign and Deb Haaland to help me defeat Donald Trump's hand-picked candidate in the biggest election of 2025? It's only a matter of time until Trump's billion-dollar war chest is spent to attack us here in Virginia, and we need to be ready to respond.**](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/807?c0=em_ms_dh_20251021_1_spanberger.xVS5it&amount=5&refcode=em20251021-5192&t=1&akid=5192%2E400544%2Ectvq1o)

This whole year, my opponent has spent more time groveling for Trump's endorsement than standing up for Virginia.
In fact, Winsome admits that she met privately with Trump to plead for his support.
This came at a time when the President was firing thousands of federal workers, driving up prices, and planning to cut funding for healthcare and public schools — actions which have devastated Virginia's economy and threatened the livelihoods of so many.
It's clear that Winsome places her loyalty to Trump above everything else.
Now, I'm using every tool at my disposal to make sure voters know the truth about Winsome. But we're in the heart of early voting now, and sharing our message on TV, at the doors, and over the internet is so incredibly expensive.
_So, can I count on your support today?_
[**If you've been waiting for the moment when you can have the greatest impact on our campaign for Governor, this is it. Please use this link right now to make your split donation →** ](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/807?c0=em_ms_dh_20251021_1_spanberger.xVS5it&refcode=em20251021-5192&t=21&akid=5192%2E400544%2Ectvq1o)

Thank you for standing with me. Let's win this together.
Abigail Spanberger

subject: 700% Increase in ICE Weapons Spending — 0% Increase in Justification
body:
ICE is burning through taxpayer money

| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | [|
---](https://chrisahuja.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=97f443092fb7c091746070aa0&id=f37392752e&e=5a6ee82cdb)
| | | | | |

Dear Peter,
Under Trump, U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement **(ICE)** has ramped up weapons spending by **700%** — purchasing more guns, armor, and even chemical agents.
On **September 29, 2025** , ICE made a **$9 million purchase** from Geissele Automatics, a company that sells semi-automatic and automatic rifles.
For comparison: between **January 20 and October 18, 2024** , ICE’s total spending in the “small arms” category was just **$9.7 million**. The escalation is staggering.
With a **$75 billion budget** , ICE is out of control, and our neighbors in CA-32 are afraid and taking precautions to protect themselves. Students are staying home from class, workers are staying home or risking being snatched by ICE in our streets.
And now, the Trump administration wants **even more taxpayer money** — not for families or healthcare, but to **hand out tax breaks to the wealthy**. That’s why our government is shut down. They’re gutting healthcare subsidies while working families pay the price.
This is why I’m running for Congress:
* To **end the militarization of immigration** enforcement and defund ICE.
* To **restore humanity and accountability** to our district and our country.
* To **stop a three-decade incumbent** , Brad Sherman, from going along to get along with Trump-world economic policies and tired policies that don’t serve our district anymore.

We don’t need more weapons in our neighborhoods — or an incumbent on the wrong side of history, **taking AIPAC money and siding with Trump** on tariff policy.
We need leadership that knows the difference between **strength and cruelty** , and policies that **put working families first**.
[**Let’s send a message to Washington: we won’t fund and support fear with our tax dollars.**](https://chrisahuja.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=97f443092fb7c091746070aa0&id=a41b59c965&e=5a6ee82cdb)[**Chip in $10, $25, or $50 today to help me fight back against Trump’s ICE escalation and build a safer, more humane America.**](https://chrisahuja.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=97f443092fb7c091746070aa0&id=58c4ac20ff&e=5a6ee82cdb)

body:
| | | | | [|

| | | | | | Hey Peter, it’s Emily. I’m the City Council President of Eau Claire, a mental health counselor, a small business owner, a mom, and proud to call Western Wisconsin my home.
---
[|
---](https://bergeforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=85565153e5fb51ffb3f8fe008&id=27a51fa66d&e=a09c3c1942)
| | **I’m running for Congress here in the 3rd District** , because it’s time for a change, it’s time for some fresh perspective, and it’s time for a leader who does the work of caring for people.

I entered politics and public service unconventionally – and it wasn’t something I aspired or planned for. I’m a Licensed Mental Health Counselor, and have spent my career caring for people: helping folks through bereavement and grief, working with children in outpatient therapy, and with LGTBQ+ community members.

When Trump was elected in 2016, it felt like my world was turning upside down. I couldn’t believe we had elected someone like him, and felt in my bones like our community deserved better.

As corny as it sounds, I wanted to be the change – so I pivoted, and decided to run for Eau Claire City Council. I was elected in 2018, beating the incumbent by 24 points through good, old-fashioned hard work, door knocking, and connecting with voters. In 2023, I was elected as the Eau Claire City Council President.
I’m running to make healthcare - including mental healthcare - more accessible. Last year, Western WI saw the closing of 2 hospitals, and multiple clinics, mental health clinics, and addiction treatment centers.
I’m running to make housing more affordable, and to return the dream of home ownership to our next generation. I believe that anyone who wants a home should have a home no matter their income.

I’m running to protect the water, land, and environment of Wisconsin. Our hunters, fishers, and nature enthusiasts deserve a clean and safe place to enjoy.

I’m running to tackle the crisis of affordability that we’re seeing everywhere. Housing, childcare, transportation, groceries and so much more have gotten too expensive.

Throughout my career and time in public service, I’ve gone toe-to-toe with MAGA Republicans – and I’ve stood up for my community. and now I’m ready to go to Congress and fight for you.

[**You know what you get with me, I’m firm in my values and stand strong in what I know is right. I know I can win this race and oust Derrick Van Orden once and for all – but I need you. Will you add your name right now and become a citizen endorser of our campaign?**](https://bergeforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=85565153e5fb51ffb3f8fe008&id=1936cc5916&e=a09c3c1942)

Emily

Fellow Conservative,

It’s been a very long time since Republicans won a full six-year Senate term in Minnesota.

The year was 2002, and **the first season of American Idol had just premiered; Kelly Clarkson wasn’t yet a household name in the United States.**

**CSI was the top show on network TV,** dethroning ER from its long-held spot atop the charts, and Everybody Loves Raymond was still airing weekly.

_**DVDs were just beginning to overtake VHS systems in our homes, and Netflix was still in its infancy as a DVD-by-mail rental service. It would be another four years, 2007, before Netflix launched its streaming service.**_

**23 YEARS IS LONG ENOUGH. BUT DEMOCRATS THINK MINNESOTA IS THEIR TERRITORY, NEVER TO BE CEDED TO A REPUBLICAN - EVER.**

**It’s time to send them a message: Time’s up.**

_[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=092abce85f56457ca23e0b32cf6d0519&_e=_DOEUJWbNMZNWbxorHpHfhWZ8jPuAtR20Emqdb51ZMlDpUz5xb_IHVsXM6YU_6QqcvKk2INbEv4wWw2W_HwHPG0eGH7ksAAS8G7v1oCVH0wg2-jWjwsSkmDD9-z2MkvSbyBzMh5w7gUTL51tL7LJsZct7ps4FurGmVpA1uFlo4CuZcULSwmW22_25sioXdXVokAhQXphgVaHbktjEFbBauypNhojurUh941JiJ92Tc8q0QALmRiUCzzZusO70ofuVD8mzDu__FYYAcGP9XisToNYfRyVD1Nlg6C0_vleJAThW80Vz5QzGfkAizI8XMxNx8lbsWhGIZ7ZDyC5ym1UyIaONuSd5TJKbz_cFtwmz_e_PJs4LAWvA0aWpIOTngXojLwdnIQHdp5yUQDa4oLyTwfLcXckzgDSZDuRiEun0RWKezLVFU7BMrXn3ReOF4kDTIQcmeI0kjg8VAOxFisNQ_iypIglychq287OjaCJNu3ilMXdzLE2j-Eu_-3h5I5ud39O87jTluW7huab_cX_v45WXoQdee_RD_6eSGVYeg2nXdG4AAV4h4P68dKB-o5oN5CL4R3t_qvdhmH-oMU-o8LSVdkhrk5qZbKZHaW3KEHyYtApY6ldJbPWcq2wOaJPrPat_s6Ci0vMt20XTI1FnaV5ykuokkuxeMo60rHen3zyDeK0QUOXsNSFqqsdGBoAY8LGbuuDtD4SlnvaticqOrloZ6Z-wr54HKIjoBaTQiP4FCDk389_yzi4bYX-qSsvI19KLZ1ZiBomxCfWZaHK2Lz_FAElBn-TNvDiEakMEOk%3D)_
A poll released recently by one of my opponent’s campaigns has breathed new life into this race - according to their pollster, **a generic Republican candidate only trails the Democrats by TWO POINTS.**

Over the last several months, I’ve been making a concerted effort to introduce myself to you via email and text messages.

_**Have you received and read them?**_

If not, let me quickly reintroduce myself to you today.

I’m Adam Schwarze, a _**former Navy SEAL Officer and Marine Corps veteran.**_ I grew up on Minnesota’s hockey rinks, enlisted after 9/11, and served in over 70 countries, leading high-stakes missions with discipline and resolve. Service is my calling — to my country, my family, and now to you. **I’m running for U.S. Senate** to fight for the America we love, the one you’ve worked hard to build for your children and grandchildren.

[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=092abce85f56457ca23e0b32cf6d0519&_e=_DOEUJWbNMZNWbxorHpHfhWZ8jPuAtR20Emqdb51ZMlDpUz5xb_IHVsXM6YU_6QqfFX0GdG7jrRDqta3yYpfUwno023pTiufOvs4fhberzc-12OpJv_eUJHEUh0asWAcvojRSkgyFXcIvq9SGoj3tPjcz_mAG9ZvQT_iGtENy4uGcjLmc9Wcyrd6r2J4E4bpC7EJ95gXmh4IX_l1vOCq-aenchpUfJ9VhB-lZZyJL0RwjmFH7ARCSTt0LrhO1KqNjUzS2AHPOYdZlEizBBYkSYkAHsJOtruoT03s67KqTtZKKHFabzjwtvoBr01GiksdBJbRWPB4M2dWkT4B-VEEFA-WgUr70lQUzeuyKTdpO6p4nohwZJIugF5wok8OgnEy1COvcEgp4nD1R9aRtxFcxoWjPCeoRuMsvW-XWkNG3qPMlHMVybF8cn4HGSEBsT1WUffLsz6GonyYV4eb1t-Skk7Ly6X1-mieIByvlVk0XY9bOsFooDWUqRE0j9OIzERJCMK7fTsKaD2bW4uxtZgoPHmTVJlaj4bqhotAbVTw6FXIt3AM6o1KcYuAFdp_ujY_7QsPXmyN9fmL1XwT0QJOP1M5FLoVUAgBiujtZ7jcLs7FDKCFplNoX6kZA5TcG_tV7Qv6xOI65H0cDGCbHIQE1mCb-ONyo53NAObCRlQCXMttuxyGtoSAOpt5XcWkPX9EsaVT1sf5f6gXqwIZeD-FhtOikV3faTK_JAYBsp9tUyQ%3D)
If I can prove to the national Republican party apparatus that I’m a contender who can raise funds independently, they’ll take me seriously and provide the firepower we need to win this race.

I need help raising $100,000 by the end of this month, and so far, we’re halfway there. So, **[if you can chip in $2.75, $5.50, or even $25 right now to help us hit our goal by Halloween, we’d really appreciate it.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=092abce85f56457ca23e0b32cf6d0519&_e=_DOEUJWbNMZNWbxorHpHfhWZ8jPuAtR20Emqdb51ZMlDpUz5xb_IHVsXM6YU_6Qq7jAczWz5dGx38XVqAzWD1vUhH-KdbNp_1uhbmi7-wkLyXGRICn2jsjOP3rEVIlH1EALFR8c5TaoxOtGPJjbo38HTWoVeJuyI9Hf0vMjcJl2-nQHcbQzFqh8yBgZ448JqE1kKLPrHjgsKnSGCcdQtJzxwdHWoLooVOnrhCvVhpIgbtZd1JQVZejW0Od6PWtlL0khpjJ6yW61uUSTDXRWKGJKDofVhU39tyBdUdBsenqVGmt7Fgrf8ereU6kl_YCNNdKm0xN1wkLI7HtxdbBapd9oybZA2yF_rrCf2B_iEnC6slc6dzNfEcvNlo4acrsnkwZPJYXWUgi8Go4JpUNv9bD065mIKBzPEhQzC4_P5fhxlvapwFgV5dhiFNE4H_70fPyvy2JbqRTf3LfItgOuibcz6xpWqNXYnTPAOMSMr1U5yQA8AlWNvNfFKOzRq0qx2fb0UKR9BVIt4vAQE75pXuVUCj5LjyzFeiXpKS0nF6DJNkPx9Cx8VcKlHWIyqtgdNty_yb0s2wKhiv5tszmv0KR2C4WQ57OuEV-1EnkCFe5lDsutxcra_0IVv5BdwptL69SWvDxgOqElZakWIJ4a4auVHeq5F_118uCy5SmcxEXQgVOreoBM_4Gtzr4K9hEdq0ZqrQsGiOWt3JZMY7pSxoZ8oTjEpC-V8umfuVa77oADEza1_PVim8KRqp7mowGTp) **

clean_body: It’s been a very long time since Republicans won a full six-year Senate term in Minnesota | Fellow Conservative, It’s been a very long time since Republicans won a full six-year Senate term in Minnesota. The year was 2002, and the first season of American Idol had just premiered; Kelly Clarkson wasn’t yet a household name in the United States. CSI was the top show on network TV, dethroning ER from its long-held spot atop the charts, and Everybody Loves Raymond was still airing weekly. DVDs were just beginning to overtake VHS systems in our homes, and Netflix was still in its infancy as a DVD-by-mail rental service. It would be another four years, 2007, before Netflix launched its streaming service. 23 YEARS IS LONG ENOUGH. BUT DEMOCRATS THINK MINNESOTA IS THEIR TERRITORY, NEVER TO BE CEDED TO A REPUBLICAN - EVER. It’s time to send them a message: Time’s up. A poll released recently by one of my opponent’s campaigns has breathed new life into this race - according to their pollster, a generic Republican candidate only trails the Democrats by TWO POINTS. Over the last several months, I’ve been making a concerted effort to introduce myself to you via email and text messages. Have you received and read them? If not, let me quickly reintroduce myself to you today. I’m Adam Schwarze, a former Navy SEAL Officer and Marine Corps veteran. I grew up on Minnesota’s hockey rinks, enlisted after 9/11, and served in over 70 countries, leading high-stakes missions with discipline and resolve. Service is my calling — to my country, my family, and now to you. I’m running for U.S. Senate to fight for the America we love, the one you’ve worked hard to build for your children and grandchildren. If I can prove to the national Republican party apparatus that I’m a contender who can raise funds independently, they’ll take me seriously and provide the firepower we need to win this race. I need help raising $100,000 by the end of this month, and so far, we’re halfway there. So, The founding fathers didn’t intend for this to be a one-party democracy. There hasn’t been much competition in Minnesota politics lately. I think there is no better person to take on the Democratic establishment than a former Navy SEAL and Marine Corps veteran. subject: You’re Invited: Microsoft Researchers, Dean Ball, and Industry Discuss AI & Biosecurity
body:
Event explores the widening gap between biosecurity and AI capabilities

| | | | | |

| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | **You’re Invited: Microsoft Researchers, Dean Ball, and Industry Discuss AI & Biosecurity** _Event explores the widening gap between biosecurity and AI capabilities_
This month, new research exposed how AI has created loopholes in the screening process for synthetic proteins that can be used to create biological weapons. While the loophole has since been patched, scientists are ringing the alarm about the widening gap between AI’s protein design capabilities and current security practices.
On Wednesday, October 29, **join ARI for a virtual panel on AI and biosecurity** with leading experts, including an author of the recent research from Microsoft exposing new biosecurity loopholes in the AI era.
---
| [Register for the Virtual Panel](https://responsibleinnovation.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=5ae332bf75&e=a07d75591f)

| | **The New Arms Race: The Widening Gap Between Biosecurity and AI Capabilities** _Virtual Panel_ Time: 3:00PM - 4:00PM ETDate: Wednesday, October 29, 2025[RSVP Here](https://responsibleinnovation.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=3ead16568c&e=a07d75591f)
The upcoming panel features experts and authors of the latest research exposing new biosecurity loopholes in the AI era, including:

* **Bruce Wittman,**__ Senior Applied Scientist, Office of the Chief Scientific Officer, Microsoft
* **Dean Ball,** Senior Fellow, Foundation for American Innovation; former Senior Policy Advisor for Artificial Intelligence and Emerging Technology, White House Office of Science and Technology Policy
* **Adam Clore,** Director of Technology R&D, Integrated DNA Technologies
* **James Diggans,** Vice President of Policy and Biosecurity, Twist Bioscience and Chair, International Gene Synthesis Consortium
* **Rachel Hovde** _(Moderator)_ , Policy Director, ARI

---
| |
This panel is open to the press and the public. The event will include a discussion with expert panelists followed by Q&A with live questions from attendees.

On Wednesday, October 29, join ARI for a virtual panel on AI and biosecurity with leading experts, including an author of the recent research from Microsoft exposing new biosecurity loopholes in the AI era. | | | The New Arms Race: The Widening Gap Between Biosecurity and AI Capabilities Virtual Panel Time: 3:00PM - 4:00PM ETDate: Wednesday, October 29, 2025 The upcoming panel features experts and authors of the latest research exposing new biosecurity loopholes in the AI era, including: Bruce Wittman, Senior Applied Scientist, Office of the Chief Scientific Officer, Microsoft Dean Ball, Senior Fellow, Foundation for American Innovation; former Senior Policy Advisor for Artificial Intelligence and Emerging Technology, White House Office of Science and Technology Policy Adam Clore, Director of Technology R&D, Integrated DNA Technologies James Diggans, Vice President of Policy and Biosecurity, Twist Bioscience and Chair, International Gene Synthesis Consortium Rachel Hovde (Moderator)_ , Policy Director, ARI | | This panel is open to the press and the public. The event will include a discussion with expert panelists followed by Q&A with live questions from attendees. | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Copyright © 2025 American for Responsible Innovation. Dear Peter,
Over a week ago, Trump and his allies shut down the federal government, severely impacting our communities and environment. This government shutdown means higher costs, less access to life-saving healthcare, unattended and unprotected public lands, and people out of work. It provides Republicans with the perfect opportunity to cut clean energy projects and jobs, allow the oil and gas industry to take over our public lands, and pursue Trump’s energy agenda that dirties our air and increases utility costs.
During the shutdown, the Trump Administration has already proposed another major funding cut for clean energy projects all in blue states, losing Oregon over $400 million for these very projects ( read more [https://www.nytimes.com/2025/10/02/climate/doe-clean-energy-programs-shutdown.html?unlocked_article_code=1.qU8.AD_Q.vwEsrzDOPhpI&smid=url-share] ).
We need your help, Peter. The consequences of this federal government shut down could be severe if our state does not take action. Will you make a generous contribution of $ 20 now to keep Oregon home? [https://secure.everyaction.com/rbY6SfJn4EmZpm6v2q-QSw2?am=20&contactdata=WL3WBl0xFEFH1zJs0LovBTkQ3HEG+FnWLeJ5b9IFBRXbFPNUglz8fUg1D+GapNGLdbjMBPP0hj/O9jPcNIiTy4VaYFB6n++kptNz/zTuApbdBS3A2xXlVV/RBWJMmymu]
Renew your membership [https://secure.everyaction.com/rbY6SfJn4EmZpm6v2q-QSw2?am=20&contactdata=WL3WBl0xFEFH1zJs0LovBTkQ3HEG+FnWLeJ5b9IFBRXbFPNUglz8fUg1D+GapNGLdbjMBPP0hj/O9jPcNIiTy4VaYFB6n++kptNz/zTuApbdBS3A2xXlVV/RBWJMmymu]
Our work here in Oregon is more important than ever. Just last week, Governor Tina Kotek signed an Executive Order to speed up the permitting process for clean energy projects, ensuring that they will be underway before the tax credit deadline next year — another Trump administration attack.
Now is the moment for our state lawmakers to take action. Oregon can stand up to Trump and his anti-climate agenda. We have already taken our first steps.
It’s crucial that our state lawmakers take action, but we need your support [https://secure.everyaction.com/rbY6SfJn4EmZpm6v2q-QSw2] to continue applying pressure on them to protect our environment and health, and bring relief to Oregonians. Oregon must be a leader on climate, and an example to the rest of the country of what climate action looks like.
Please, renew your membership and make your impact in this movement with a generous gift of $20 now. [https://secure.everyaction.com/rbY6SfJn4EmZpm6v2q-QSw2]
Renew your membership [https://secure.everyaction.com/rbY6SfJn4EmZpm6v2q-QSw2?am=20&contactdata=WL3WBl0xFEFH1zJs0LovBTkQ3HEG+FnWLeJ5b9IFBRXbFPNUglz8fUg1D+GapNGLdbjMBPP0hj/O9jPcNIiTy4VaYFB6n++kptNz/zTuApbdBS3A2xXlVV/RBWJMmymu]
Join us to work together to keep Oregon the home we know and love, ensuring we stick to the commitments we value. The situation is dire, and now is the time to give and take a stand for Oregon. This will take all of us, but if we each contribute what we can, there’s so much we can do for our home.
Our work begins with you . Thank you for making it possible.
In solidarity,

name: LaMonica McIver
subject: Fighting Trump’s charges against me in court
body:
Friend –

Today, I'm appearing in court to keep fighting the baseless charges
brought against me by the Trump administration. This case is
precedent-setting and it will shape the future of our democracy.

I am being targeted for doing my oversight work at an ICE facility. The
Trump administration wants to punish political opponents and anyone who
speaks up, silence dissent, drain me of my resources with an expensive
legal battle, and put me in prison for up to 17 years. Even in the face of
all this, I will not stop fighting.

[ https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20251021-1.APLqvx&refcode=em20251021-2423&amount=5&t=1001&akid=2423%2E21716%2Eg4TIsJ ]Can I count on you to pitch in to Sarah McBride and me to help fight
back? We need your help to amass the resources to keep fighting this legal
battle in court.

While I am not guilty of these charges, I am facing real prison time and a
long, expensive court fight. What’s more, the outcome of this case will
impact how public officials can be targeted by the administration. Mine is
the first prosecution like this from the Trump administration, but we know
it won’t be the last.

Today, we argue our motions to dismiss this case in court. I need you
standing with me.

[ https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20251021-1.APLqvx&refcode=em20251021-2423&amount=5&t=1020&akid=2423%2E21716%2Eg4TIsJ ]Donate $5 »

The stakes couldn’t be higher: this case is about whether or not the Trump
administration gets to silence the voices that challenge it.

I will not fold and I will keep standing up because our democracy is on
the line.

This is a warning shot for more authoritarian action, and we can’t let
them win.

They want to make an example out of me, but I refuse to back down.

We’re not backing down,

LaMonica

body:
#
Peter, we just launched our campaign for Governor of Texas and we’re off to a Texas-sized start.
It’s 100% clear: Texas is ready to end the era of Greg Abbott’s corruption.
[**If you’re with us, will you split $5 between James Talarico’s campaign for U.S. Senate and my campaign for Governor now?**](https://act.jamestalarico.com/go/512?c0=jt-em-hinojosa.lE1Qia&refcode=em251021-1-ak&t=1&akid=184%2E1347274%2Ewz9ZBp)
[DONATE](https://act.jamestalarico.com/go/512?c0=jt-em-hinojosa.lE1Qia&refcode=em251021-1-ak&t=2&akid=184%2E1347274%2Ewz9ZBp)
I’m running for Governor because we’re in the fight of our lives in Texas. Our families, our schools, and our future are all on the line. And we know good and well that we can’t count on Greg Abbott to fight for us when it really matters.
Greg Abbott doesn’t work for Texans like you and me. He works for the special interests, big corporations, and the billionaire donors who fund his campaigns.
It won’t be easy, but we can beat Abbott and the GOP if we aren’t afraid of a tough fight. We’re Texans. We never back down — and we’re not about to start now.
If you’re with us, here’s why it’s so important that you show your support TODAY:
* Greg Abbott has a giant warchest and a network of national GOP donors.
* Republicans and the media will be sizing us up as opposition starting now.
* This is going to be a very expensive race, so we have zero time to waste.

[**Peter, become a Founding Donor to my campaign. Split $5 between James Talarico’s campaign and my campaign now.**](https://act.jamestalarico.com/go/512?c0=jt-em-hinojosa.lE1Qia&refcode=em251021-1-ak&t=3&akid=184%2E1347274%2Ewz9ZBp)
[DONATE](https://act.jamestalarico.com/go/512?c0=jt-em-hinojosa.lE1Qia&refcode=em251021-1-ak&t=4&akid=184%2E1347274%2Ewz9ZBp)
We’re going to turn the page on the GOP’s decades of failed leadership and make Texas work for Texans again. This is a fight we can win together. Let’s do this, y’all.
Thank you for your early support,
Gina Hinojosa
Candidate for Governor of Texas

body:
We won’t be scared into submission. | | | Peter — The administration is weaponizing the military against our communities — it’s happening all over the country. Like we saw in Los Angeles earlier this year, militarization efforts are taking place in cities like Chicago and Portland to try to quiet our people and scare our movement into submission. **It won’t work.** Our communities are united in support of the immigrants who power this country and each other — and we see it every day. Neighbors are coming together to defend each other and expel hate from our communities, students are advocating for justice on behalf of their detained peers, and everyday heroes are stepping up to inform, engage, and support their communities. **People across the country are seeing costs go up. And the administration spends countless dollars on militarizing our communities instead of funding healthcare, education, and other resources we need to thrive.** For this to change, we need everyone on board. As a member of Congress, I'm going to be unwavering in my fight for our communities.
I will not vote for authoritarian bills in the name of "compromise," I will not abandon or demonize vulnerable groups to cater to the right, and I will not change my stances for fear of retaliation.
