body:
In Argentina, President Milei has transformed the state-run kids' channel Pakapaka to feature The Tuttle Twins, a cartoon that teaches children about capitalism, inflation, limited government, and the "evils of taxes."

|
---
| | [](https://email.alert.conservativelibertywire.com/c/eJyc0DGOszAQBeDTmA5kD9iEwsUvRXT52y3RZDwQS8ZGxgTl9qtEuxfYdkbv6dP7uk039MHH5T-ubCmcU94nxzNHF_ydc3lhdAsXpLS90gQSdK1kDWracto3pjLpyll9AR5MxVb1RsleD4OuHraXPc0KiIxUdL_0WnZIRrPTDIwGK2_fhUqCUkOn4dLQXc3kTD84PWiGWXQSA-fSUIo75ycW_-Qf2OkzN5TWKthHKdsu2n8CRgHjznRkbjCyS-_kKmCc0xEdFp9iPadcM6WYVk81u4M-ZwHjhnXAU7TjUdaJcN3QL1G011-jAPP5pFg4FtFeKZxVtm47fQh-N73o5LKiDx9V-euaTwvfAQAA___V64hU) Friend,

In Argentina, President Milei has transformed the state-run kids' channel Pakapaka to feature The Tuttle Twins, a cartoon that teaches children about capitalism, inflation, limited government, and the "evils of taxes."

A government using state-run resources to promote freedom from government... Hilarious!

One of the thinkers The Tuttle Twins spotlights is Frederic Bastiat, the 19th-century French economist whose masterwork, _The Law,_ remains one of the most powerful defenses of individual liberty ever written.

Here's the beautiful irony: if Bastiat were alive today, _The Law_ itself would tell Milei to shut down Pakapaka entirely.

Why? Because _The Law_ argues that the government's only legitimate purpose is to protect life, liberty, and private property -- not to run television channels.

I was introduced to _The Law_ not long before attending my first seminar hosted by Foundation for Economic Education (FEE) when I was a young college student over 20 years ago.

Now, two decades later, I'm the president of FEE -- where our mission is to inspire, educate, and connect future leaders with the economic, ethical, and legal principles of a free society.

_The Law_ is just one of the resources we use to teach these principles to the next generation, but I believe everyone should read this book.

[That's why anyone who donates $30 or more to support FEE's educational programs can get their own copy of The Law today! Through our FEE in the Classroom program, renowned professors and successful entrepreneurs introduce students to the freedom philosophy in classrooms across the country.

This program teaches students how the principles of liberty -- like those discussed in _The Law _-- benefit everyone and why they are essential to a prosperous society. body:
|
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117722556/577420400/148511826?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMGM3ZjQ3Mi1iNmFlLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FdD4nVRI4FcVqhz2eKmCyGtB_eftxqkG4hDc8CXeZpo=)
Peter,

I was proud to join thousands of Californians on Saturday at the No Kings rallies in the Santa Clarita and Antelope Valleys.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117722557/577420401/148511826?refcode=em-10.21.25-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMGM3ZjQ3Mi1iNmFlLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FdD4nVRI4FcVqhz2eKmCyGtB_eftxqkG4hDc8CXeZpo=)
I was inspired by the many veterans, young people, and patriots who spent their day peacefully making their voices heard. They shared their concerns with me about the future of our democracy, healthcare affordability, and the economy.

There’s a lot of uncertainty right now. We’re entering the third week of the government shutdown, with no end in sight as Republicans refuse to come to the table.

Thousands of families stand to see their healthcare premiums skyrocket or even lose their healthcare entirely while Republicans prioritize their billionaire donors and appease the Trump White House. Thousands of federal workers and active military are working without pay.

While there’s a lot of work to be done, standing shoulder to shoulder with my concerned fellow citizens gave me hope – and the drive to continue to do right by CA-27.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117722558/577420403/148511826?refcode=em-10.21.25-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMGM3ZjQ3Mi1iNmFlLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FdD4nVRI4FcVqhz2eKmCyGtB_eftxqkG4hDc8CXeZpo=)

Hi, it’s Oregon Secretary of State Tobias Read. Let’s be clear about what’s happening right now.
Donald Trump has demanded Oregon’s voter data — the private information of every single voter in this state. He’s sent troops onto Portland streets. And when Oregonians stood up and said No Kings, his administration treated peaceful protesters like enemies of the state.
If that doesn’t set off alarms, it should. This is not normal. This is not democracy. This is a test of whether states like ours will bow to authoritarian pressure or stand up and defend the people we serve.
I’m determined that Oregon will meet that test head-on with the courage and conviction needed to prevail. That’s what I’ve worked to do each and every day as your Secretary of State. But I need steadfast grassroots support to keep up the fight, so I’m asking you personally to join me in this fight by chipping in $10, $25, or more right now. Can I count on you? I’ve said it before and I’ll say it again: Oregon doesn’t take orders from bullies who think they’re kings.
We don’t hand over voter data so it can be used to target, intimidate, or disenfranchise citizens.
We don’t let federal troops trample our streets and call it “law and order.”
And we don’t back down when our rights, our voters, and our values are under attack.
But standing up takes resources. And I need your help to keep doing it. Every single dollar you give helps us fight back and keep Oregon strong, independent, and unafraid. Chip in today and show Donald Trump that Oregon has no kings. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=251021-nk]

**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
🚨 **ICYMI, Day 4** of the **Douglas County Dirty Dozen** is out now... Meet Kyrzia Parker — a self-described “kink-allied therapist” backed by the teachers union. From drag shows to woke baby books, voters will now decide if her policies belong in our schools. Watch the latest video and follow along on [X](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), [Instagram](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), [Facebook](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) & [TikTok](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)!
Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** Denver police arrested 12 protesters [during “No Kings” demonstrations](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), emphasizing zero tolerance for property damage. Fort Collins is set to debut [ranked-choice voting in November](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), a first for the city. El Paso County transferred [26 individuals with criminal charges to ICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) custody—setting a record—while the state [banned cheaters and violent offenders](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) from casinos. In northern Colorado, [Poudre School District board candidates](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) are clashing over parental rights and curriculum transparency.
🇺🇸 **On the National Stage...**[Voting tech firm Smartmatic](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and its parent company were indicted for allegedly bribing foreign officials and laundering funds. Authorities are investigating [a possible attempt on President Trump’s life](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) after a hunting stand was discovered overlooking Air Force One’s landing path in Florida. [New data shows violent crime](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) has dipped overall but murders and car thefts remain well above pre-pandemic levels—especially in blue-run cities—while renewed scrutiny of [Special Counsel Jack Smith’s tactics](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) shows how his politicized prosecutions backfired, fueling public backlash that helped propel Trump’s 2024 victory.
🗣️ **Commentary Spotlight...** Complete Colorado warns a proposed “progressive” income tax [would cripple Colorado’s economy](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), while national commentary examines [Democrats’ failure to connect](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) with male voters. Russ Minary’s _“Every Day in America Is ‘No Kings Day’”_ condemns anti-Trump protests as [misinformed attacks on constitutional order](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), and Cory Gaines [defends the opt-in model](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for the Healthy Kids Colorado Survey. And three state lawmakers are backing 40 counties [urging the state to “Fund It or Fix It,”](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) demanding fiscal honesty instead of unfunded mandates that strain local governments.
This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday, October 21, 2025.
– Team RMV

**[Pueblo’s game changer: 2C asks who should run the city—a professional or a politician](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Pueblo is about to decide–as Randy Thurston puts it—whether power belongs to a politician or a professional. On Unleashed with Heidi Ganahl: Pueblo pushback: the mayor, the vote & the battle for Colorado’s soul, Thurston, a former city councilman and broker called 2C “one of the most massive game changers” Pueblo has faced in decades.
If approved, 2C would eliminate the strong-mayor system adopted seven years ago and return the city to a professional manager model—where council hires an administrator to run daily operations instead of leaving those duties to one elected office.

**[‘No Kings’ 2.0 Protest Brings Arrests and Tighter Security](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Denver police arrested 12 protesters during follow-up “No Kings” demonstrations after thousands marched downtown, with charges including assault on an officer, aggravated assault, and vandalism.
* Officers declared the gathering an unlawful assembly, deploying smoke and pepper balls after protesters attempted to enter highways and ignored dispersal orders.
* The Denver protest was part of a nationwide wave of “No Kings” rallies, with over 50 events across Colorado and hundreds more throughout the U.S.

**[Colorado must stop pushing unfunded laws on local governments, lawmakers say](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE DAILY SENTINEL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Lawmakers Rick Taggart, Janice Rich, and Matt Soper argue that unfunded state mandates are straining Colorado’s counties, costing more than $360 million annually and forcing local governments to cut essential services.
* They urge the legislature to “Fund It or Fix It”—ensuring that any new state law comes with sustainable funding and that fiscal notes reflect real-world local costs.
* The authors emphasize bipartisan unity, with nearly 40 counties joining the effort, warning that unfunded mandates break public trust and leave local governments unable to serve their communities effectively.

**[EVERY Day In America Is ‘No Kings Day’—READ the U.S. Constitution](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**BY RUSS MINARY | COMMENTARY | OCTOBER 20** _“It ain’t what you don’t know that gets you into trouble. It’s what you know for sure that just ain’t so.” Mark Twain may or may not have said it, but whoever did certainly had a valid point. Today in 2025, many people seem to know a lot that just ain’t so. Over the weekend, thousands of people gathered in cities across the U.S. for a series of “No Kings” rallies and protests._
**[Ready, Aim, Fire: How the Shoes of Peace Keep Us Steady During Chaos](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY DRAKE HUNTER | COMMENTARY | OCTOBER 19** _Last week, Sherrie and I were traveling to Florida. Many know my wife has Stage 4 brain cancer, and because of that, she’s mostly immobilized. clean_body: | Friend, It meant so much to be surrounded by people who care so deeply about our country’s future this weekend at No Kings Day events. = In Chesaning, Flint, and communities all across Michigan, people came together to remind ourselves of the principles that this nation was founded on: freedom for all, equality under the law, and a government that answers to the people – not to one person. We’re living through a moment when those principles are being tested. When political power is being used to divide, not unite. When too many in Washington would rather serve the wealthy and well-connected than the families working hard to get by. And here in MI-08 – a district Donald Trump won – the stakes couldn’t be more clear. If we want to retake the gavel and put a meaningful check on President Trump’s administration, we need to flip the House. The future of Social Security, abortion rights, and our children’s education could all come down to what happens right here – and that’s no exaggeration, friend. = Unfortunately, Republicans have already poured nearly a million dollars into attacks against me – and more are on the way. Cori recently sat down with Joy Reid for one of the most powerful and personal conversations she’s ever had.
They talked about everything: the $15 million AIPAC-backed campaign that she took on, the threats she faced for calling for a ceasefire in Gaza, the pressure from within her own party to stay silent, and what it really means to fight unapologetically for all of us.
It was real. It was raw. It was truth.
It’s worth the watch. Click the image below or watch here [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cab_email-joyreidshow?refcode=x_251021_joyreid_act] .
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cab_email-joyreidshow?refcode=x_251021_joyreid_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cab_email-joyreidshow?refcode=x_251021_joyreid_act]
These conversations are precisely why the powerful media companies removed Joy Reid’s voice off the airwaves. Not because she lacked viewers or impact. But because she told the truth, and now she’s curating a space for herself and for people like Cori who do the same.
That’s what makes them both dangerous to the status quo. Because one thing about them: true fighters always get back up, and that’s exactly what Cori has done time and time again.
Cori’s running to reclaim our seat for the people of St. Louis, who deserve a representative who will never sell out or stay silent.
Yes, the forces she’s up against haven’t gone anywhere. But neither have we.
Powerful corporate interests are bowing down to the Trump Administration and trying to silence those like Joy and Cori who would take them on. The only way to fight back is to build our own communities, our own megaphones, and our own campaigns. That takes all of us – and the time to start is now, before it's too late.
Every dollar we raise right now is part of critical early investments that allow us to build a campaign that can win next year. And then we'll have a fighter for all of us in Congress. Chip in now to help Cori keep speaking truth to power >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cab_email-joyreidshow?refcode=x_251021_joyreid_act]
DONATE TODAY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cab_email-joyreidshow?refcode=x_251021_joyreid_act]
Because when they cancel truth-tellers, we get louder. And when they try to silence our movement, we organize.
Join us. Stand with Cori. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cab_email-joyreidshow?refcode=x_251021_joyreid_act]
— Team Cori

### A love letter to Michigan
| | [Haley Stevens](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---
| Oct 21
---

---

If you know me, you know I believe in hard work, staying scrappy, and always remembering your North Star.
For me, that's easy: _**It 's Michigan.**_
I love this state. I love what I do. And I love _who_ I do it for.
This campaign - and the work and calling of my life - is about fighting for Michiganders.
It's for the autoworkers in Flat Rock. The small-business owners in Pontiac. The teachers in Grand Rapids, the retirees in Marquette, the nurses in Flint. It's for the working families busting their tails every day in every corner of Michigan, all hoping to build a future where their kids can thrive.
It's for the Great Lakes, where we learned to swim. The diners in Detroit, where we ate Coney dogs and made memories. The games at Ford Field, summers up north, and the manufacturers across our state who put America on four wheels.
**This campaign is for you, Michigan. It 's **_**always**_**been for you.**
I've never forgotten where I come from - not when I was working to save the auto industry in the Obama administration, not when I'm sitting at my desk fighting for Michigan in Congress, and certainly not now as I ask you to help me have the honor of being Michigan's next U.S. senator - our state's chief lawmaker and champion.
I know the Michigan way. It's grit. It's hard work. It's about listening to your neighbor, learning from your community, and then leading with the same doggedness that built this state brick by brick.
**And that 's what it's going to take to win this race.**
Because here's the truth: A Texas GOP billionaire has already funneled $5 million into a super PAC backing my MAGA opponent, Mike Rogers. Trump has already endorsed him, because Mike Rogers will rubber stamp his agenda. And the latest polls show we're neck and neck - Michigan is officially a "Toss-Up."
As a multi-millionaire, MAGA Mike's agenda shows how detached he is from working Michiganders - he doesn't care about rising costs from Trump's tariffs that are hurting hardworking folks. **He 's sold Michigan out before, and he'll do it again.**
We've got our work cut out for us, but I'm ready. I know who I'm fighting for.
**Michigan.** This place. _My people._
So thank you - for reading, for believing, and for being part of this journey with me.
If you're with me, I'd be honored if you'd chip in to help keep this grassroots campaign going strong. Truly, I'd be grateful for any amount:

With love and grit,
Haley

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

In Argentina, President Milei has transformed the state-run kids' channel Pakapaka to feature The Tuttle Twins, a cartoon that teaches children about capitalism, inflation, limited government, and the "evils of taxes."

A government using state-run resources to promote freedom from government... Hilarious!

One of the thinkers The Tuttle Twins spotlights is Frederic Bastiat, the 19th-century French economist whose masterwork, _The Law,_ remains one of the most powerful defenses of individual liberty ever written.

Here's the beautiful irony: if Bastiat were alive today, _The Law_ itself would tell Milei to shut down Pakapaka entirely.

Why? Because _The Law_ argues that the government's only legitimate purpose is to protect life, liberty, and private property -- not to run television channels.

I was introduced to _The Law_ not long before attending my first seminar hosted by Foundation for Economic Education (FEE) when I was a young college student over 20 years ago.

Now, two decades later, I'm the president of FEE -- where our mission is to inspire, educate, and connect future leaders with the economic, ethical, and legal principles of a free society.

_The Law_ is just one of the resources we use to teach these principles to the next generation, but I believe everyone should read this book.

name: AOC
subject: Why I fight the way I do in Congress
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
I recently visited the National Hispanic Institute for an 85th birthday celebration in Texas where we honored Ernesto Nieto, NHI’s founder, with a Congressional Record proclamation.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/34991?t=1&akid=10004%2E2526796%2EKx8eCI)
Surrounded by students, NHI alumni, and mentors, I was reminded that NHI isn’t just an organization — it’s a family.
When I was 16 years old, I joined NHI. **I didn’t know it at the time, but it would change everything**.
At NHI’s Lorenzo de Zavala Youth Legislative program, I learned lessons that still guide me to this day: our culture is a source of strength, leadership comes from community, and **when people come together, we can build power that no one can take away**.
NHI is a major reason why I ran for Congress, and why we’ve been successful.
We didn’t have any of the conventional things you’re “supposed” to have when you run for office. No big donors, no party machine behind us. We had the concept of Nieto’s “Third Reality” — making your own breaks and not waiting for anyone’s permission.
That asset-based mindset — **seeing our communities as powerful, not deficient** — was instilled in me at NHI, and it helped shape the presence we have in our community.
And it’s why I fight the way I do in Congress: because I know firsthand what happens when you give young people the tools and confidence to lead. You change their lives.
I want every young person to feel what I felt at the National Hispanic Institute — **that their voice matters and their future is worth our continued investment**.
[Will you chip in $5 to the National Hispanic Institute so we can keep building the leaders of tomorrow? That’s exactly how this movement continues to gather momentum and grow.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/34991?t=2&akid=10004%2E2526796%2EKx8eCI)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/34991?t=3&akid=10004%2E2526796%2EKx8eCI)**
In solidarity,
Alexandria

clean_body: I recently visited the National Hispanic Institute for an 85th birthday celebration in Texas where we honored Ernesto Nieto, NHI’s founder, with a Congressional Record proclamation. Surrounded by students, NHI alumni, and mentors, I was reminded that NHI isn’t just an organization — it’s a family. When I was 16 years old, I joined NHI. I didn’t know it at the time, but it would change everything. At NHI’s Lorenzo de Zavala Youth Legislative program, I learned lessons that still guide me to this day: our culture is a source of strength, leadership comes from community, and when people come together, we can build power that no one can take away. NHI is a major reason why I ran for Congress, and why we’ve been successful. We didn’t have any of the conventional things you’re “supposed” to have when you run for office. No big donors, no party machine behind us. We had the concept of Nieto’s “Third Reality” — making your own breaks and not waiting for anyone’s permission. That asset-based mindset — seeing our communities as powerful, not deficient — was instilled in me at NHI, and it helped shape the presence we have in our community. And it’s why I fight the way I do in Congress: because I know firsthand what happens when you give young people the tools and confidence to lead. You change their lives. I want every young person to feel what I felt at the National Hispanic Institute — that their voice matters and their future is worth our continued investment. In solidarity, Alexandria | ---|--- | | | ---|---|---|--- Email us: mailto: speak@ocasiocortez.com

name: Marjorie Taylor Greene
subject: I’m being targeted by a disinformation campaign
body:
It’s so obvious.
| | | | Friend – I know when I’m being targeted.
I’ve been around DC long enough to recognize the signs. The attacks I am facing today are not organic. This isn’t random criticism.
**It’s strategic. And it’s heavily funded.**
They’re trying to flood the zone with lies. Smear campaigns. Bot attacks. Shadowy “news” stories that read like DNC press releases. It’s coming from all directions —** _and it’s coming fast._**
Who’s behind it?
Could be **deep-pocketed RINOs** who can’t take it when I don’t get on board with the corporate wing of my own party.
Could be **Democrat operatives** trying to soften the battlefield before the midterms or 2028.
Could even be **foreign actors** , hoping to fracture our movement from the inside out.
**Whoever it is — they’re spending real money to try and silence me.**
Why? Because I tell the truth. Because I don’t play the DC game. Because I won’t bow to lobbyists, corporate media, or the Swamp...
I represent **the people...** **_Not_****the Washington, D.C. elites.**
**_[And because I stand with YOU — the America First patriots they despise](https://link.email.greene4congress.)_****.**
I’m digging to get to the bottom of this. I will find out who’s pulling the strings.
**_But right now, I need something from you..._**
**[I need as many patriots as I can get – before midnight – to sign the “I STAND WITH MTG” letter and show the people organizing this disinformation campaign against me that it isn’t working >>>](https://link.email.greene4congress.)**
---
[STAND WITH MTG](https://link.email.greene4congress.)
I’m not asking because it’s convenient...**I’m asking because this moment matters.**
I need to know **I’m not alone in this fight,** and the people launching these attacks need to know **it’s not going to work.**
**_[If you’ve ever believed in the work I’m doing — exposing corruption, fighting for our values, standing up to the uniparty — now is the time to show it](https://link.email.greene4congress.)_****.**
_In the Fight,_
| | [](https://link.email.greene4congress.)
---
**Marjorie Taylor Greene**

clean_body: I’m counting on you right now My situation is in your hands, Peter.I’m writing today to give you an update and to make a humble plea. Look – this is from the bottom of my heart, so please read this message to the end.My team and I put together a historic win in 2021 to help flip all three of Virginia’s highest offices red. Ever since becoming Lt. Governor, I’ve been logging big wins for my friends, neighbors, and every fellow Virginian. Now, I’m running for Governor so we can continue to keep up the amazing work we’ve been doing here in the Commonwealth and make history again.But right now I have a few SERIOUS challenges:I was legally barred from accepting even a dime in support of my campaign while I was in the Virginia legislative session. But my Democrat opponent, Abigail Spanberger, has been fundraising BIG TIME while I’ve been working hard in our capital. Seriously, a far-Left group injected $500K into Abigail Spanberger’s campaign coffers and there wasn’t a thing I could do in response!Now Spanberger has an ENORMOUS fundraising advantage, Peter. Polls show this race is tied, but Spanberger has a serious cash advantage. If we don’t make up the difference, our conservative mission will be cut short. Today, I’m making a plea to you as a Christian, a mother, and a Marine; please send in any amount you can spare to support my campaignWithout your support, we will fall even further behind. The Democrat elitists will log a win and our Commonwealth will regress down a path to irreversible socialism!I wouldn’t ask you to stay in this fight if I didn’t think it was worth it. And Peter, I know we will win if we hold strong and fight this battle together. you can’t afford to keep fighting for the future of our Commonwealth, our children, and our nation, am asking you from the bottom of my heart; please stick with me and help us keep the conservative movement thriving!Ever Forward,Lt. Patriot, When I heard of Charlie Kirk, he wasn't famous. He wasn't filling arenas. He wasn't a household name. A few people told me, _" You've gotta meet this guy -- he's doing something big out in Illinois."_ So I went. Charlie was running Turning Point from a modest office in the Chicago suburbs -- surviving on coffee and pure belief that America was still worth saving.
| [ ](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=05df8b6005ec49478c25d23a01430cf0&_e=T-8_sZHylgKuupmwzwXtbDbOfvyIpGYiq457WTfMNbViIEozClhMarSUCw-0Ycbx_Ki4V6wxXRR5NpvIzpuywv9hMgyBvNyY8W-p7RvBfmrPIILBLUJpsF0S4P3e5o4_2uHtmxx5YItI0aRDihKxrDMcdmATTwK3zNOaPKpAnGUoHfHhPZfciotakbHoau906yUqpd_vck5Vhb4qMcyys1pjog-x49Henz2oTUd0duRnAJlFBTuasaJ5l6oLAnjgFNgytYHm6QaVrn5Kf6CqwlfuFA--hgjfC0fBPZn6ooQVfLq5g9mqnoYoE3nRA4tKYQHZRw7eDnGIT8NLi1-GuzCtNzf_gtvd3LzNtN0akpkv1wv0U_H5Sc09Iqit3XrxQKMPSse7EgqSY4VvVbOiQPKbNTVLrMq1u8MS8hCSSlKxgYQcqxWEozeJMw-WQoONk2HkpwYiWEWvsfKNkWBTJppsEzilHCVy3oKob0olvNeuO93q57PfPE6o1HpqVBrK3_ydCaNzx1WRjFIbFjlzthEpBZJYfQC3of9jaqFwviDcuvX2Wqj-kNYkWeh6DaiEVA6t7pH_Ny8IIaz7aguruE6HYR2Cl9OxOXi-H4UeHtydn1HksRPX6cf6LpMrzZd4YqHeN_56Z06H0bf_iZ5NkmzYYLm_sOhn5AaFGWTOeSC4fNtk0YTlMZb59sLShqEiNj3iwRjgyDM2XF_t6XjOSQ%3D%3D)
---
_**Above:** The original Turning Point HQ in Lemont, Illinois. This is where it all began -- just Charlie, a vision, and a mission that changed everything. _
Back then, we were both organizing young conservatives, both dreaming about how to win back the culture. But when I first sat down with Charlie... _I knew._ Charlie was the visionary. He had the plan. And I HAD to be part of it. I jumped in and never looked back. From that moment on, I was there for all of it. The early conferences and campuses. The road trips. The rallies. The fights. In those days, our team didn't have much. But what we had was conviction -- and that was more than enough. Because we believed in something BIG. Something real. Something urgent. **Faith, family, freedom** -- and the absolute grit to go build something that could save this country. And Charlie? _He did it._ He didn't just build a brand... _He built a machine._ First, Charlie built a movement that changed the hearts and minds of an entire generation -- a seismic shift that flipped the narrative that young people belonged to the Left. Then, he built Turning Point Action to become the grassroots force the Left never saw coming... and beat them at their own game. And, I hitched my wagon to it _from the start._ Charlie and I weren't just friends... We were brothers in the fight. We did everything together.
| [ ](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=05df8b6005ec49478c25d23a01430cf0&_e=T-8_sZHylgKuupmwzwXtbDbOfvyIpGYiq457WTfMNbViIEozClhMarSUCw-0Ycbx_Ki4V6wxXRR5NpvIzpuywv9hMgyBvNyY8W-p7RvBfmrPIILBLUJpsF0S4P3e5o4_2uHtmxx5YItI0aRDihKxrDMcdmATTwK3zNOaPKpAnGUoHfHhPZfciotakbHoau906yUqpd_vck5Vhb4qMcyys1pjog-x49Henz2oTUd0duRnAJlFBTuasaJ5l6oLAnjgHlMz3XLFfCCNh7wWskyueGexAxhtbIUSZVpqmzDFUvOf9PDzxpbyXKYG-rLhpGeAWzRbE8SxAKOzHJzHiLIHJyH9IrAnmPkZkjBHTPHVHIdg4kItxjfsbm2LDm9RGXdDu6EpGVZZNyD8KOpxp_nQAJtmSvZxTZ0Pb32T7Wkw8aUU2RkWD7VngbXhImY6I0h1UsliJAMdeza3AyCjabiVSMtjyYVuzMQHQi0YxRvUehCRmAEKW-m9ZDVIDOIunMxDwcd-e5NZtMg_nAkUq85YqFG4oN1Mbp4qY1rrcvAH1oU1OpUGtQZ-c5kPSsM6mt7Iz__captwLFMMRAmHYbH7z3aKDkqbRt7p2VwnXcqPHtJenpq0hQflE1MNHaBUliHtdScPc5-4vvbjziebZ_QTScrziy141tK1WbHxQzvjVIvfYF1YSfGmLA3X9l_f223gdT9z4gKAPL68_flss_YhpQ%3D%3D)

We strategized over midnight texts... battled together through COVID, the 2020 Election, and every crisis they threw at us... We created AmericaFest from scratch... launched Turning Point Action to go on offense -- in the very states the GOP had given up on. **And we rallied a grassroots army that put President Donald J. Trump back in the White House in 2024. ** We didn't just talk about chasing ballots... Turning Point Action built the first full-scale, professional ballot-chasing operation on the Right -- _and it delivered real results._ 10 for 10. **In every single state we operated in... Trump won.** In Arizona _alone,_ we chased over 205,000 low-propensity conservative votes -- well beyond the margin of victory. _In Wisconsin?_ 60,000+. _In Nevada?_ 6,000+ -- and we won back a district we hadn't carried in 20 years. _In Michigan?_ 14,000+ votes helped us flip a U.S. House seat and take the state house majority. We didn't just make noise... _We made history. _
| [ ](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=05df8b6005ec49478c25d23a01430cf0&_e=T-8_sZHylgKuupmwzwXtbDbOfvyIpGYiq457WTfMNbViIEozClhMarSUCw-0Ycbx_Ki4V6wxXRR5NpvIzpuywv9hMgyBvNyY8W-p7RvBfmrPIILBLUJpsF0S4P3e5o4_2uHtmxx5YItI0aRDihKxrDMcdmATTwK3zNOaPKpAnGUoHfHhPZfciotakbHoau906yUqpd_vck5Vhb4qMcyys1pjog-x49Henz2oTUd0duRnAJlFBTuasaJ5l6oLAnjgD87zPFS0dmEt0hj6mSSQIzDFGxKh_8ZyH6AGzDcDaA89JiGKYPvb5JPtUDfs0tYcHwFkw1pIXRvXHJeJPU4s2ljgK5i64lsb3wsWGj7b1LJntNIlGWXf34Eu68RH_Mn2UFAgdm-3VeJ3kdRguAJ65La9xbpD_u0OeqHEmYUDAiVzRteXNZSECETri6mweLbqE5bcZ36lPgbhbscChyw_0mly89bkHU6fvEzmkRhvqNDi3V5bAokWoZi4MbtEVUaBXcCBeGl2Gq3OIKKUIe4S7NPURo2ycab_r2J9wP2a81f-mayiKjGSv7LIcHNp4Q0qeHZEHV8QEC-1FX8WLvFBFX1eVrRq4rsgwgubL9P7Ze7RGUp3-pM35O3oV08iWow42BHz26ArSgnrBwFLXJH2Os1NJybhAf8jsnjEz5GTb71YMm6-loAKo6wP1B0OCjGSuAvyL9-iOVQXQyDLoRUHkw%3D%3D)
---
_**Above:** Election Night 2024. Our biggest win yet. That's me on the left -- still fighting beside Charlie, just like we always did. _
Patriot, I watched Charlie pour everything into this mission. He lived on the road 300+ days a year. We never stopped. _Because Charlie never stopped. _ He didn't build all of this for clout or clicks... Instead, he did it for this country. For all of us. For every parent who feels like they're losing their kid to the Left... For every student who's afraid to speak up... For every American who still believes in this country... Charlie built this movement and this machine for them. For you. And now? After he gave everything for that mission? **We have to carry the torch. We have to keep the machine running -- ****_and make it stronger than ever._** Everything we've felt since the day we lost Charlie -- _we must turn it into action._ He used to ask me (and everyone else at Turning Point) all the time: _" What are we building next?"_ **Well, Patriot, here 's the answer: We're building the next generation of grassroots power -- one voter, one precinct, one act of courage at a time.**
| [ ](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=05df8b6005ec49478c25d23a01430cf0&_e=T-8_sZHylgKuupmwzwXtbDbOfvyIpGYiq457WTfMNbViIEozClhMarSUCw-0Ycbx_Ki4V6wxXRR5NpvIzpuywv9hMgyBvNyY8W-p7RvBfmrPIILBLUJpsF0S4P3e5o4_2uHtmxx5YItI0aRDihKxrDMcdmATTwK3zNOaPKpAnGUoHfHhPZfciotakbHoau906yUqpd_vck5Vhb4qMcyys1pjog-x49Henz2oTUd0duRnAJlFBTuasaJ5l6oLAnjgPNUnULrSX8LPf1CjU0ajt7HuS-PSo8l1_PIgr8jOcnemZo8qpbpJLS2g8Zh2eZvpZDMNWOWfOseHUIeGKaeXS9TRKFdzVNyEFDxI6mEZf66YjrzBvq3hG_Jh9uXZlEW0z3A6fSMsVDdqdb8Rb65Z3cWi5re7oPadBiqcHisKBw08qpk4pD-_3OdJEMY73y2Tab7lZOkdrsWhakM5OUOtR7wPZ78IfGjDkkRuImgOtGNgR3OOvnRvFQt1r22nQ12LdtXQvjBztwJJGBFr7Z8_XJqKgYeczLJrmzgarcdnDNq0Q-fHh7FJxkP0UmqbhHJ_lABvMbYnDCKjRxL7qqsd3HK9ozdarqoL-AceGKOgY-zpowFvlu0yDGrl6stlxp7Ci5UGaZbK7BX0WntEjf--aWKVHyZ5Zdi04v3waFFmlWQCuXVyyqmsBtwS8mVCAErJRMY6jN4yRhV2kqn5HGSZDQ%3D%3D)
---
**But it doesn 't happen without you.** _So, here 's my ask..._ Go to church for Charlie. Start a family for Charlie. Join a chapter or coalition for Charlie. Register to vote for Charlie. Chase votes for Charlie. Run for office for Charlie. Commit to WIN. Commit to FIGHT. Commit to FINISH what he started. That's what Charlie would've wanted. I'm not stopping until we save our country. I'm all in -- and if you're reading this, I'm betting that you are, too. If so, I'm honored to fight alongside you. And if you've already been with us for a while -- thank you. Now, let's get to work.
**For Charlie.** **God Bless,** **Tyler Bowyer**

clean_body: A tribute to Charlie & Turning Point Action—see how to help and double your impact today. | | Patriot, When I heard of Charlie Kirk, he wasn't famous. He wasn't filling arenas. He wasn't a household name. A few people told me, " You've gotta meet this guy -- he's doing something big out in Illinois." So I went. Charlie was running Turning Point from a modest office in the Chicago suburbs -- surviving on coffee and pure belief that America was still worth saving. | Above: The original Turning Point HQ in Lemont, Illinois. This is where it all began -- just Charlie, a vision, and a mission that changed everything. Back then, we were both organizing young conservatives, both dreaming about how to win back the culture. But when I first sat down with Charlie... I knew. Charlie was the visionary. He had the plan. And I HAD to be part of it. I jumped in and never looked back. From that moment on, I was there for all of it. The early conferences and campuses. The road trips. The rallies. The fights. In those days, our team didn't have much. But what we had was conviction -- and that was more than enough. Because we believed in something BIG. Something real. Something urgent. Faith, family, freedom -- and the absolute grit to go build something that could save this country. And Charlie? He did it. He didn't just build a brand... He built a machine. First, Charlie built a movement that changed the hearts and minds of an entire generation -- a seismic shift that flipped the narrative that young people belonged to the Left. Then, he built Turning Point Action to become the grassroots force the Left never saw coming... and beat them at their own game. And, I hitched my wagon to it from the start. Charlie and I weren't just friends... We were brothers in the fight. We did everything together. | We strategized over midnight texts... battled together through COVID, the 2020 Election, and every crisis they threw at us... We created AmericaFest from scratch... launched Turning Point Action to go on offense -- in the very states the GOP had given up on. And we rallied a grassroots army that put President Donald J. Trump back in the White House in 2024. We didn't just talk about chasing ballots... Turning Point Action built the first full-scale, professional ballot-chasing operation on the Right -- and it delivered real results. 10 for 10. In every single state we operated in... Trump won. In Arizona alone, we chased over 205,000 low-propensity conservative votes -- well beyond the margin of victory. In Wisconsin? 60,000+. In Nevada? 6,000+ -- and we won back a district we hadn't carried in 20 years. In Michigan? 14,000+ votes helped us flip a U.S. House seat and take the state house majority. We didn't just make noise... We made history. | Above: Election Night 2024. Our biggest win yet. That's me on the left -- still fighting beside Charlie, just like we always did. Patriot, I watched Charlie pour everything into this mission. He lived on the road 300+ days a year. We never stopped. Because Charlie never stopped. He didn't build all of this for clout or clicks... Instead, he did it for this country. For all of us. For every parent who feels like they're losing their kid to the Left... For every student who's afraid to speak up... For every American who still believes in this country... Charlie built this movement and this machine for them. For you. And now? After he gave everything for that mission? We have to carry the torch. We have to keep the machine running -- and make it stronger than ever. | **__A Note from Rep. Elise Stefanik__**
---
Friend,
Kathy Hochul is raising millions of dollars to BUY New York.
**Meanwhile, we’re struggling to raise the final $18,020 we need to reach our critical fundraising benchmark with only hours to go until the mid-month cutoff at 11:59 P.M. TONIGHT! **
At this late hour, I’m out of options. We don’t have any campaign checks left to cash, or any emergency funds we can draw from...
...My only hope of reaching our goal is this one final note to all of my _TOP_ grassroots supporters.
_As always: If you’ve given all that you can, or can’t afford to contribute right now, please simply disregard what I’m about to ask._

California is holding one of the most important elections in the country this year on November 4.
By voting **YES on Proposition 50** , we can give power back to the people, combatting Donald Trump’s unprecedented action to seize control of Congress.
Here’s what’s at stake:
Trump knows he’s on track to lose the 2026 midterm elections because of his disastrous policies. But instead of winning over voters, he pressured Republican-led states like Texas to gerrymander their congressional maps—erasing Democratic-held seats before a single vote is even cast.

Over the weekend, millions of Americans took to the streets for the **" No Kings" protests.** A powerful reminder that this country still belongs to _the people_ , not a wannabe monarch. But just hours later, Donald Trump posted an **AI-generated video** of himself -- wearing a **crown** , flying a **fighter jet** , and **dropping feces on protesters** in Times Square.

A powerful reminder that this country still belongs to the people , not a wannabe monarch. But just hours later, Donald Trump posted an AI-generated video of himself -- wearing a crown , flying a fighter jet , and dropping feces on protesters in Times Square. | That's right. The sitting President of the United States used AI propaganda to humiliate and threaten Americans who dared to speak out. This isn't leadership -- it's authoritarianism wrapped in mockery. And if we've learned anything, it's that Trump will continue abusing his power to silence dissent and intimidate the opposition. Yet the message from the streets was clear: Americans are not afraid. The same Americans who filled the streets must now fill the ballot boxes. This is the moment to act -- to organize, to vote, and to ensure this movement translates into real power at the polls. Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Democracy Docket: With New Order, Trump Tries to Kill Off Vote By Mail [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=102125_3&amount=25]
We're going to keep hammering this home, Team, because the mainstream media continues to ignore this executive order and how it will change our elections forever.
President Donald Trump's massive anti-voting executive order has sent lawmakers, election officials, and voting rights advocates into a frenzy. One provision focuses on a goal that for years has been a borderline obsession for MAGA: Cracking down on voting by mail.
For background: After every election in which he's been a candidate or in power, Trump has raged over the use of mail-in ballots in general and ballot deadlines in particular . He's tried to claim fraud for every single ballot counted after Election Day.
So of course, this order directs Attorney General Pam Bondi to “take all necessary action” against any states that count absentee or mail-in ballots received after Election Day.
This order makes it clear that the MAGA crew will do anything they can to codify their power permanently and silence the will of the people by suppressing and eliminating the votes we cast.
We've got to keep fighting and work to protect our elections and our fundamental right to vote. Step up with $15 or whatever you can today and help us defend vote by mail across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=102125_3&amount=15]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

We all know that mail-in voting laws are about ballot accessibility, making it easier for voters to participate in our elections . Elderly voters, the disabled, our military service members -- they all vote by mail.
Mail-in voting has happened dating back to the Civil War. It's always been safe and secure, mail-in voting fraud is supremely rare. States have spent millions of taxpayer dollars investigating voter fraud since 2020's "big lie" and found virtually nothing. It's been used widely in some states for decades and in most of the country since the pandemic.
Our partners at VoteAmerica said it best: “ There is no good-faith reason to limit vote-by-mail access, reject ballots without postmarks, or refuse to count ballots that arrive after Election Day. If the administration moves forward with these proposals, they will effectively disenfranchise older voters, rural voters, and military voters. ”
Opponents of voting rights have proven they'll go to any length necessary to stop people from voting and make sure that they stay in power. subject: Patriots support communities. Kings build ballrooms.

body:
|
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117727486/577438023/1117401451?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_KMC_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20251021_PM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MWM4N2VhOS1jM2FlLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wYfFcM3mF_SWOf9DC52ZUwKewxPx--3Q3UW5sJcpa-E=)
---
Last weekend, I joined millions of Americans across the country at a No Kings rally. Standing shoulder-to-shoulder with hardworking people protesting because they love this country, I couldn’t help but feel hope. And it made me recognize a few important truths:
* **Patriots support our communities.** Even in crowds of thousands of people, I could see neighbors cheering each other on and connecting with one another over the issues they care about most, from accessing health care to stopping secret police from terrorizing our communities.

* **Rallies like this are as American as apple pie.** Think about it, we’re coming out to reaffirm that we elect presidents — we don’t have kings. And Republicans called this un-American. They’re blatantly disregarding how our Constitution works: giving power to the people to choose who represents them.

* **Kings build ballrooms**. While the people he was elected to serve speak out against his authoritarianism, Trump is busy tearing apart the White House to build a $250 million ballroom. It’s the epitome of “let them eat cake.”

Here’s the bottom line: There is nothing more American or patriotic than telling a tyrant NO: NO soldiers on our streets. NO targeting political enemies. NO kids without health care. **NO KINGS.** **[Last weekend showed that we can build the democracy we want. All we need to do is work together. clean_body: | = Last weekend, I joined millions of Americans across the country at a No Kings rally. Standing shoulder-to-shoulder with hardworking people protesting because they love this country, I couldn’t help but feel hope. And it made me recognize a few important truths: Patriots support our communities. Even in crowds of thousands of people, I could see neighbors cheering each other on and connecting with one another over the issues they care about most, from accessing health care to stopping secret police from terrorizing our communities. Rallies like this are as American as apple pie. Think about it, we’re coming out to reaffirm that we elect presidents — we don’t have kings. And Republicans called this un-American. They’re blatantly disregarding how our Constitution works: giving power to the people to choose who represents them. Kings build ballrooms. While the people he was elected to serve speak out against his authoritarianism, Trump is busy tearing apart the White House to build a $250 million ballroom. It’s the epitome of “let them eat cake.” Here’s the bottom line: There is nothing more American or patriotic than telling a tyrant NO: NO soldiers on our streets. NO targeting political enemies. NO kids without health care. "The terms of the 20 point plan that the president put out there is very clear...It's that Hamas has to disarm. It's that Hamas has to actually behave itself and that Hamas, while all the fighters can be given some sort of clemency, they're not going to be able to kill each other, and they're not going to be able to kill their fellow Palestinians," Vance said, adding,"if Hamas doesn't cooperate, then, as the United States has said,**[Hamas is going to be obliterated."](https://substack.com/redirect/d9d547d9-3ce1-4452-9469-7c77ac372c49?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
* **White House personnel, Former Rep.[ Mark Walker, R-N.C.](https://substack.com/redirect/5fe27e55-02f2-4532-a9e5-850b83821c74?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg),** a former pastor who previously led the House Homeland Security Subcommittee on Intelligence and Counterterrorism, called this **["one of the most historic peace moments of our lifetime."](https://substack.com/redirect/d4050f99-bcda-4658-990e-2761a556e2fd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Walker, who has yet to be confirmed by the Senate, praised Trump's "audacious diplomacy" for brokering the cease-fire deal between Israel and Hamas that critics said would never happen.
* **Walker said his mission as ambassador will focus on advocating for persecuted people of faith worldwide,** ranging from groups like Coptic Christians in Egypt to the Druze in Syria to victims of Islamist terror groups like Boko Haram and al-Shabaab in Africa. "Whether it's Boko Haram or al-Shabaab, these groups view anyone who doesn't bow to their radical ideology as an infidel," Walker said. "That hatred fuels persecution against Jews, Christians and others." Walker's visit will involve meetings with top Israeli officials, meeting with freed Hamas hostages, and a pilgrimage to Jerusalem's Western Wall, with Vance set to visit the **[Church of the Holy Sepulchre](https://substack.com/redirect/d9d547d9-3ce1-4452-9469-7c77ac372c49?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** apart from managing the peace deal.

* * *
# Trump breaks ground on new White House ballroom and Democrats are pretending it's not privately funded
The Trump administration broke ground Monday on their previously announced "big, beautiful White House Ballroom" set to be the location for future presidential events, much to the seeming dismay of house Democrats.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a1da28f8-485e-4ee9-a962-1187cd2a7482?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Hilary Clinton is not happy about the Presidential construction of a new White House ballroom, jumping on the recent Democrat social media spree surrounding the weekend's anti-Trump protests to express her seeming disdain.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7e512381-b4c8-4260-9299-1173d062463b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **["It's not his house,"](https://substack.com/redirect/d4380107-636f-4ee0-827a-e667fc3bc290?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Clinton wrote about the White House,** with other Democrat leaders Like Massachusetts Rep. Elizabeth Warren. "Oh you're trying to say the cost of living is skyrocketing?" **[Warren posted on X.](https://substack.com/redirect/c399a4ad-ef96-49ef-adc6-fde019ffd713?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** "Donald Trump can't hear you over the sound of bulldozers demolishing a wing of the White House to build a new grand ballroom." It remains unclear whether or not the two will stand by their harsh opinion around the time invitations to the first event at the ballroom arrive.
* **The administration 's construction project is estimated to cost roughly [$200 million](https://substack.com/redirect/57cd0627-84f0-4a13-85e4-7a702b2c5f86?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg),** with **["zero cost to the American Taxpayer!"](https://substack.com/redirect/bba4f91d-f57e-481d-9a9e-a47292094442?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** according to Trump, who posted on Truth Social that the project is being privately funded by unnamed patriots, companies, and himself. The demolition began this week, with hope of completion before Trump's end of term in January 2029.

* * *
# "I'm not a king at all!" Trump responds to No Kings Protestors
President Donald Trump **[responded to this past weekend's "No Kings" protests](https://substack.com/redirect/db362e90-0612-4ddc-aed3-8d98e041c357?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** across the country on Air Force One Sunday, dispelling protesters' claims of his authoritarianism and assuring that the protests were not representative of country-wide sentiment.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/db362e90-0612-4ddc-aed3-8d98e041c357?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **" I think it's a joke. I looked at the people.** They're not representative of the country," Trump said of the protests spanning across major cities like New York, Washington DC, and London.
* **The roughly[2,500 protests taking place this past Saturday were anti-Trump themed](https://substack.com/redirect/47b7ae23-1603-4aad-b5c9-30f118b157d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**, with reports of attendees being majorly peaceful. Democrat Leaders like California Gavin Newsom telling Americans to "use this weekend's No Kings marches as a declaration of independence against the **[tyranny and lawlessness](https://substack.com/redirect/625a4c56-9e90-49b1-a37e-36da88a3b806?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** currently running this country."

| | Dorian Gray glanced at the picture, and suddenly an uncontrollable feeling of hatred for Basil Hallward came over him, as though it had been suggested to him by the image on the canvas, whispered into his ear by those grinning lips. The mad passions of a hunted animal stirred within him, and he loathed the man who was seated at the table, more than in his whole life he had ever loathed anything. He glanced wildly around. Something glimmered on the top of the painted chest that faced him. His eye fell on it. He knew what it was. It was a knife that he had brought up, some days before, to cut a piece of cord, and had forgotten to take away with him. He moved slowly towards it, passing Hallward as he did so. As soon as he got behind him, he seized it and turned round. Hallward stirred in his chair as if he was going to rise. He rushed at him and dug the knife into the great vein that is behind the ear, crushing the man’s head down on the table and stabbing again and again. There was a stifled groan and the horrible sound of some one choking with blood. Three times the outstretched arms shot up convulsively, waving grotesque, stiff-fingered hands in the air. He stabbed him twice more, but the man did not move. Something began to trickle on the floor. He waited for a moment, still pressing the head down. Then he threw the knife on the table, and listened. He could hear nothing, but the drip, drip on the threadbare carpet. He opened the door and went out on the landing. The house was absolutely quiet. No one was about. For a few seconds he stood bending over the balustrade and peering down into the black seething well of darkness. Then he took out the key and returned to the room, locking himself in as he did so. The thing was still seated in the chair, straining over the table with bowed head, and humped back, and long fantastic arms. Had it not been for the red jagged tear in the neck and the clotted black pool that was slowly widening on the table, one would have said that the man was simply asleep. How quickly it had all been done! He felt strangely calm, and walking over to the window, opened it and stepped out on the balcony. The wind had blown the fog away, and the sky was like a monstrous peacock’s tail, starred with myriads of golden eyes. He looked down and saw the policeman going his rounds and flashing the long beam of his lantern on the doors of the silent houses. The crimson spot of a prowling hansom gleamed at the corner and then vanished. A woman in a fluttering shawl was creeping slowly by the railings, staggering as she went. Now and then she stopped and peered back. Once, she began to sing in a hoarse voice. The policeman strolled over and said something to her. She stumbled away, laughing. A bitter blast swept across the square. The gas-lamps flickered and became blue, and the leafless trees shook their black iron branches to and fro. He shivered and went back, closing the window behind him.

This is evidenced primarily by the results of research on Sirko's remains, according to which the Cossack ataman was 70-75 years old at the time of his death in 1680. The first researcher of Sirko's biography, the famous Ukrainian historian Dmytro Yavornytskyi, suggested that the future ataman was born in Sloboda Ukraine in the settlement of Merefa (now the city of Merefa, Kharkiv region). However, this is not true. Merefa was founded only in 1658, i.e. when Sirko was in his late teens. However, Sirko and his family lived in Merefa for a long time in his house, and after his death, his wife and some family members lived there. The fact that Merefa in Slobozhanshchyna is associated with the name of the Cossack Ataman is evidenced by another name for the town recorded in some Ukrainian chronicles, Sirkivka. Where, then, should we look for Sirko's homeland? In our opinion, the sources give grounds to localize it in Eastern Podillia, namely in the Vinnytsia region. It is worth recalling that Sirko was a colonel in Vinnytsia (Kalnytsia) in 1658-1660. As you know, at that time in Ukraine, people who came from the local area were usually elected to such positions. Let us also recall a letter from Hetman of the Left Bank Ukraine Ivan Samoilovych to the tsarist voivode Prince G. Romodanovsky of April 20, 1675*, which recounts (in Russian) Sirko's own words: "And since I was born among the Poles, I want to die there." Thus, it is clear that Sirko was born on the Ukrainian lands that were under the rule of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, not Muscovy (the latter included Slobozhanshchyna). The historian Volodymyr Borysenko's assumption that Sirko's birthplace was the hundred-man town of the Bratslav regiment Murafa, a few kilometers from Kalnyk, is correct. Now it is the village of Zhdanov, Vinnytsia region. By the way, Murafa in the Slobozhanshchyna probably originated from this Murafa, because immigrants from the Right Bank of Ukraine to the Left Bank often gave the newly founded settlements the names of their native villages or towns. It is also worth noting Sirko's great interest in Keleberda, which he founded in 1675 on the left bank of the Dnipro. For a long time, he sought from the Moscow tsar the right to own this town or sloboda, as well as the strategically important crossing of the Dnipro near Perevolochna (Sirko wanted this crossing not for himself, but for the entire Zaporozhian Lowland Army). Contrary to popular belief, we believe that Sirko did not come from a Cossack family, but from a small Ukrainian Orthodox gentry. For example, we know the name of a Podillia nobleman, Voytekh Sirko, who was married to a certain Olena Kozynska. Sources mention them in 1592. It is possible that they were relatives of the Cossack leader. Perhaps it is no coincidence that the kings of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, writing to Sirko, called him "urodzon." The word "nobleman" evokes negative associations for many people due to stereotypes instilled in school textbooks of the Stalinist era. However, this approach is not always correct. The term "nobleman" is identical to the words "knight," "chevalier," "nobleman," etc. and was commonly used not only in Poland but also in Ukraine, Belarus, and the Czech Republic. If scholars in Russia, Poland, and the Czech Republic, having contracted vulgar sociologism, no longer accuse Pushkin or Bunin, Suvorov or Kutuzov, Žižka or Kostiushko of being of noble or gentry origin, why have attacks on the Ukrainian and Belarusian gentry continued until recently? Is it not because in this way the imperial "divide and conquer" was transferred to our long-suffering history? Was it not because it was necessary to impose a nihilistic attitude toward the history of Ukraine, to "prove" that Ukrainians or Belarusians were just dark labor without national consciousness, ethnographic material doomed to build other people's empires? Meanwhile, the Ukrainian gentry produced many outstanding sons of Ukraine, fighters for its freedom. Suffice it to mention the names of Kryshtof Kosinski, Petro Konashevych-Sahaidachny, Ivan Sulyma, Ivan Mazepa, Bohdan Khmelnytsky, and his associates: Ivan and Danylo Vyhovsky, Ivan Bohun, Danylo and Ivan Nechai, Mykhailo Krychevsky, Jan Sokolovsky, Siluyan Muzhylovsky, and others. Sirko's appearance and personality do not always coincide with the conventional ideas about him that have developed in some works of art. The Cossack leader was slightly taller than average (174-176 cm), had regular facial features, and a straight nose. By the way, the great Relin intuitively caught this when he depicted him in the center of his painting "Cossacks Writing a Letter to the Turkish Sultan." It is interesting that the prototype for Sirko's image in the painting was the famous military leader General Dragomirov. Only one significant detail was not known to Repin and his consultant D. Yavornytskyi - a red birthmark on Sirko's lower lip on the right side. His contemporaries considered it a "sign of God" given to distinguish him from ordinary people. name: Seth Moulton
subject: The why
body:
I've been getting this question a lot

| |
---
Hi friend, When people ask me why I’m running for the U.S. Senate, my answer always comes back to one thing:**taking action when it matters most.** After serving overseas, I came home determined to fix the broken politics that put lives at risk and left Washington paralyzed by caution and complacency. I learned firsthand what happens when leaders hesitate instead of acting with courage and conviction. That’s why I ran for Congress. Not because it was easy, but because Massachusetts families deserved better than the same old politics and failed leadership. Ten years later, I’m running for Senate for the same reason: our country is in crisis, and the urgency of this moment demands change — not complacency. Washington is filled with career politicians who have spent decades in office while Donald Trump and his MAGA allies tear down our democracy, weaponize government, and turn Americans against one another at a breakneck speed. Meanwhile, too many Democrats are standing still. I'm not afraid to call out our party's weaknesses, friend. It’s time for a new generation of leaders, people who won’t accept “good enough” when families are hurting, who will meet this moment with courage, urgency, and a plan for the future. **That’s why I’m running for Senate:** To stand up to Trump and his enablers, to hold this administration accountable, and to fight for veterans waiting for care, families struggling to pay the bills, and kids growing up in a country that should not only inspire them to dream big, but set them up to make those dreams a reality. I’ve never been afraid to challenge the status quo, whether it was in the Marines, in Congress, or in my own party. Everybody playing nice and waiting their turn is how we've ended up where we are today. **This isn’t a time for caution. It’s a time for change.** **This is my _why,_ friend.** And I’d be honored to have you by my side in this fight. **[Can I count on you to make a contribution today and help power this campaign for bold, new leadership forward?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117728319/577440770/2090747700?refcode=251021_sm_why_l1&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYjk0NzdlZS1jNWFlLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jHQutWct_QnPbBqdb60uA1tHPlypwZHnNdNiVANonpM=)** | [Give $25 >>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117728326/577440777/1375639745?express_lane=true&amount=25&refcode=251021_sm_why&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYjk0NzdlZS1jNWFlLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jHQutWct_QnPbBqdb60uA1tHPlypwZHnNdNiVANonpM=) | [Give $50 >>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117728327/577440778/1375639745?express_lane=true&amount=50&refcode=251021_sm_why&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYjk0NzdlZS1jNWFlLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jHQutWct_QnPbBqdb60uA1tHPlypwZHnNdNiVANonpM=)

After serving overseas, I came home determined to fix the broken politics that put lives at risk and left Washington paralyzed by caution and complacency. I learned firsthand what happens when leaders hesitate instead of acting with courage and conviction. That’s why I ran for Congress. Not because it was easy, but because Massachusetts families deserved better than the same old politics and failed leadership. Ten years later, I’m running for Senate for the same reason: our country is in crisis, and the urgency of this moment demands change — not complacency. Washington is filled with career politicians who have spent decades in office while Donald Trump and his MAGA allies tear down our democracy, weaponize government, and turn Americans against one another at a breakneck speed. Meanwhile, too many Democrats are standing still. I'm not afraid to call out our party's weaknesses, friend. It’s time for a new generation of leaders, people who won’t accept “good enough” when families are hurting, who will meet this moment with courage, urgency, and a plan for the future. That’s why I’m running for Senate: To stand up to Trump and his enablers, to hold this administration accountable, and to fight for veterans waiting for care, families struggling to pay the bills, and kids growing up in a country that should not only inspire them to dream big, but set them up to make those dreams a reality. I’ve never been afraid to challenge the status quo, whether it was in the Marines, in Congress, or in my own party. USO Supporter,
Behind every deployment is a service member who feels the distance. Right now, that distance feels even greater. With some government programs and resources at a standstill, deployed troops are facing added hardship.
**The USO is stepping in to help.**
As a trusted partner of America's Armed Forces, the USO is working overtime to meet the extra needs of service members and their families -- extending Center hours, providing warm meals and distributing non-perishable food from several of our centers in Europe.
**[Your gift today can help fund these critical programs, provide a place for our heroes to rest and recharge and more.* And right now, a generous group of donors will match your gift, dollar for dollar, up to a total of $20,000, but only for a limited time.**](https://links.e.uso.)**

A piece of home goes a long way. Right now, about 170,000 service members are deployed outside the United States. **From Europe to the Middle East to the Pacific, the USO goes where our troops go, delivering comfort, connection and care no matter how far away they serve.**
Today's service members are answering the call in 178 countries, often thousands of miles from the lives they know. **[Please make a generous donation today to have it MATCHED and help show our heroes they are never alone.](https://links.e.uso.)**

name: Katie Britt
subject: Come take a stroll through the past with me.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Britt for Alabama, Inc
body:
Please read the following message from our sponsor.
-------------------------

[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/541bc478a5f947809f39d233c489f870-0990c3d166fe4277b1ceda4728a9bb66/63]

Friend,

My name is Katie Britt, and if it’s alright with you, I’d like to
share a little about who I am. I’M NOT PART OF THE D.C. COCKTAIL
CIRCUIT, AND I NEVER WILL BE. THAT’S JUST NOT WHO I AM.

In 2022, I was elected to represent the great state of Alabama in the
United States Senate. I became the first woman in Alabama’s history
to hold this seat—but that’s not why I ran.

I ran because I’m a MOM, a WIFE, and a CONSERVATIVE who’s fed up
with the direction this country is heading. I came to Washington to
fight for our families, to protect our values, and to bring some
Alabama backbone to a broken system.

I didn’t come here to make friends with the political elite. I came
here to stand up for the people who don’t have a voice in the
room—and I’m not backing down.

[Katie Britt and her family]
[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/541bc478a5f947809f39d233c489f870-0990c3d166fe4277b1ceda4728a9bb66/63]

Before coming to the Senate, I served as the first female president
and CEO of the Business Council of Alabama, and before that, I was
Chief of Staff to Senator Richard Shelby. I’VE NEVER SHIED AWAY FROM
A CHALLENGE—AND I’VE NEVER FORGOTTEN WHO I’M FIGHTING FOR. In
every role I’ve held, my mission has been the same: deliver real
results for Alabama families and the American people.

[Katie and her family at Alabama Football Game]
[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/541bc478a5f947809f39d233c489f870-0990c3d166fe4277b1ceda4728a9bb66/63]

Before starting my career in public service, I earned my undergraduate
and law degrees from the University of Alabama. That experience taught
me how to lead, think on my feet, and fight for what I believe
in—AND IT LAID THE FOUNDATION FOR EVERYTHING I’VE DONE SINCE.

[Katie, as a baby, with her mom]
[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/541bc478a5f947809f39d233c489f870-0990c3d166fe4277b1ceda4728a9bb66/63]

[Katie, as a toddler, with her mom]
[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/541bc478a5f947809f39d233c489f870-0990c3d166fe4277b1ceda4728a9bb66/63]

[Katie with her dad and siblings]
[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/541bc478a5f947809f39d233c489f870-0990c3d166fe4277b1ceda4728a9bb66/63]

But long before that, I was just a small-town girl from Enterprise,
Alabama. My dad ran the local hardware store. My mom taught dance to
almost every kid in town. We didn’t grow up with wealth or political
connections. WE CAME FROM HARD WORK, GRIT, AND DOING THINGS THE RIGHT
WAY. THAT’S HOW I WAS RAISED, AND THAT’S EXACTLY HOW I LEAD.

[Katie and her family in the ruins of their home]
[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/541bc478a5f947809f39d233c489f870-0990c3d166fe4277b1ceda4728a9bb66/63]

My husband Wesley and our two amazing kids are my rock. In 2011, a
tornado tore through our home and nearly took our lives. That moment
changed everything, and reminded me what truly matters. _FAITH,
FAMILY, and RESILIENCE._

[Katie and her kids at Alabama game]
[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/541bc478a5f947809f39d233c489f870-0990c3d166fe4277b1ceda4728a9bb66/63]

[Katie and her husband on their wedding day]
[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/541bc478a5f947809f39d233c489f870-0990c3d166fe4277b1ceda4728a9bb66/63]

[Katie with her husband and two children]
[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/541bc478a5f947809f39d233c489f870-0990c3d166fe4277b1ceda4728a9bb66/63]

I’ve lived a life full of hard work, determination, and breaking
barriers. There have been challenges and triumphs alike, but I
wouldn’t trade any of it.

My story is a testament to what America stands for—the American
Dream. From a small town in Alabama, I rose to become my state’s
U.S. Senator—a woman who’s breaking barriers and fighting for
conservative values every day.

_I’M LIVING PROOF OF THE LIMITLESS OPPORTUNITY AND FREEDOM THAT
DEFINE THIS COUNTRY._

But, I didn’t get here by playing it safe or staying quiet, AND
I’M NOT ABOUT TO START NOW.

The radical Left wants to silence conservatives like me. They want to
drown out our voices and push their agenda without opposition, but
I’m standing firm.

I’m fighting tooth and nail to keep up and push back hard, for
Alabama, for our values, and for every American who believes in
freedom.

THE SUPPORT I’VE RECEIVED SO FAR MEANS EVERYTHING, BUT THIS FIGHT IS
FAR FROM OVER. We need the resources to keep going strong and hold our
ground.

SO, AFTER HEARING A BIT OF MY STORY, WILL YOU TAKE A MOMENT TO CHIP IN
WHATEVER YOU CAN AFFORD TO HELP ME KEEP UP THIS FIGHT? THE ROAD AHEAD
WON’T BE EASY, BUT I’VE FACED TOUGH BATTLES BEFORE. AND IT WOULD
MEAN THE WORLD TO HAVE YOU STANDING WITH ME.
[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/541bc478a5f947809f39d233c489f870-0990c3d166fe4277b1ceda4728a9bb66/63]

CHIP IN TO FIGHT WITH KATIE BRITT >>
[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/541bc478a5f947809f39d233c489f870-0990c3d166fe4277b1ceda4728a9bb66/63]

Thank you, and may God bless America.

Katie Britt (R-AL)

[Katie Britt]
[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/541bc478a5f947809f39d233c489f870-0990c3d166fe4277b1ceda4728a9bb66/63]

[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/541bc478a5f947809f39d233c489f870-0990c3d166fe4277b1ceda4728a9bb66/63]

I didn’t run for Senate to sit quietly on the sidelines. I’m a
mom, a conservative, and a proud Alabamian—and I came to fight for
the values that make America strong.

_FAITH. FAMILY. FREEDOM._

The Left is doing everything they can to tear it all down. But I
didn’t come to Washington to play games. I came to fight for the
people who feel forgotten, overlooked, and ignored.

>From securing the border to protecting our kids and defending our way
of life—I’m in this for the long haul.

THIS FIGHT ISN’T EASY, BUT IT’S WORTH IT. AND I’M NOT GOING
ANYWHERE.

Will you stand with me?

STAND WITH KATIE >>
[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/541bc478a5f947809f39d233c489f870-0990c3d166fe4277b1ceda4728a9bb66/63]

[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/541bc478a5f947809f39d233c489f870-0990c3d166fe4277b1ceda4728a9bb66/63]

[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/541bc478a5f947809f39d233c489f870-d487010b7de046488b83f9a0bf3e305a/63].

| “Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. is often quoted as saying that ‘The arc of the moral universe is long, but it bends towards justice.’ Except it doesn’t bend on its own. It bends because we pull it in the direction of justice.”

—Eric H. Holder, Jr.
82nd Attorney General
---
A.G. Eric Holder is right, Peter.
At the NDRC, we believe that _all of us_ have a role to play in ensuring justice and fairness in our democracy. Ending extreme gerrymandering is a critical battle that requires the strength of the people. It’s only by coming together that we can restore the integrity of our elections, so that voters pick their politicians — not the other way around.
Right now, our country is facing a moment of reckoning as Republicans launch unprecedented attempts to undermine free and fair elections. Our democracy as we know it is on the line.
This is exactly why the NDRC exists. We’ll keep doing everything we can to fix this broken system by supporting our endorsed Democracy Defenders, protecting voting rights, and raising awareness about the ongoing attacks on fair maps. But this is a challenging fight that requires investment right now and for the long term to ensure we can keep bending the arc closer to justice.

clean_body: [] Folks, with only two weeks left until Election Day, it’s officially crunch time! This is our opportunity to defeat Trump-endorsed Jason Miyares and flip Virginia blue, and we can’t afford to miss it. Before I share our game plan for these final weeks, can I count on you to chip in and help keep our momentum strong? [] MAKE A DONATION [?] When we launched this campaign, my team and I traveled all across the Commonwealth to speak with Virginians and learn what mattered most to them. Every step of the way, we’ve prioritized meeting folks where they're at and listening to everyday Virginians — and we’re proud to have built a campaign that puts you first. Meanwhile, Jason Miyares has shown he's in total lockstep with Donald Trump's dangerous agenda. That’s right — the same Donald Trump who has personally endorsed MAGA Miyares and called me an “animal” on Sunday night. But when Trump says I can “join a long list of attorney generals that have been suing” him, he’s absolutely right. I’m the only candidate in this race who will actually stand up for Virginia’s workers, economy, and fundamental rights and freedoms. We're getting down to the wire with only two weeks left until Election Day, and I'll need your help to: 🔵 Reach undecided voters and share our vision for Virginia's future. 🔵 Travel to counties across the Commonwealth. 🔵 Mobilize our voting outreach efforts. We’ve got a lot of work to do in this final stretch, and I’m relying on the strength of our grassroots movement. Can you step up and contribute $25 or more so we can defeat Jason Miyares and win this for all Virginians on November 4th? name: Ruben Gallego
subject: You don’t have to pick one or the other
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
There’s this false choice people are getting forced into — like, you can build prosperity, or you can take on monopolies and take care of people.
#

Peter, it's Ruben Gallego here.
I’ve got something here for you to read, when you have some free time.
[**David Leonhardt from the New York Times sat down with me and we talked for a little while because people are curious, in 2024, how a Democrat could win a state Trump won by 3.5%.**](https://www.nytimes.com/2025/10/20/opinion/ruben-gallego-interview-democrats-border-security-affordability.html?smid=nytcore-ios-share&referringSource=articleShare)
At the most fundamental level, it’s about what life is like in the United States, and how life should be in the United States.
There’s this false choice people are getting forced into — like, you can build prosperity, or you can take on monopolies and take care of people.
We don’t have to make that choice! We should be building things fast, as fast as possible, especially housing. And at the same time, we should be making sure that monopolies don’t control markets that are driving up prices. We should be able to build roads fast and at the same time make sure that there’s ways for us to have affordable child care for working-class America.

clean_body: I need you with me, Peter. Peter, I never planned on running for office again. But I see what’s happening in Washington – and I can’t stay on the sidelines. I’m jumping in this fight: I’m running for Senate in 2026. Why? Because Ohioans are working harder than ever, and they’re still falling behind. Why? Because wages are flat. Why? Because costs are rising. Why? Because the people in power are only looking out for their rich friends and corporate interests. No one is fighting for Ohio workers and families in the Senate. But with your support, we can change that. We can build a country where workers share in the wealth they create, where hard work pays off, and where everyone who works hard can afford a decent life. This won’t be easy – and with Ohio being one of the most competitive Senate races in the country, we know there are many fights ahead.
