Local elections matter. Here's everything you need to know to vote in Arizona's Special Election on November 4th. |
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117729876/577445924/-1397648958?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20251021_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTRhM2ZmNjQtY2JhZS1mMDExLThlNjEtNjA0NWJkZWQ4YmE0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=PPJZNTn11nG-cVvU0S-h6k0fTiPiq7arwlKhofG8SLA=)
---
Hi there, **Mark your calendars: Arizona's next Election Day is November 4th, which is just two weeks from today!** Growing up in rural Arizona, I learned early that local elections shape our daily lives just as much as the big races that make headlines. Local elections make a critical impact on our schools, our roads, our water infrastructure, and our communities' futures. **If you’re eligible to vote in Arizona and/or are willing to help us ensure a fair and safe Election Day for everyone, here are some great resources:**
* **Find your polling location or nearest drop box:** Head to [IWillVote.com](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117729877/577445925/327637188?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20251021_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTRhM2ZmNjQtY2JhZS1mMDExLThlNjEtNjA0NWJkZWQ4YmE0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=PPJZNTn11nG-cVvU0S-h6k0fTiPiq7arwlKhofG8SLA=&emci=1b4fd7df-c5ae-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=a4a3ff64-cbae-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=9307116) to find where to vote in your area.
* **Check what's on your ballot:** Visit the [Clean Elections website](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117729878/577445926/2119518375?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20251021_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTRhM2ZmNjQtY2JhZS1mMDExLThlNjEtNjA0NWJkZWQ4YmE0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=PPJZNTn11nG-cVvU0S-h6k0fTiPiq7arwlKhofG8SLA=&emci=1b4fd7df-c5ae-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=a4a3ff64-cbae-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=9307116) for a county-by-county breakdown of races and measures.
* **Questions or problems?** If you have questions about your registration, your ballot, or anything else, call the Voter Protection Hotline at **(833) 868-3429**.
* **Want to help protect the vote?** We need Voter Protection volunteers across Arizona. Sign up here: [https://forms.gle/SrKCRws1YokC2oRD8](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117729879/577445927/-1570381894?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20251021_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTRhM2ZmNjQtY2JhZS1mMDExLThlNjEtNjA0NWJkZWQ4YmE0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=PPJZNTn11nG-cVvU0S-h6k0fTiPiq7arwlKhofG8SLA=&emci=1b4fd7df-c5ae-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=a4a3ff64-cbae-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=9307116)

**If your ballot hasn't arrived in your mailbox yet, you can call our Voter Protection Hotline at (833) 868-3429 or reach out to your county recorder’s office.** Don't wait until the last minute — fill it out and return it as soon as you get it. Put your ballot in the mail **by October 28th** to ensure it’s returned in time or drop it off at a dropbox by Election Day. Every election is decided by who shows up. In local races, that's especially true. Margins can be razor-thin, which means your vote carries even more weight. **Republicans are counting on low turnout in local elections.** They're betting that Arizonans won't pay attention to races that don't make national headlines. Let's prove them wrong. [**And if you can, chip in to support our work to protect the vote and support Democrats up and down the ballot:**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117729880/577445928/541746778?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20251021_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTRhM2ZmNjQtY2JhZS1mMDExLThlNjEtNjA0NWJkZWQ4YmE0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=PPJZNTn11nG-cVvU0S-h6k0fTiPiq7arwlKhofG8SLA=) | [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117729881/577445929/79744751?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20251021_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTRhM2ZmNjQtY2JhZS1mMDExLThlNjEtNjA0NWJkZWQ4YmE0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=PPJZNTn11nG-cVvU0S-h6k0fTiPiq7arwlKhofG8SLA=)

See you at the polls — or at the drop box!
Charlene Fernandez

the single largest day of protest in modern U.S. history. It was truly amazing
to see people powerfully and peacefully showing the world: This is what
democracy looks like. Trump said it was small; he said no one would show up. And as usual, he was flat
out wrong. But here's what matters even more than numbers: Our movement is building the
strength and momentum we need to stop authoritarianism in America. beginning. Our movement is growing, and Saturday’s turnout proves it. Now is the time to

in America. Not now, not ever. We’ll be in touch soon with where we go from here. Thanks for being with us, Peter. Justin Kwasa

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a49a4233-16a9-4cff-8409-31815cea159f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
It is one of the crueler jokes of our time that a man like Donald J. Trump--whose knowledge of history could be etched on the head of a pin and still leave room for the Lord's Prayer--is once again holding court on matters of global consequence.
And true to form, the old orange man has once again vomited up not statesmanship, not reason, not even the low cunning of a backroom operator.
But as is his tradition, there was a tantrum and a screed. And for good measure he added in some [slavish regurgitation of all the Kremlin's favorite talking points](https://substack.com/redirect/1b01de15-d629-42b3-809e-97d06387fabb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
As reported by multiple news outlets, Trump summoned Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky--whose country is being carved up by Russian artillery and scorched by imperial savagery--to the White House.
A meeting to take place in the hallowed halls of the White House West Wing.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5e96e6d1-d5da-4103-b11f-3164bb688905?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* * *
🔥 **[No Kings Offer! 20% Off Memberships!](https://substack.com/redirect/a49a4233-16a9-4cff-8409-31815cea159f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** 🔥
[💥 Join now. Save now. Stand up. 💥](https://substack.com/redirect/c3df2d9d-e928-43a5-b636-2d2b79929ce1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
One might imagine in a saner universe, that the leader of a besieged democracy attacked without provocation by a vicious aggressor would be met with solemnity.
Respect. Perhaps even gratitude.
But Trump, ever the demented vulgarian, instead _berated Zelensky._ Trump chastised him like a misbehaving valet. Why?
Because Trump spoke by phone with Putin the day before. And because Zelensky refused to play along with Trump's delusional fan-fiction of "peace." (or, more likely, peace in our time).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5e96e6d1-d5da-4103-b11f-3164bb688905?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Let's be clear: Trump did not offer a strategy. Trump issued an ultimatum [indistinguishable from Putin's propaganda](https://substack.com/redirect/375ffbb3-aa5f-45fe-9a50-9666ea039da0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Trump's proposal--to freeze the front lines and allow Russia to keep its stolen land in Ukraine's Donbas region--was nothing short of a white flag. Signed in the sleazy Trump penmanship of cowardice.
* * *
[Subscribe for free to stay in the loop.](https://substack.com/redirect/a49a4233-16a9-4cff-8409-31815cea159f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.rdp-ChhjjHMNnwLCK8SD9NwVV8bWokvIJxFPmupVb8o?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=176681931)
* * *
The moral position, apparently, is that Ukraine should be thankful for whatever crumbs it fall off the American table. And if Ukraine doesn't kneel fast enough, Mango Mussolini will spontaneously combust.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/375ffbb3-aa5f-45fe-9a50-9666ea039da0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
By most accounts, t _he Trump tantrum was epic_. [Not "Young Republican Epic,"](https://substack.com/redirect/5e96e6d1-d5da-4103-b11f-3164bb688905?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) but still, impressive.
The 47th President of the United States is a man with the emotional stability of a spoiled toddler denied a second scoop of ice cream. So, naturally, his solution to having to debate a real man led to deranged shouting and cursing, according to multiple reports.
This is the brittle temperament of a little boy who fancies himself a "dealmaker" but melts down when confronted [with anyone possessing the slightest hint of moral clarity](https://substack.com/redirect/21d373e7-4b78-4e2a-9185-b0162e41c592?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1b01de15-d629-42b3-809e-97d06387fabb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
What Trump is demanding from Zelensky is not peace. It is Ukraine's surrender--dressed up in the tinsel of Trump's skanky transactional politics.
And handed to Putin with a wink.
Trump's proposals mirror _almost verbatim_ the Kremlin's own script. Stop fighting, give up territory, and let the Russian boot rest firmly planted on Ukrainian soil.
Never mind the thousands dead. Or the mass graves. Or the tortured civilians, Or the kidnapped children. Or the thousands of other horrors visited on Ukraine by the war criminal Putin.
Trump, a man who likely couldn't find Donbas on a map without a UN interpreter present, has decided that [Zelenskyy's resistance is inconvenient--for Trump](https://substack.com/redirect/e9702b39-6f3c-49c6-b4c3-553e91e55bfa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--and therefore immoral.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/47563595-a0bf-4e13-a7c9-65d60fcbc565?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The gall of it would be amusing, if it weren't so grotesque.
Here is a man who dodged military service with a bogus bone spur, wagging his finger at a wartime president who has literally stood on the front lines.
Trump--whose bravery peaks at social media posts [and AI poop videos](https://substack.com/redirect/bf716a4d-5fba-483a-b9e7-73fa34064b81?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--telling Zelensky how to fight a war is the equivalent of a circus clown giving advice to a brain surgeon.
And for what? So Trump can appeal to the lowest dregs of MAGA -- the bootlickers, Q-anon conspiracists, [careerist cowards, crypto-bros.](https://substack.com/redirect/74baa30f-f85b-4fe7-918a-d7beeb251669?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) The Twitter trolls [and theocrats](https://substack.com/redirect/1b01de15-d629-42b3-809e-97d06387fabb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) who think that Putin is a misunderstood genius and NATO is a scam.
Trump has made it his business to take every legitimate American interest and douse it _in the urine of his own ego_. Trump's sympathies lie not with democracies under fire, but with tyrants who flatter him.
Putin, Kim, Orban, bin Thani, MBS, Milei--if you want Trump's admiration, don't fight for freedom. Just compliment him and suggest that he receive the Nobel peace prize.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/21d373e7-4b78-4e2a-9185-b0162e41c592?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The tragedy here isn't merely that Trump is ignorant. It's that he's willfully so.
He is the spiritual heir to every demagogue and know-nothing who ever mistook cruelty for toughness and betrayal for diplomacy. Trump's "peace plan" is a con job, a cheap surrender masquerading as statesmanship and charity.
The only thing it would achieve is giving Putin exactly what he wants: time, territory, and Western fracture.
* * *
[Subscribe for free to stay in the loop.](https://substack.com/redirect/a49a4233-16a9-4cff-8409-31815cea159f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.rdp-ChhjjHMNnwLCK8SD9NwVV8bWokvIJxFPmupVb8o?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=176681931)
* * *
Zelensky, for his part, showed more restraint than most saints, as he did in a previous trip to the house Trump is currently tearing apart.
He did not rise to Trump's bait.
He did not walk out, slam the door, or call Trump what many of us wish we could call him every day.
This man of steel, forged in the fiery hell of Russia's genocidal attacks on Ukraine, reportedly endured the outburst because his country needs support.
It doesn't need drama.
In that moment, the man from Kyiv towered over the man quack from Queens in every measurable sense.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e9702b39-6f3c-49c6-b4c3-553e91e55bfa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Zelensky, of course, is everything Trump is not: brave, resolute, respected by free nations. And Trump, like all cheap frauds confronted by the real article, can only recoil in fury.
Thus the tantrum. Thus the shouting. Thus Trump's open desire to let Putin finish the job.
* * *

[💥 Join now. Save now. Stand up. 💥](https://substack.com/redirect/c3df2d9d-e928-43a5-b636-2d2b79929ce1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
Don't be fooled. Donald Trump wants Ukraine to be fed to the wolves and America's soul right along with it. We[ must support leaders](https://substack.com/redirect/21d373e7-4b78-4e2a-9185-b0162e41c592?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) who will[ not let him get away with it](https://substack.com/redirect/e9702b39-6f3c-49c6-b4c3-553e91e55bfa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Because we've yet again been reminded that Trump is not just unfit for office. He is _antithetical_ to it. The precise inverse of everything the U.S. presidency is supposed to mean and represent.
He is the symptom of a [degenerative Republican political disease: the elevation of celebrity over character, truculence over truth](https://substack.com/redirect/5e96e6d1-d5da-4103-b11f-3164bb688905?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and raw, unfiltered ego over the lives of men, women, children, and whole nations.
History will judge Trump on the Russia-Ukraine war.
The only question is whether we will judge ourselves before it is too late for Ukraine.
And for America.

body:
| Friend —

Today, I appear in court to keep fighting the baseless charges brought against me by the Trump administration. This case is precedent-setting and it will shape the future of our democracy.

I am being targeted for doing my oversight work at an ICE facility. The Trump administration wants to punish political opponents and anyone who speaks up, silence dissent, drain me of my resources with an expensive legal battle, and **put me in prison for up to 17 years.** Even in the face of all this, I will not stop fighting.

**_[Can I count on you to pitch in to Bonnie Watson Coleman and me to help fight back? We need your help to amass the resources to keep fighting this legal battle in court.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117730725/577448630/-1696173515?amount=10&source=EM_NBI_BWC_20251021_FR_SplitMcIver_0_6MO_LaMonicaMcIver_NA_NA_split&refcode2=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDY4NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNjg1MmJiMC1jZWFlLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FqjkU1R_JnKixujDjjrfKAf58tOLSW9lJLpwbm6eZwA=)_**

After weeks of attacking our state, President Trump ordered troops to Portland.

The Portland I know is a beautiful, vibrant, and resilient city. It’s a place where families build their futures, where communities come together, and where people stand up for justice.

Hey Derek, I have good news and bad news:

First, the good news: The FDA just approved a generic version of the abortion pill mifepristone. That’s progress. 💪

But here's the bad news: While we move forward, the GOP’s charging backward. Every single male Republican senator (yes, every one of them) just signed a letter to Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. demanding new restrictions on mifepristone.

They want control. Over women’s bodies, families, choices.

Let’s be clear: Deciding when or whether to become a mother should be between a woman and her doctor. Not politicians. 🙅♀️ If you agree, help me tell extremist Republicans to shove it by pitching in $5 now.

https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/51809?t=1002&akid=10377%2E434096%2EoOj5Y_

Since the FDA approved this generic version, RFK Jr. is now launching a so-called “safety review” of mifepristone based on a junk study from a right-wing think tank. Not peer-reviewed. Not credible. Garbage.

The facts are crystal clear: 100+ studies over 30+ years and across dozens of countries say mifepristone is safe. This isn’t about safety – it’s about politics. RFK Jr. and extremist Republicans want to ban abortion.

Trump lit this fuse when he stacked the Supreme Court with anti-abortion Justices. His justices overturned Roe and states banned abortion – just like he wanted.

Now, women’s lives are on the line. States are threatening to prosecute doctors who care for women with high-risk pregnancies. Others are forcing women to stay pregnant against their will – even in medical emergencies.

A woman’s right to make her own health care decisions is sacred and non-negotiable. Period. I voted NO on RFK Jr.’s confirmation, and I’ll never let junk science or political zealots dictate women’s health care.

Democrats must do everything we can to protect this fundamental right. I believe that if you are not willing to do whatever it takes to protect abortion rights when they are on the line, then you cannot call yourself pro-choice. It’s that simple.

If you’re with me, will you pitch in a few bucks to push back against these extremist Republicans and stand up for reproductive freedom?

https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/51809?t=1003&akid=10377%2E434096%2EoOj5Y_

Thanks, Derek,

John ❤️

Fellow American,

My name is Winsome Earle-Sears, and if you don't mind, I'd like to tell you a little about myself. **I 'm not your typical politician, and I never will be. _This is my story._**

In 2021, I won the General Election for Lieutenant Governor of Virginia by less than 60,000 votes. In doing so, I became the first black woman to hold this office--but that's not why I ran. This is my story. In 2021, I won the General Election for Lieutenant Governor of Virginia by less than 60,000 votes. In doing so, I became the first black woman to hold this office--but that's not why I ran. I ran to effect real change and instill common-sense conservative leadership. That's exactly what we have done and will continue to do. Before becoming the 2nd in command in Virginia, I beat a 20-year incumbent in 2001 to become the first Republican to win a seat in a majority black district in the Virginia House of Delegates since 1865. In the General Assembly, I focused on getting results for my constituents. Prior to my career in politics, I had the distinct honor of serving as an electrician in the United States Marine Corps. Looking even further back, when I was just 6 years old, my family and I came to the United States from Jamaica. We arrived in a new land with no money and different accents, but we made it work and got through the struggles - only in America is something like this even possible. Of course, none of this would have been possible without my husband, Terence, and my amazing daughters. Throughout all of this, they have been my rock, and I owe them everything - they have kept me grounded, confident, and optimistic for the future. As you can see, I've lived a full life. There have been highs, lows, and everything in between, but I don't regret a single thing. I maintain, without a shadow of a doubt, that my story is only possible in America. Hi Derek, it’s JB Pritzker here. Trump’s deranged agenda is harming people in every corner of Illinois — as well as Americans in every other state in our great nation. Illinois is the top soybean-producing state in America. Trump’s tariffs are wreaking havoc on our farmers and agricultural economy — raising fertilizer costs, shutting off markets, and driving down farm incomes. This guy is unhinged. He’s insecure. He’s a wannabe dictator. He said I should be thrown in jail, along with Democratic leaders who’ve had the courage to stand up to him and his threats to our basic democratic principles. **I have one thing to say to Donald Trump: If you come for my people, you come through me. So come and get me.** Derek, Trump and his threats won’t scare me out of fighting back, and I hope that you won’t let them stop you, either. But to prevent him from having two more years of unchecked power, we need to make sure that Democrats up and down the ballot and across the country have the resources that they need to win in 2025, 2026, and beyond. The fact is that the DNC is the organization best positioned to distribute resources to the candidates, organizations, and state parties that need them most to win critical races.
